Name=heal

Script Source=
Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim Map as Long, X as Long, Y as Long
dim Loop as Long, Mana as Long, Health as Long
dim CalcX as Long, CalcY as Long

Map = GetPlayerMap(Player)
X = GetPlayerX(Player)
Y = GetPlayerY(Player)
Mana = Divide(GetPlayerMaxMana(Player), 3) * 2
Health = GetPlayerDamage(Player) - Divide((GetPlayerStrength(Player) + 2), 5)

If GetTileAtt(Map, X, Y) = 6 | GetTileAtt2(Map, X, Y) = 6 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You may not cast that here.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
If GetPlayerMana(Player) < Mana Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must regenerate to cast again.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If

CreatePlayerFloatText(Player, "Ave Maria!", BrightGreen)
SetPlayerMana(Player, GetPlayerMana(Player) - Mana)

For Loop = 1 to GetMaxUsers()
	If IsPlaying(Loop) Then
		If GetPlayerClass(Loop) <> 4 Then
			If Map = GetPlayerMap(Loop) Then
				If Player <> Loop Then
					CalcX = Abs(GetPlayerX(Loop) - X)
					CalcY = Abs(GetPlayerY(Loop) - Y)
					If CalcX < 4 & CalcY < 4 Then
						If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 16) = 0 Then
							RunScript2("heal1", Loop, Health)
						Else
							If GetPlayerGuild(Player) > 0 Then
								If GetPlayerGuild(Player) = GetPlayerGuild(Loop) Then
									RunScript2("heal1", Loop, Health)
								End If
							Else
								SetPlayerFlag(Player, 16, 0)
								PlayerMessage(Player, "Your spells have been set to affect everyone.", White)
								RunScript2("heal1", Loop, Health)
							End If
						End If
					End If
				End If
			End If
		End If
	End If
Next Loop

End Sub

   Dim InventoryList as STRING
   Dim Count as LONG

         If IsPlaying(PlayerCount) & PlayerCount <> Player then
            InventoryList = StrCat(GetPlayerName(PlayerCount)," has the following inventory items: ")
            For Count = 1 to 19
             If StrCmp(GetObjectName(GetPlayerInvObject(PlayerCount,Count)), "") Then

             Else
               InventoryList = StrCat(InventoryList , StrCat(GetObjectName(GetPlayerInvObject(PlayerCount,Count)), ", "))
             End IF
            Next Count
            PlayerMessage(Player,InventoryList,White)
         End If
   Main = STOP
END FUNCTION

Name=invis1

Script Source=
Function Main(Player as Long) AS LONG
'Thief-Mage Hide

If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 25) = 1 Then
	If GetPlayerX(Player) = GetPlayerFlag(Player, 21) & GetPlayerY(Player) = GetPlayerFlag(Player, 22) & GetPlayerHP(Player) = GetPlayerMaxHP(Player) Then
		Timer(Player, 1, "Invis1")
	Else
		RunScript1("TurnVisible", Player)
	End If

Name=jailtimer

Script Source=
Sub Main()
dim A as Long, B as Long, C as Long

For A = 1 to GetMaxUsers()
	B = GetPlayerFlag(A, 40)
	C = GetPlayerFlag(A, 41)
	If B > 0 Then
		If B = 1 Then
			RunScript1("GameWarp", A)
			PlayerMessage(A, "You have been released from jail.", WHITE)
			SetPlayerFlag(A, 40, 0)
		Else
			SetPlayerFlag(A, 40, B - 1)
		End If
	End If
	If C > 0 Then
		If C = 1 Then
			PlayerMessage(A, "You have been unsquelched.", WHITE)
			SetPlayerFlag(A, 41, 0)
		Else
			SetPlayerFlag(A, 41, C - 1)
		End If
	End If
Next A

End Sub

Name=joingame

Script Source=
Function Main(Player As Long) As Long
	Dim A as Long
	'Reset Flags
	RunScript1("ResetFlags", Player)

	If StrCmp(GetMapName(GetPlayerMap(Player)), "") Then PlayerWarp(Player, 1, 5, 5)

	'Player God MOTD
	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 78) > 0 Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You are a helper god.  Available commands are warpto <player>, boot <player> <reason>, ban <player> <reason>, squelch <player> <time>, and jail <player> <time>.", WHITE)
	End If

	'New Player
	If GetPlayerLevel(Player) < 10 Then
		PlayerWarp(Player, 677, 2, 2)
		CalculateStats(Player)
		SetPlayerHP(Player, GetPlayerMaxHP(Player))
		SetPlayerStatus(Player, 2)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "Welcome to Odyssey!  To move about, use the arrow keys.  To run, hold shift while moving.  Head downward to embark on your adventure!", BRIGHTGREEN)
	End If
	If GetPlayerLevel(Player) < 25 Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "Make sure to check the website at www.odysseyclassic.com for extra help.", Yellow)
	End If

	TakeObj(Player, 510, HasObj(Player, 510)) 'Old Incognito
	TakeObj(Player, 497, HasObj(Player, 497)) 'CTF Name Change
	TakeObj(Player, 362, HasObj(Player, 362)) 'Dodgeball
	TakeObj(Player, 383, HasObj(Player, 383)) 'Snowtossers
	TakeObj(Player, 508, HasObj(Player, 508)) 'Red Flag
	TakeObj(Player, 509, HasObj(Player, 509)) 'Blue Flag

	'------- Bug Fix? -------
	If StrCmp(GetPlayerName(Player), "") Then SetPlayerName(Player, "Bugged")

	RunScript1("Sprite", Player)
	RunScript1("Orders", Player)
	'RunScript1("ResetPots", Player)

	'Artifacts
		If HasObj(Player, 393) Then RunScript1("ArtifactSpawn", Player)
		If HasObj(Player, 389) Then RunScript1("ArtifactSpawn", Player)

	'If GetPlayerLevel(Player) > 80 & GetPlayerAccess(Player) = 0 Then PlayerWarp(Player, 666, 5, 5)
	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 31) > 0 Then RunScript1("Poison1", Player)

	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 40) > 0 Then PlayerMessage(Player, strcat("You have ", strcat(str(GetPlayerFlag(Player, 40)), " minutes left to serve.")), White)

	Main = Continue
End Function

	PlayerMessage(Player, "1. Why do you need 100 Lumber?", DarkGrey)
	PlayerMessage(Player, "2. Where can I get these Metal Bands?", DarkGrey)
	SetPlayerFlag(Player, 240, 2)
End If
If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 240) = 2 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "Madargan Gar says, ''Manny has told me of your arrival. Alas I am in need of materials. Bring me 100 Lumber and 2 Metal Bands and I will make you the bucket.''", Yellow)
	PlayerMessage(Player, "1. Why do you need 100 Lumber?", DarkGrey)
	PlayerMessage(Player, "2. Where can I get these Metal Bands?", DarkGrey)
End If
If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 240) = 3 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "Madargan Gar says, ''I am still in need of materials. Bring me 100 Lumber and 2 Metal Bands and I will make you the bucket.''", Yellow)
	PlayerMessage(Player, "1. Why do you need 100 Lumber?", DarkGrey)
	PlayerMessage(Player, "2. Where can I get these Metal Bands?", DarkGrey)
	
End If

	If HasObj(Player, 215) >= 100 & HasObj(Player, 461) >= 2 Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "Madargan Gar says, ''You have all the materials? Type /Craft and I'll get to work.''", Yellow)
	Else
		PlayerMessage(Player, "Madargan Gar says, ''I am still in need of materials. Bring me 100 Lumber and 2 Metal Bands and I will make you the bucket.''", Yellow)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "1. Why do you need 100 Lumber?", DarkGrey)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "2. Where can I get these Metal Bands?", DarkGrey)
	End If
End If

	Playermessage(Player, "Madargan Gar says, ''Did you take that bucket to Manny?", Yellow)
	PlayerMessage(Player, "1. I'm just on my way now.", DarkGrey)

		PlayerMessage(Player, "1. Of course, how can I help?", DarkGrey)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "2. Im a very busy adventurer, leave me be.", DarkGrey)
		Exit Function
	End If
	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 92) = 3 Then
		If HasObj(Player, 280) Then
			PlayerMessage(Player, "Ness Atoui says, ''How's the trip coming along? You haven't gotten far have you...''", Yellow)
		Exit Function
		End If
		If HasObj(Player, 280) = 0 Then
			PlayerMessage(Player, "Ness Atoui says, ''YOU LOST IT!?!? Good thing I knew you'd do that. Would you like another copy?", Yellow)
			PlayerMessage(Player, "1. Eh, yes please...", DarkGrey)
			PlayerMessage(Player, "2. Its ok, I have it in a safe place.", DarkGrey)
			Exit Function
		End If
	End If
	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 92) = 4 Then
		If HasObj(Player, 281) Then
			PlayerMessage(Player, "Ness Atoui says, ''You made it!! Thank you so much adventurer! I don't know how to repay you, all these rubies wouldn't be enough, but I'm sure the deed is reward in itself for you.''", Yellow)
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You say, ''...''", Grey)
			TakeObj(Player, 281, 1)
			SetPlayerFlag(Player, 92, 5)
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You have completed the Gibberish Errand!", BrightGreen)
				If GetPlayerLevel(Player) < 80 Then
					GivePlayerExp(Player, 20000)
					PlayerMessage(Player, "You have gained 20k experience!", Green)
				Else
					GiveObj(Player, 6, 100000)
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You have received 100k Gold Coins!", Green)
				End If
			Exit Function
		End If
		If HasObj(Player, 281) = 0 Then
			PlayerMessage(Player, "Ness Atoui says, ''You met Cundi? But you lost the translation... Good game newb, go get another one.''", Yellow)
			Exit Function
		End If
	End If
	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 92) > 4 Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "Ness Atoui says, ''Welcome to Ness's Ruby Centre, bank of Dragonia''", Grey)	
	End If
Else
	PlayerMessage(Player, "Ness Atoui says, ''Welcome to Ness's Ruby Centre, bank of Dragonia''", Grey)
End If

End Function

Name=keypad

Script Source=
Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim K1 as Long, K2 as Long, K3 as Long, K4 as Long
dim Direction as Long

K1 = 1
K2 = 2
K3 = 3
K4 = 4

If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 110) > 0 Then
	If GetPlayerX(Player) < GetPlayerFlag(Player, 21) Then Direction = 1 'Left
	If GetPlayerX(Player) > GetPlayerFlag(Player, 21) Then Direction = 2 'Right
	If GetPlayerY(Player) < GetPlayerFlag(Player, 22) Then Direction = 3 'Up
	If GetPlayerY(Player) > GetPlayerFlag(Player, 22) Then Direction = 4 'Down

	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 111) = 0 Then
		SetPlayerFlag(Player, 111, Direction)
	Else
		If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 112) = 0 Then
			SetPlayerFlag(Player, 112, Direction)
		Else
			If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 113) = 0 Then
				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 113, Direction)
			Else
				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 114, Direction)
				If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 111) = K1 Then
				If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 112) = K2 Then
				If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 113) = K3 Then
				If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 114) = K4 Then
				CreateMapFloatText(GetPlayerMap(Player), GetPlayerFlag(Player, 21), GetPlayerFlag(Player, 22), "Click!", BrightGreen)
				PlayerMessage(Player, "The plates click as they unlock!", White)
				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 110, 0)
					Select Case GetPlayerMap(Player)
						Case 90
							RunScript1("BossKeypad", Player)
					End Select
					Exit Sub
				End If
				End If
				End If
				End If
				'RESET
				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 110, 0)
				PlayerMessage(Player, "The plates click as they reset.", Grey)
			End If
		End If
	End If
End If

End Sub

Name=khargattack4

Script Source=
Function main(player as long) as long
Dim a as long, b as long, c as long, d as long


Dim SkipCounter as Long
SkipCounter = 0

if getflag(101) = 1 then
b = random(50)+50
timer(player, b, "khargattack4")
For A = 1 to GetMaxUsers()
   If GetPlayerMap(A) = 1572 Then
      If SkipCounter >= C Then
	playermessage(a, "Your mind swims, and suddenly you lose faith in your allies.", grey)
	 SetPlayerGuild(a, 0)
         Exit Function
      End If
      SkipCounter = SkipCounter + 1
   End If
Next A
end if
main = continue
End Function

Function main(player as long) as long

For A = 1 to GetMaxUsers()
   If GetPlayerMap(A) = 1572 Then
          if GetPlayerEquipped(a, 5) = 398 then
          CreateCharacterEffect(1572,a,9,1,7,2,5)
          playermessage(a, "Flames burst beneath your feet, but your Elderfire Ring absorbs most of the inferno!", brightred)
               if getplayerhp(a) <= 20 then
               setplayerisdead(a, 1)
               else
               end if
          setplayerhp(a, (getplayermaxhp(player) - 20))
          else
      playermessage(a, "Kha'rg summons a mighty inferno that rages into life from under you!", brightred)
      CreateCharacterEffect(1572,a,6,1,7,2,5)
      if getplayerhp(a) <= 90 then
               setplayerisdead(a, 1)
               else
      setplayerhp(a, (getplayermaxhp(player) - 90))
         Exit Function
      End If
end if
end if
Next A
end if
main = continue
End Function

Name=killplayer

Script Source=
Function Main(Killer AS LONG, Killed as LONG) as LONG
dim Map as Long, X as Long, Y as Long

Map = GetPlayerMap(Killed)
X = GetPlayerX(Killed)
Y = GetPlayerY(Killed)

	'Poison
	If GetPlayerFlag(Killed, 31) > 0 Then
		SetPlayerFlag(Killed, 31, 0)
		SetPlayerFlag(Killed, 33, 0)
	End If

	'God Death
	If GetPlayerAccess(Killed) > 0 Then
		Main = Stop
		Exit Function
	End If
	
	'Cleric Spell - Redemption
	If GetPlayerFlag(Killed, 207) > 0 Then RunScript1("redemption2", Killed)

	'Minigames
	Select Case GetPlayerFlag(Killed, 10)
		Case 1 'Carn
			RunScript2("carnkill", Killer, Killed)
			Main = Stop
			Exit Function
		Case 2 'Team Carn
			RunScript2("teamkill", Killer, Killed)
			Main = Stop
			Exit Function
		Case 3 'Battle
			RunScript2("battlekill", Killer, Killed)
			Main = Stop
			Exit Function
		Case 4 'TTD
			RunScript2("ttdkill", Killer, Killed)
			Main = Stop
			Exit Function
		Case 6 'Big CTF
			RunScript2("ctfkill", Killer, Killed)
			Main = Stop
			Exit Function
		Case 11 'Football
			RunScript2("footballkill", Killer, Killed)
			Main = Stop
			Exit Function
		Case 12 'Dodgeball
			RunScript2("dodgeballkill", Killer, Killed)
			Main = Stop
			Exit Function
		Case 13 'Team Arena
			RunScript2("teamarenakill", Killer, Killed)
			Main = Stop
			Exit Function
		Case 14 'Tournament Kill
			RunScript2("tournamentkill", Killer, Killed)
			Main = Stop
			Exit Function
		Case 16 'Snowball Tag
			RunScript2("snowballkill", Killer, Killed)
			Main = Stop
			Exit Function
	End Select

	'Hell
	If GetPlayerMap(Killed) = 666 Then
		Main = Stop
		Exit Function
	End If

	'Stake Arena
	If GetPlayerFlag(Killer, 13) = 3 Then
		RunScript2("stakekill", Killer, Killed)
		Main = Stop
		Exit Function
	End If

	'Duel Arena
	If GetPlayerFlag(Killer, 14) > 0 Then
		RunScript2("duelkill", Killer, Killed)
		Main = Stop
		Exit Function
	End If
	
	If GetPlayerMap(Killer) = 1988 | GetPlayerMap(Killer) = 1987 Then
		PlayerWarp(Killed, 1988, 6, 3)
		RunScript1("Restore", Killed)
		Main = Stop
		Exit Function
	End If

	If HasObj(Killed, 393) Then
		If GetPlayerGuild(Killer) > 0 Then
			If RunScript1("Invent", Killer) = 1 Then
				RunScript1("ArtifactSpawn", Killed)
			Else
				If HasObj(Killer, 389) | HasObj(Killer, 393) Then
					RunScript1("ArtifactSpawn", Killed)
				Else
					TakeObj(Killed, 393, HasObj(Killed, 393))
					GiveObj(Killer, 393, 1)
					GlobalMessage(strcat(GetPlayerName(Killer), " takes the Babylon Torch!"), Yellow)
				End If
			End If
		Else
			RunScript1("ArtifactSpawn", Killed)
		End If
	End If
	If HasObj(Killed, 389) Then
		If GetPlayerGuild(Killer) > 0 Then
			If RunScript1("Invent", Killer) = 1 Then
				RunScript1("ArtifactSpawn", Killed)
			Else
				If HasObj(Killer, 389) | HasObj(Killer, 393) Then
					RunScript1("ArtifactSpawn", Killed)
				Else
					TakeObj(Killed, 389, HasObj(Killed, 389))
					GiveObj(Killer, 389, 1)
					GlobalMessage(strcat(GetPlayerName(Killer), " takes the Dragonia Candle!"), Yellow)
				End If
			End If
		Else
			RunScript1("ArtifactSpawn", Killed)
		End If
	End If

	'Prevent being warped to town when killed in the arena
	Select Case GetPlayerMap(Killed)
		Case 1887 'Gallins House
			SetPlayerFlag(Killed, 30, 2)
		Case 1962 'House of PK
			SetPlayerFlag(Killed, 30, 1)
		Case Else
			SpawnObject(Map, 443, 1, X, Y)	'First Aid Kits
	End Select
	
	SetPlayerFlag(Killed, 15, 1)

	Main = Continue
End Function

Sub Main()
dim Light as Long

Light = GetFlag(71)

If GetFlag(70) = 0 Then 'Daytime
	Light = Light + 5
	If Light > 140 Then
		Light = 135
		SetFlag(70, 1)
	End If
Else
	Light = Light - 5
	If Light < 20 Then
		Light = 20
		SetFlag(70, 0)
	End If
End If

SetFlag(71, Light)
SetOutdoorLight(Light)

End Sub

Name=lottery

Script Source=
Function Main(Player as Long) AS LONG
dim Pot as Long, Loop as Long, Number as Long, Cost as Long

Pot = GetFlag(121)
Cost = GetFlag(124)
Number = 1

If GetFlag(122) = 1 Then
	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 220) > 0 Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, strcat("Your ticket number is ", str(GetPlayerFlag(Player, 220))), White)
		Exit Function
	End If

	If HasObj(Player, 6) >= Cost Then
	
		For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
			If IsPlaying(Loop) Then
				If Loop = Player Then
				Else
					If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 220) > 0 Then
						If StrCmp(GetPlayerIP(Player), GetPlayerIP(Loop)) Then
							PlayerMessage(Player, "You have already entered the lottery on another account", WHITE)
							Exit Function
						End If
					End If
				End If
			End If
		Next Loop
		
		TakeObj(Player, 6, Cost)
LoopStart:
		For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
			If IsPlaying(Loop) Then
				If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 220) = Number Then
					Number = Number + 1
					Goto LoopStart
				End If
			End If
		Next Loop

		SetFlag(120, GetFlag(120) + 1)
		SetFlag(121, Pot + Cost)
		SetPlayerFlag(Player, 220, Number)
		PlayerMessage(Player, strcat("Your ticket number is ", str(Number)), White)
		If HasObj(Player, 481) = 0 Then GiveObj(Player, 481, 1)
	Else
		PlayerMessage(Player, strcat("You require ", strcat(str(Cost), " Gold to play the Lottery.")), Grey)
	End If
Else
	PlayerMessage(Player, "Lottery is not open.", Grey)
End If

End Function

Function Main(Player as Long) AS Long
dim Loop as Long, WinNum as Long

WinNum = Random(GetFlag(120)) + 1

For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
	If IsPlaying(Loop) Then
		If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 220) = WinNum Then
			GlobalMessage(strcat("And the winning number is...", strcat(str(WinNum), "!")), Yellow)
			GlobalMessage(strcat(GetPlayerName(Loop), strcat(" wins the Jackpot of ", strcat(str(GetFlag(121)), "!!"))), BrightGreen)
			GiveObj(Loop, 6, GetFlag(121) + GetFlag(123))
			SetFlag(120, 0)
			SetFlag(121, 0)
			SetFlag(122, 0)
			Goto ResetFlags
		End If
	End If
Next Loop

ResetFlags:
For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
	SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 220, 0)
	TakeObj(Loop, 481, 1)
Next Loop
End Function

				Goto EndLoop

		End If
	Next Loop

Name=lure

Script Source=
Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim Map as Long, Mon as Long
Map = GetPlayerMap(Player)

CreatePlayerFloatText(Player, "Mon En!", BrightGreen)

Select Case GetPlayerDirection(Player)
	Case 0
		For Mon = 0 To 5
			If GetMonsterY(Map, Mon) <= GetPlayerY(Player) Then
				If Abs(GetPlayerX(Player) - GetMonsterX(Map, Mon)) < 4 Then
					SetMonsterTarget(Map, Mon, Player)
				End If
			End If
		Next Mon
	Case 1
		For Mon = 0 To 5
			If GetMonsterY(Map, Mon) >= GetPlayerY(Player) Then
				If Abs(GetPlayerX(Player) - GetMonsterX(Map, Mon)) < 4 Then
					SetMonsterTarget(Map, Mon, Player)
				End If
			End If
		Next Mon
	Case 2
		For Mon = 0 To 5
			If GetMonsterX(Map, Mon) <= GetPlayerX(Player) Then
				If Abs(GetPlayerY(Player) - GetMonsterY(Map, Mon)) < 4 Then
					SetMonsterTarget(Map, Mon, Player)
				End If
			End If
		Next Mon
	Case 3
		For Mon = 0 To 5
			If GetMonsterX(Map, Mon) >= GetPlayerX(Player) Then
				If Abs(GetPlayerY(Player) - GetMonsterY(Map, Mon)) < 4 Then
					SetMonsterTarget(Map, Mon, Player)
				End If
			End If
		Next Mon
End Select

End Sub

		End If
	End If

Name=map109

Script Source=
sub main(player as long)
'Random Damage Carnage Script by Atrus
dim a as long
a = random(9)
if getplayerhp(player) > getplayermaxhp(player) + 1 then
else
if getplayerhp(player) < 5 then
else
if a = 1 then
setplayerhp(player, getplayerhp(player) - 5)
playermessage(player,"Ouch, you got burnt!",brightred)
else
if a = 2 then
setplayerhp(player, getplayerhp(player) - 5)
playermessage(player,"Ouch, you got burnt!",brightred)
else
if a = 3 then
setplayerhp(player, getplayerhp(player) - 10)
playermessage(player,"Ouch, you got burnt!",brightred)
else
if a = 4 then
setplayerhp(player, getplayerhp(player) - 10)
playermessage(player,"Ouch, you got burnt!",brightred)
else
if a = 5 then
setplayerhp(player, getplayerhp(player) - 15)
playermessage(player,"Ouch, you got burnt!",brightred)
else
if a = 6 then
setplayerhp(player, getplayerhp(player) - 20)
playermessage(player,"Ouch, you got burnt!",brightred)
else
if a = 7 then
setplayerhp(player, getplayerhp(player) - 5)
playermessage(player,"Ouch, you got burnt!",brightred)
else
if a = 8 then
setplayerhp(player, getplayerhp(player) - 10)
playermessage(player,"Ouch, you got burnt!",brightred)
else
if a = 9 then
setplayerhp(player, getplayerhp(player) - 5)
playermessage(player,"Ouch, you got burnt!",brightred)
end if
end if
end if
end if
end if
end if
end if
end if
end if
end if
end if
end sub

Name=map1213_5_6

Script Source=
Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim Cost as Long
Cost = 10000

If GetPlayerDirection(Player) = Up Then
	If GetPlayerHP(Player) = GetPlayerMaxHP(Player) Then
		If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 75) = 0 Then
			If HasObj(Player, 6) >= Cost Then
				PlayerWarp(Player, 1213, 5, 5)
				TakeObj(Player, 6, Cost)
				SetFlag(112, GetFlag(112) + Cost) 'Money Collected
				PlayerMessage(Player, strcat("You pay ", strcat(str(Cost), " Gold and go through the barrier.")), White)
			Else
				PlayerWarp(Player, 1213, 5, 7)
				PlayerMessage(Player, strcat("You need ", strcat(str(Cost), " Gold to enter.")), Grey)
			End If
		Else
			PlayerWarp(Player, 1213, 5, 5)
			PlayerMessage(Player, "Lofgan says, ''Right this way sir!''", White)
		End If
	Else
		PlayerWarp(Player, 1213, 5, 7)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You need full Health to enter.", Grey)
	End If
Else
	PlayerWarp(Player, 1213, 5, 7)
	PlayerMessage(Player, "Lofgan says, ''Hope you found what you were looking for. Come again soon!''", Grey)
End If

End Sub

Name=map124_10_6

Script Source=
Function Main(player as long) as long
dim a as long

For A = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
	If GetPlayerGuild(A) = 0 Then
		If GetPlayerFlag(A, 10) = 1 Then
			SetPlayerFlag(A, 10, 0)
			PlayerWarp(A, 677, 5, 5)
			BootPlayer(A, "Left Guild in CTF")
		End If
	End If
Next A

'Spectator
If GetPlayerGuild(Player) <> 30 & GetPlayerGuild(Player) <> 31 Then
	Exit Function
End If

'RedTeam
If getplayerguild(player) = 30 then
	exit function
end if

'BlueTeam
If getplayerguild(player) = 31 then
If hasobj(player,508) then		'Has Red Flag

For A = 0 to getmaxusers
	If HasObj(A, 509) Then		'Blue Flag Gone
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You must recover your flag first!", 15)
		exit function
	end if
Next A

'Blue Score
setflag(63,getflag(63)+1)
globalmessage(strcat(getplayername(player), " has scored for the Blue Team!"),white)
globalmessage(strcat("<Score> Red Team: ", strcat(str(getflag(62)),strcat(" Blue Team: ",strcat(str(getflag(63)), " <Score>")))),yellow)
takeobj(player,508,1)
setplayerstatus(player,0)
setPlayerSprite(Player, 133)
ResetMap(124)
ResetMap(149)
ResetMap(150)
for a = 0 to getmaxusers
	If GetPlayerMap(A) = 124 | GetPlayerMap(A) = 149 | GetPlayerMap(A) = 150 Then
		takeobj(a,509,1)
		SetPlayerStatus(a, 0)
		SetPlayerHP(a, GetPlayerMaxHP(a))
		SetPlayerEnergy(a, GetPlayerMaxEnergy(a))
		SetPlayerMana(a, GetPlayerMaxMana(a))
			if getplayerguild(a) = 31 then
				playerwarp(a,124,8,6)
				setPlayerSprite(a, 133)
			End If
			if getplayerguild(a) = 30 then
				playerwarp(a,150,3,6)
				setPlayerSprite(a, 132)
			End If
	End If
next a

'Blue Team Wins
if getflag(63) = 5 then
 globalmessage("The Blue Team has won Capture the Flag!",brightGreen)
 setflag(62,0)
 setflag(63,0)
      
      for a = 0 to getmaxusers
		if getplayermap(a) = 124 | getplayermap(a) = 149 | getplayermap(a) = 150 then
			if getplayeraccess(a) = 0 then
				If GetPlayerGuild(A) = 31 Then GiveObj(A, 504, 1)
				SetPlayerStatus(A,0)
				SetPlayerSprite(A,0)
				SetPlayerGuild(A, GetPlayerFlag(A, 5))
				Playerwarp(A, 677,5,5)	
			end if
		end if 
      next a
      Exit Function
end if

'Spawn Flags
SpawnObject(150, 508, 1, 1, 6)
SpawnObject(124, 509, 1, 10, 6)
exit function

else
	PlayerWarp(Player, 124, 9, 6)
	exit function
end if
end if

End Function

Script Source=
SUB Main(Player AS LONG)
   If GetPlayerLevel(Player) > 10 Then
      If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 69) = 0 Then
         GlobalMessage(StrCat(StrCat(GetPlayerName(Player), " has stepped on the Tile of Truth and is level "), Str(GetPlayerLevel(Player))), WHITE)
         SetPlayerFlag(Player, 69, 1)
         PlayerWarp(Player, 127, 5, 8)
      Else
         PlayerWarp(Player, 127, 5, 8)
      End If
   Else
      PlayerMessage(Player, "You are too weak to approach the tile of truth!", BRIGHTRED)
      PlayerWarp(Player, 127, 5, 8)
   End If
END SUB

Name=map1315_4_1

Script Source=
Function Main(Player as Long) AS LONG

If GetPlayerHP(Player) = GetPlayerMaxHP(Player) Then
	If GetMapPlayerCount(1489) = 0 Then
		PlayerWarp(Player, 1489, 5, 3)
		SetFlag(93, 1)
		ResetMap(1489)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You hear a voice say, ''You wish to learn of the Dark Arts? So be it.''", White)
		SpawnMonster(1489, 240, 5, 5, 0)
		Timer(Player, 20, "summonerfire")
	Else
		PlayerMessage(Player, "Someone is already attempting the Summoners Challenge.", Grey)
		PlayerWarp(Player, 1315, 4, 2)
	End If
Else
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You should regenerate before attempting the Summoners Challenge.", Grey)
	PlayerWarp(Player, 1315, 4, 2)
End If

End Function

playerwarp(player,666,6,6)
end if
end if

if getplayerlevel(player) >20 then

end if
end if

Sub Main(Player as Long)

Else
	OpenDoor(1413, 10, 9)
	PlayerWarp(Player, 1413, 1, 8)
	SetPlayerFlag(Player, 10, 10)
	SetPlayerFlag(Player, 11, 1)

	Select Case GetPlayerFlag(Player, 216)
		Case 0
			Spawn = 1
		Case 1
			Spawn = 2
		Case 2
			Spawn = 3
		Case 3
			Spawn = 4
		Case 4
			Spawn = 4
	End Select

	Case 1
		SpawnMonster(1413, 190, 2, 9, 0)
	Case 2
		SpawnMonster(1413, 191, 2, 9, 0)
	Case 3
		SpawnMonster(1413, 192, 2, 9, 0)
	Case 4
		SpawnMonster(1413, 193, 2, 9, 0)
End Select
End If

Name=map1423_0_0

Script Source=
Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim Loop as Long, Count as Long

For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
	If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10) = 11 Then
		If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11) = 1 Then Count = Count + 1
	End If
Next Loop

If Count < GetFlag(104) Then
	RunScript1("FootballRed", Player)
	MapMessage(1423, strcat(GetPlayerName(Player), " has subbed in."), Red)
	MapMessage(1424, strcat(GetPlayerName(Player), " has subbed in."), Red)
	MapMessage(1425, strcat(GetPlayerName(Player), " has subbed in."), Red)
Else
	PlayerWarp(Player, 1423, 1, 0)
	PlayerMessage(Player, strcat("There are already ", strcat(str(GetFlag(104)), " players on the field.")), Yellow)
End If

End Sub

Function Main(Player as Long) AS LONG
dim Map as Long, X as Long, Y as Long, Monster as Long

Map = GetPlayerMap(Player)

For X = 3 To 7
	For Y = 3 To 8
		If Random(3) = 0 Then
			CreateTileEffect(Map, X, Y, 26, 40 + Random(20), 8, 0, 0)
				If GetPlayerX(Player) = X & GetPlayerY(Player) = Y Then
					MagicAttackPlayer(Player, Player, 42)
				End If
				For Monster = 0 To 5
					If GetMonsterX(1489, Monster) = X & GetMonsterY(1489, Monster) = Y Then
						'AttackMonster(Player, Monster, 10)
					End If
				Next Monster
		End If
	Next Y
Next X

End Function

	Y = Random(5) + 2
	For X = 1 To 9
		CreateTileEffect(Map, X, Y, 1, 40, 8, 0, 0)
			If GetPlayerX(Player) = X & GetPlayerY(Player) = Y Then
				MagicAttackPlayer(Player, Player, 44)
			End If
			For Monster = 0 To 5
				If GetMonsterX(1489, Monster) = X & GetMonsterY(1489, Monster) = Y Then
					AttackMonster(Player, Monster, 15)
				End If
			Next Monster
	Next X
Next Loop

End Function

*******************************************************
Name=map150_1_6

Script Source=
Function Main(player as long) as long
dim a as long

For A = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
	If GetPlayerGuild(A) = 0 Then
		If GetPlayerFlag(A, 10) = 1 Then
			SetPlayerFlag(A, 10, 0)
			PlayerWarp(A, 677, 5, 5)
			BootPlayer(A, "Left Guild in CTF")
		End If
	End If
Next A

'Spectator
If GetPlayerGuild(Player) <> 30 & GetPlayerGuild(Player) <> 31 Then
	Exit Function
End If

'Blue Team
If GetPlayerGuild(Player) = 31 Then Exit Function

'Red Team
If getplayerguild(player) = 30 then
If hasobj(player,509) = 1 then	'Has Blue Flag

For A = 0 to getmaxusers
	If HasObj(A, 508) Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You must recover your flag first!", 15)
		exit function
	end if
Next A

'Red Score
setflag(62,getflag(62)+1)
globalmessage( strcat(getplayername(player), " has scored for the Red Team!"),white)
globalmessage(strcat("<Score> Red Team: ", strcat(str(getflag(62)),strcat(" Blue Team: ",strcat(str(getflag(63)), " <Score>")))),yellow)
takeobj(player,509,1)
ResetMap(124)
ResetMap(149)
ResetMap(150)
for a = 0 to getmaxusers
	If GetPlayerMap(A) = 124 | GetPlayerMap(A) = 149 | GetPlayerMap(A) = 150 Then
		takeobj(a,508,1)
		setplayerstatus(a,0)
		SetPlayerHP(a, GetPlayerMaxHP(a))
		SetPlayerEnergy(a, GetPlayerMaxEnergy(a))
		SetPlayerMana(a, GetPlayerMaxMana(a))
		if getplayerguild(a) = 31 then
			playerwarp(a,124,8,6)
			SetPlayerSprite(a, 133)
		End If
		if getplayerguild(a) = 30 then
			playerwarp(a,150,3,6)
			SetPlayerSprite(a, 132)
		End If
	End If
next a

'Red Team Wins
if getflag(62) = 5 then
 globalmessage("The Red Team has won Capture the Flag!",brightGreen)
 setflag(62,0)
 setflag(63,0)
      
      for a = 0 to getmaxusers
      if getplayermap(a) = 124 | getplayermap(a) = 149 | getplayermap(a) = 150 then
      if getplayeraccess(a) = 0 then
		If GetPlayerGuild(a) = 30 Then GiveObj(A, 504, 1)
		SetPlayerStatus(A,0)
		SetPlayerSprite(A,0)
		SetPlayerGuild(A, GetPlayerFlag(A, 5))
		Playerwarp(A, 677,5,5)
      end if
      end if 
      next a
      Exit Function
end if

SpawnObject(150, 508, 1, 1, 6)
SpawnObject(124, 509, 1, 10, 6)


exit function

else
	PlayerWarp(Player, 150, 2, 6)
exit function
end if
end if
End Function

Name=map1551_1_2

Script Source=
Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim Loop as Long

PlayerWarp(Player, 1551, 2, 2)
If GetPlayerGuild(Player) > 0 Then
	If HasObj(Player, 389) Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You are already holding an Artifact.", Grey)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
		If HasObj(Loop, 393) Then
			PlayerMessage(Player, "The Torch has been taken.", Grey)
			Exit Sub
		End If
	Next Loop
	If RunScript1("Invent", Player) = 1 Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "Your inventory is full.", Grey)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	GlobalMessage(strcat(GetPlayerName(Player), " has picked up the Babylon Torch!"), Yellow)
	GiveObj(Player, 393, 1)
	For Loop = 0 To 80
		If GetObjNum(1551, Loop) = 393 Then DestroyObject(1551, Loop)
	Next Loop
Else
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must be Guilded to handle this Artifact.", Grey)
End If

End Sub

Name=MAP1552_11_7

Script Source=
SUB Main(Player AS LONG)
Dim A as Long, B as Long, RedFlag as Long, BlueFlag as Long
RedFlag = 492
BlueFlag = 493
If GetPlayerGuild(Player) = 31 Then
   If HasObj(Player, RedFlag) Then
      For B = 1 to 80
         If HasObj(B, BlueFlag) Then
            PlayerMessage(Player, "You must recover your flag first!", 15)
            Exit Sub
         End If
      Next B
      TakeObj(Player, RedFlag, 1)
      SpawnObject(1552, RedFlag, 1, 0, 8)
      GlobalMessage(StrCat(GetPlayerName(Player), " returned the Red Flag to the Blue Base.  Blue Team Wins!"), 11)
      GiveObj(Player, 504, 1)
      For A = 1 to 80
         If GetPlayerMap(A) = 1552 Then
               If HasObj(A, RedFlag) Then
                  TakeObj(A, RedFlag, 1)
                  SpawnObject(78, RedFlag, 1, 10, 5)
               End If
               PlayerWarp(A, 79, 5, 5)
               If GetPlayerGuild(A) = 31 Then GiveObj(A, 504, 1)
               If GetPlayerAccess(A) = 0 Then
                  SetPlayerGuild(A, 0)
                  SetPlayerSprite(A, 0)
                  SetPlayerStatus(A, 0)
               End If
         End If
      Next A
   Else
      PlayerWarp(Player, 78, 10, 7)
   End If
Else
   PlayerWarp(Player, 78, 10, 7)
End If
END SUB

Name=map161_11_2

Script Source=
sub main(player as long)
'//Random Damage Carnage Script by Atrus
dim a as long
a = random(9)
if getplayerhp(player) > getplayermaxhp(player) + 1 then
else
if getplayerhp(player) < 5 then
else
if a = 1 then
setplayerhp(player, getplayerhp(player) - 5)
playermessage(player,"Ouch, you got sucked into the swamp!",brightred)
else
if a = 2 then
setplayerhp(player, getplayerhp(player) - 5)
playermessage(player,"Ouch, you got sucked into the swamp!",brightred)
else
if a = 3 then
setplayerhp(player, getplayerhp(player) - 10)
playermessage(player,"Ouch, you got sucked into the swamp!",brightred)
else
if a = 4 then
setplayerhp(player, getplayerhp(player) - 10)
playermessage(player,"Ouch, you got sucked into the swamp!",brightred)
else
if a = 5 then
setplayerhp(player, getplayerhp(player) - 15)
playermessage(player,"Ouch, you got sucked into the swamp!",brightred)
else
if a = 6 then
setplayerhp(player, getplayerhp(player) - 20)
playermessage(player,"Ouch, you got sucked into the swamp!",brightred)
else
if a = 7 then
setplayerhp(player, getplayerhp(player) - 5)
playermessage(player,"Ouch, you got sucked into the swamp!",brightred)
else
if a = 8 then
setplayerhp(player, getplayerhp(player) - 10)
playermessage(player,"Ouch, you got sucked into the swamp!",brightred)
else
if a = 9 then
setplayerhp(player, getplayerhp(player) - 5)
playermessage(player,"Ouch, you got sucked into the swamp!",brightred)
end if
end if
end if
end if
end if
end if
end if
end if
end if
end if
end if
end sub

Script Source=
Function Main(Player as Long) AS LONG
dim Ration as Long, Slot as Long, A as Long
Ration = HasObj(Player, 445) + HasObj(Player, 446) + HasObj(Player, 447) + HasObj(Player, 449)

For Slot = 1 To 20
	If GetPlayerInvObject(Player, Slot) = 0 Then
		A = A + 1
	End If
Next Slot
	If A = 0 Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You have no room in your inventory to create potions.", Grey)
		Exit Function
	End If

If Ration < 3 Then
'20 Scorpian Stings => Strength Potion
	If HasObj(Player, 403) & HasObj(Player, 286) >= 10 & HasObj(Player, 78) >= 20 Then
		TakeObj(Player, 78, 20)
		TakeObj(Player, 403, 1)
		TakeObj(Player, 286, 10)
		GiveObj(Player, 445, 1)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You've made a Vial of Water, 10 Hell Shards and 20 Scorpian Stings into a Strength Potion!", Yellow)
		Exit Function
	Else
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You do not have all the ingredients required.", Grey)
	End If
Else
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You may not carry more than 3 Stat Potions.", Grey)
End If

End Function

		TakeObj(Player, 286, 10)

		PlayerMessage(Player, "You've made a Vial of Water, 10 Hell Shards and 20 Marshroom into a Vigorous Potion!", Yellow)
		Exit Function
	Else
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You do not have all the ingredients required.", Grey)
	End If
Else
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You may not carry more than 3 Stat Potions.", Grey)
End If

End Function

*******************************************************
Name=map1622_6_4

Script Source=
Function Main(Player as Long) AS LONG
dim Ration as Long, Slot as Long, A as Long
Ration = HasObj(Player, 445) + HasObj(Player, 446) + HasObj(Player, 447) + HasObj(Player, 449)

For Slot = 1 To 20
	If GetPlayerInvObject(Player, Slot) = 0 Then
		A = A + 1
	End If
Next Slot
	If A = 0 Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You have no room in your inventory to create potions.", Grey)
		Exit Function
	End If

If Ration < 3 Then
'20 Scorpian Stings => Strength Potion
	If HasObj(Player, 403) & HasObj(Player, 286) >= 10 & HasObj(Player, 285) >= 5 Then
		TakeObj(Player, 285, 5)
		TakeObj(Player, 403, 1)
		TakeObj(Player, 286, 10)
		GiveObj(Player, 447, 1)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You've made a Vial of Water, 10 Hell Shards and 5 Demon Hearts into a Constitution Potion!", Yellow)
		Exit Function
	Else
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You do not have all the ingredients required.", Grey)
	End If
Else
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You may not carry more than 3 Stat Potions.", Grey)
End If

End Function

Script Source=
Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim Gate as Long
Gate = 0

If strcmp(GetPlayerUser(Player), "brandon") Then Gate = 1
If strcmp(GetPlayerUser(Player), "wish") Then Gate = 1
If strcmp(GetPlayerUser(Player), "jeromeb") Then Gate = 1
If strcmp(GetPlayerUser(Player), "awsq") Then Gate = 1
'If strcmp(GetPlayerUser(Player), "captainmarco") Then Gate = 1

If Gate = 1 Then
	PlayerWarp(Player, 1692, 5, 5)
Else
	PlayerWarp(Player, 1692, 3, 5)
End If

End Sub

Name=map1701_10_2

Script Source=
Sub Main(Player as Long)

If GetPlayerGuild(Player) > 0 Then
	If GetGuildHall(GetPlayerGuild(Player)) = 23 Then
		If GetPlayerGuildRank(Player) = 2 | GetPlayerGuildRank(Player) = 3 Then
			OpenDoor(1701, 10, 3)
		Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, "Only leaders may open this vault.", White)
		End If
	End If
End If

End Sub

			OpenDoor(1792, 1, 4)

		End If
	End If
End If

Name=map1793_5_1

Script Source=
Sub Main(Player as Long)

If GetPlayerDirection(Player) = 1 Then
	PlayerWarp(Player, 1793, 5, 2)
	GiveObj(Player, 392, 1)
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You have refunded your Game Token.", White)
Else
	If HasObj(Player, 392) Then
		TakeObj(Player, 392, 1)
		PlayerWarp(Player, 1793, 5, 0)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You put in a Game Token.", White)
	Else
		PlayerWarp(Player, 1793, 5, 2)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You require a Game Token to play.", Grey)
	End If
End If

End Sub

Name=map1799_1_3

Script Source=
Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim Loop as Long, Count as Long

Count = 0
For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
	If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 13) = 2 Then Count = Count + 1
Next Loop
If Count > 0 Then Exit Sub

SetPlayerFlag(Player, 13, 2)

End Sub

Name=map1826_0_9

Script Source=
SUB Main(Player AS LONG)
	Dim A As Long
	Dim B As Long
	B = 0
	For A = 1 to GetMaxUsers
		If GetPlayerMap(A) = 1827 Then
			B = A
		End If
	Next A
	
	If B > 0 Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, StrCat(GetPlayerName(B), " is already in the treasure room!"), BRIGHTRED)
		PlayerWarp(Player, 1826, 1, 1)
	Else
		ResetMap(1827)
		PlayerWarp(Player, 1827, 5, 6)
		GivePlayerExp(Player, 50000)
		GivePlayerExp(Player, 50000)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You receive 100k experience for completing Hero's Quest!", White)
	End If
END SUB

Script Source=
Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim Spawn as Long

If GetFlag(89) = 0 Then
	RunScript1("GameWarp", Player)
	PlayerMessage(Player, "Solo the Champ is closed.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
If GetFlag(90) > 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "There is already someone soloing the Champ.", Grey)
	PlayerWarp(Player, 1828, 10, 1)
Else
	ResetMap(1828)
	PlayerWarp(Player, 1828, 5, 5)
	SetPlayerFlag(Player, 10, 8)
	SetFlag(90, Player)
	Select Case GetPlayerFlag(Player, 215)
		Case 0
			Spawn = 1
		Case 1
			Spawn = 2
		Case 2
			Spawn = 3
		Case 3
			Spawn = 4
		Case 4
			Spawn = 4
	End Select

Select Case Random(Spawn) + 1
	Case 1
		SpawnMonster(1828, 216, 6, 6, 0)
	Case 2
		SpawnMonster(1828, 144, 6, 6, 0)
	Case 3
		SpawnMonster(1828, 123, 6, 6, 0)
	Case 4
		SpawnMonster(1828, 114, 6, 6, 0)
End Select
End If

End Sub

Script Source=
sub main(player as long)
if hasobj(player,456) >= 1 then
takeobj(player,456,1)
else
playerwarp(player,1856,10,10)
playermessage(PLayer,"YOU NEED ITENS",red)
end if


dim a as long

for a = 0 to getmaxusers()
if getplayermap(a) = 1856 & getplayery(a) <= 9 then 
goto outs
playerwarp(player,1856,10,10)
playermessage(player,"someone is already fighting it!",red)
end if
next a
if getplayermap(player) = 1856 then runscript1("bosswarp",a)
outs:
end sub

Name=map1856_9_4

Script Source=
Function main(player as long) as long
Dim a as long, x as long, y as long
setflag(43, 2)
a = random(12) + 1
'mapmessage(getplayermap(player),str(a),white)

if getplayerdirection(player) = left then
x = getplayerx(player) - 1
y = getplayery(player)
else
if getplayerdirection(player) = right then
x = getplayerx(player) + 1
y = getplayery(player)
else
if getplayerdirection(player) = up then
x = getplayerx(player)
y = getplayery(player) - 1 
else
if getplayerdirection(player) = down then
x = getplayerx(player)
y = getplayery(player) + 1 
else
end if
end if
end if
end if

select case a

case 1
spawnobject(getplayermap(player),387,1,x,y)


case else


end select

main = continue
End Function

Script Source=
Sub Main(Player as Long)

If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 13) < 4 Then
	If GetPlayerDirection(Player) = Right Then
		PlayerWarp(Player, 1949, 8, 1)
	Else
		PlayerWarp(Player, 1949, 9, 2)
	End If
Else
	If GetPlayerDirection(Player) = Right Then
		PlayerWarp(Player, 1949, 9, 2)
	Else
		PlayerWarp(Player, 1949, 11, 7)
		SetPlayerFlag(Player, 13, 0)
		RunScript1("Restore", Player)
		SetFlag(150, 0)
		MapMessage(1949, "A new duel may now begin.", Yellow)
	End If
End If

End Sub

Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim X as Long, Y as Long

SetPlayerFlag(Player, 210, 196)
Select Case GetPlayerDirection(Player)
	Case Up
		X = 2
		Y = 5
	Case Down
		X = 2
		Y = 3
	Case Left
		X = 3
		Y = 4
	Case Right
		X = 1
		Y = 4
End Select
SetPlayerFlag(Player, 211, X)
SetPlayerFlag(Player, 212, Y)
PlayerWarp(Player, 554, 10, 10)

End Sub

Script Source=
FUNCTION Main(Player AS LONG) AS LONG
dim a as long, b as long, c as long

if hasobj(player,288) then
goto ok
else

a = hasobj(player,198) + hasobj(player,41) + hasobj(player,99)

   If a > 5 Then
   PlayerMessage(player, "You can not carry more than five ration items!", grey)
      TakeObj(Player, 41, 1)
      TakeObj(Player, 41, 1)
      TakeObj(Player, 41, 1)
Main = Stop
      Exit Function
   Else
      Main = Continue
   End If
end if

ok:
main = continue
END FUNCTION

Script Source=
Function Main(Player as Long) AS LONG
dim Mana as Long
'Test Tile Buff

	If GetPlayerMana(Player) >= Mana Then
		
			SetPlayerMana(Player, GetPlayerMana(Player) - Mana)
				SetEquippedItemSuffix(Player, 3, 250)
				Timer(Player, 30, "testbuff")
			CreatePlayerFloatText(Player, "Os Mose!", BrightGreen)
			CreateCharacterEffect(GetPlayerMap(Player), Player, 58, 40, 8, 1, 0)

		End If

		PlayerMessage(Player, "You must regenerate before casting.", Grey)


	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must wait to cast again.", Grey)


End Function

*******************************************************
*******************************************************
Name=map2114_1_0

Script Source=
Sub Main(Player as Long)



If GetPlayerGuild(Player) > 0 Then	
if getplayerguild(player) = getflag(186) & getflag(185) > 0 then 




	dim Cost as Long
	Cost = 3


	Dim Effect as Long, Damage as Long, HP as Long

	Dim XCoord as Long, YCoord as Long, Loop as Long, MonsterLoop as Long
	
	dim xPos as long, yPos as long


	If HasObj(Player, 603) >= Cost Then

	TakeObj(Player, 603, cost)




	playermessage(player, "The magic artillery pushes you back!", yellow)
	PlayerWarp(Player, 2114, 1, 2)
	CreateTileEffect(2114, 1, 0, 1, 100, 8, 0, 0)




	'Area of Effect - Mage Spell - Arcane Rain

	Effect = 45

	Damage = GetPlayerDamage(Player) + 5

	xPos = random(5)

	yPos = random(5)+6

	For Loop = 1 to GetMaxUsers()


	If IsPlaying(Loop) Then



		If GetPlayerMap(Loop) = getplayermap(player) Then



	

			for xCoord = 0 to 2

			for yCoord = 0 to 2

			

				if getplayerx(loop) = xpos +xCoord & getplayery(loop) = ypos + yCoord then

				


						CreateTileEffect(GetPlayerMap(Player), xpos +xCoord, ypos + yCoord, 45, 50, 6, 4, 0)
						MagicAttackPlayer(Player, Loop, Damage)

						

				end if

				

			next xCoord

			next yCoord







		End If



	End If



	Next Loop


	For XCoord = 0 to 2

		For YCoord = 0 to 2





			CreateTileEffect(getplayermap(player), xpos+xcoord, ypos+ycoord, Effect, 33, 10, 0, 0)



		Next YCoord



	Next XCoord








	ELSE

	PlayerMessage(Player, strcat("You need ", strcat(str(Cost), " Fort Ammo to continue.")), brightred)
	PlayerWarp(Player, 2114, 1, 1)
	end if

else
playermessage(player, "Your guild does not have special access to the Darkcone Fort.", white)
PlayerWarp(Player, 2114, 1, 1)
end if 

else
playermessage(player, "You are not in a guild.", white)
PlayerWarp(Player, 2114, 1, 1)
end if



END SUB

	Effect = 45

	xPos = random(6)+6

	yPos = random(5)+6


	For Loop = 1 to GetMaxUsers()

			for xCoord = 0 to 2

			for yCoord = 0 to 2

			

				if getplayerx(loop) = xpos +xCoord & getplayery(loop) = ypos + yCoord then

	Next Loop

		Next YCoord



	Next XCoord








	ELSE

	PlayerMessage(Player, strcat("You need ", strcat(str(Cost), " Fort Ammo to continue.")), brightred)

Name=map2114_3_0

Script Source=
Function Main(Player as Long) AS LONG

	dim Cost as Long
	Cost = 6
	
	

	If getplayerguild(player) = getflag(186) & getflag(185) > 0 then		
		If HasObj(Player, 421) >= Cost then
			PlayerWarp(Player, 2114, 4, 0)
			TakeObj(Player, 421, cost)
			spawnmonster(2114,401,6,10)
			MapMessage(2114, "Fort Berzerker yells, ''I obey only the true Fort Commander!''", grey)
			playermessage(player, "Beware. When given the opportunity, he will attack anyone.", brightred)
		else 
			playermessage(player, "You need 6 Fort Ammo to summon a Berzerker.", white)
			PlayerWarp(Player, 2114, 4, 0)
		end if
	else

Function Main(Player as Long) AS LONG
dim Map as Long, X as Long, Y as Long
Dim a as long
a = random(6)



select case a
case 0
Attackplayer(player, player, 30)
playerwarp(player, 2117, 10, 6)
case 1
Attackplayer(player, player, 30)
playerwarp(player, 2117, 8, 8)
case 2

playerwarp(player, 2117, 5, 10)
case 3
Attackplayer(player, player, 30)
playerwarp(player, 2117, 2, 7)
case 4
Attackplayer(player, player, 30)
playerwarp(player, 2117, 4, 3)
case 5
Attackplayer(player, player, 30)
playerwarp(player, 2117, 7, 3)
case 6
Attackplayer(player, player, 30)
playerwarp(player, 2117, 6, 6)

case else
end select

Map = GetPlayerMap(Player)

For X = 3 To 8
	For Y = 3 To 8
		If Random(3) = 0 Then
			CreateTileEffect(Map, X, Y, Random(70) + 1, 40 + Random(20), 8, Random(2), 0)
		End If
	Next Y
Next X




main = continue


End Function

GiveObj(Player, 609, 1)
case 1
playerwarp(player, 2119, 6, 7)
GiveObj(Player, 614, 1)
case 2
playerwarp(player, 2119, 6, 7)
GiveObj(Player, 615, 1)
case 3
playerwarp(player, 2119, 6, 7)
GiveObj(Player, 617, 1)


case else
end select




main = continue


End Function

Name=map2131_0_1

Script Source=
SUB Main(Player AS LONG)
	Dim A As Long
	Dim B As Long
	B = 0
	For A = 1 to GetMaxUsers
		If GetPlayerMap(A) = 2132 Then
			B = A
		End If
	Next A
	
	If B > 0 Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, StrCat(GetPlayerName(B), " is already in the treasure room!"), BRIGHTRED)
		PlayerWarp(Player, 2131, 1, 1)
	Else
		ResetMap(2132)
		PlayerWarp(Player, 2132, 5, 6)
		GivePlayerExp(Player, 50000)
		GivePlayerExp(Player, 50000)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You receive 100k experience for completing Hero's Quest!", White)
	End If
END SUB

Script Source=
Function main(player as long) as long
dim a as long, b as long
b = getplayeragility(player) + getplayerendurance(player) + 5
a = random(b)

if a <= 15 then
playermessage(player,"You attempt to jump the crevice but miss! You fall to your doom. Or a scorpion pit! Be careful.",white)
setplayerhp(player,1)
setplayerenergy(player,1)
playerwarp(player,232, 6, 10)
main = stop
exit function
end if

if a >= 16 then
playermessage(player,"You attempt to jump the crevice and make it across! Good job.",white)
playerwarp(player,231, 10, 7)
main = stop
exit function
end if


end function

end if

playermessage(player,"You already planted an explosive here!",white)
main = stop
exit function
end if

if hasobj(player,351) >0 then
takeobj(player,351,1)
playermessage(player,"You plant an explosive on the wall base. [6 Remaining]",white)
setplayerflag(player,10,11)
else
playermessage(player,"You need explosives!",white)
end if
end if

end function

SUB Main(Player AS LONG)
	Dim A as Long
	For A = 1 To GetMaxUsers
		If IsPlaying(A) Then
			If GetPlayerMap(A) = 305 Then
				If GetPlayerX(A) = 7 & GetPlayerY(A) = 1 Then
					PlayerWarp(A, 305, 10, 2)
				End If
			End If
		End If
	Next A
	
	PlayerWarp(Player, 305, 1, 2)
END SUB

Name=MAP320_8_3

Script Source=
SUB Main(Player AS LONG)
   If GetPlayerLevel(Player) = 1 & GetPlayerExperience(Player) = 0 Then
      If GetPlayerClass(Player) = 1 Then
         Dim A as Long
         For A = 1 to 510
            If HasObj(Player, A) Then
               PlayerMessage(Player, "You cannot bring anything into Capture the Flag!", WHITE)
               PlayerWarp(Player, 1, 5, 5)
               Exit Sub
            End If
         Next A
         SetPlayerFlag(Player, 10, 1)
         PlayerMessage(Player, "Welcome to Capture the Flag!", WHITE)
         PlayerWarp(Player, 79, 5, 5)
      Else
         PlayerMessage(Player, "You must be a Knight to enter Capture the Flag!", WHITE)
         PlayerWarp(Player, 1, 5, 5)
      End If
   Else
      PlayerMessage(Player, "You must be level 1 to enter Capture the Flag!", WHITE)
      PlayerWarp(Player, 1, 5, 5)
   End If
END SUB

Name=map342_4_4

Script Source=
FUNCTION Main(Player AS LONG) AS LONG
dim a as long, b as long, c as long

if hasobj(player,288) then
goto ok
else

a = hasobj(player,198) + hasobj(player,41) + hasobj(player,99)

   If a > 5 Then
   PlayerMessage(player, "You can not carry more than five ration items!", grey)
      TakeObj(Player, 41, 1)
      TakeObj(Player, 41, 1)
      TakeObj(Player, 41, 1)
Main = Stop
      Exit Function
   Else
      Main = Continue
   End If
end if

ok:
main = continue
END FUNCTION

Name=map355_9_9

Script Source=
Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim Loop as Long

PlayerWarp(Player, 355, 9, 8)
If GetPlayerGuild(Player) > 0 Then
	If HasObj(Player, 393) Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You are already holding an Artifact.", Grey)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
		If HasObj(Loop, 389) Then
			PlayerMessage(Player, "The Candle has been taken.", Grey)
			Exit Sub
		End If
	Next Loop
	If RunScript1("Invent", Player) = 1 Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "Your inventory is full.", Grey)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	GlobalMessage(strcat(GetPlayerName(Player), " has picked up the Dragonia Candle!"), Yellow)
	GiveObj(Player, 389, 1)
	For Loop = 0 To 80
		If GetObjNum(355, Loop) = 389 Then DestroyObject(355, Loop)
	Next Loop
Else
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must be Guilded to handle this Artifact.", Grey)
End If

End Sub

Name=map447_3_2

Script Source=
Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim Cost as Long
Cost = 3000
PlayerWarp(Player, 447, 3, 3)

If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 109) = 0 Then
	If HasObj(Player, 6) >= Cost Then
		TakeObj(Player, 6, Cost)
		SetPlayerEnergy(Player, GetPlayerMaxEnergy(Player))
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You take a drink and are restored to full Energy!", White)
		SetPlayerFlag(Player, 109, 1)
		Timer(Player, 3, "PushTimer")
		SetFlag(111, GetFlag(111) + Cost) 'Gold Collected
	Else
		PlayerMessage(Player, strcat("Dragonian Miner says, ''That'll cost you ", strcat(str(Cost), " Gold.''")), Grey)
	End If
End If

End Sub

Sub Main(Player as long)

	Dim B As Long

	For A = 1 to GetMaxUsers
		If GetPlayerMap(A) = 553 Then
			B = A
		End If
	Next A
	
	If B > 0 Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, StrCat(GetPlayerName(B), " is already in the treasure room!"), BRIGHTRED)
		PlayerWarp(Player, 552, 11, 2)
	Else
		ResetMap(553)
		PlayerWarp(Player, 553, 5, 6)
	End If
End Sub

Name=map559_3_6

Script Source=
Sub Main(player as long)

If getflag(11) = 0 then
playermessage(player,"The Orb does not react to your touch!",white)
exit sub
end if

If getflag(11) = 1 then
playermessage(player, "The light from the Orb goes out, you guessed correctly. You have 3 orbs left.",white)
setflag(11,2)
CreateTileEffect(559,3,6, 2, 1,8,1,0)
exit sub
else
playermessage(player, "The four orbs spark and the room shakes, you have guessed wrong. The trap is triggered!",white)
spawnmonster(getplayermap(player),242,6,6,1)
setflag(11,0)
CreateTileEffect(559,3,6, 7, 1,8,4,0)
CreateTileEffect(559,4,6, 7, 1,8,2,5)
CreateTileEffect(559,5,6, 7, 1,8,2,0)

CreateTileEffect(559,6,3, 7, 1,8,4,0)
CreateTileEffect(559,6,4, 7, 1,8,2,0)
CreateTileEffect(559,6,5, 7, 1,8,2,0)

CreateTileEffect(559,9,6, 7, 1,8,4,0)
CreateTileEffect(559,8,6, 7, 1,8,2,0)
CreateTileEffect(559,7,6, 7, 1,8,2,0)

CreateTileEffect(559,6,7, 7, 1,8,2,0)
CreateTileEffect(559,6,8, 7, 1,8,2,0)
CreateTileEffect(559,6,9, 7, 1,8,4,0)

CreateTileEffect(559,6,6, 1, 1,8,3,0)
exit sub
end if

End Sub

Name=map585_9_4

Script Source=
Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim ObjNum as Long, ObjVal as Long, Level as Long
ObjNum = GetPlayerFlag(Player, 46)
ObjVal = GetPlayerFlag(Player, 47)

If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 242) = 0 Then 'Not Started
	PlayerMessage(Player, "Trapper Joe says, ''Hello Friend. Have you time to help in an errand?''", Yellow)
	PlayerMessage(Player, "1. Sure, how can I help?", DarkGrey)
	PlayerMessage(Player, "2. My time is worth more than pity errands.", DarkGrey)
	Exit Sub
End If
If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 242) = 1 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "Trapper Joe says, ''Thank you so much Friend. I have an old pelt that my grandfather skinned as a boy. It is falling to pieces. Please take it to the Elvish Tanner in Alephvale, to the North of Greystone Peaks. He will restore it's beauty.''", Yellow)
	PlayerMessage(Player, "1. I can manage that.", DarkGrey)
	PlayerMessage(Player, "2. Hmm, maybe I'm busier than I thought. I'll pass.", DarkGrey)
	Exit Sub
End If
If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 242) = 2 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "Trapper Joe says, ''How goes the errand Friend?''", Yellow)
	PlayerMessage(Player, "1. Fine, I'll be done in no time.", DarkGrey)
	PlayerMessage(Player, "2. Where was it I was to take the pelt to again?", DarkGrey)
	PlayerMessage(Player, "3. I've...lost your pelt... my bad.", DarkGrey)
	Exit Sub
End If
If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 242) = 3 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "Trapper Joe says, ''How goes the errand Friend?''", Yellow)
	PlayerMessage(Player, "1. I've taken the pelt to Velatre and he's made a jacket for you!", DarkGrey)
	PlayerMessage(Player, "2. Where was it I was to take the pelt to again?", DarkGrey)
	PlayerMessage(Player, "3. I've...lost your pelt... my bad.", DarkGrey)
	Exit Sub
End If
If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 242) = 4 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "Trapper Joe says, ''How goes the errand Friend?''", Yellow)
	PlayerMessage(Player, "1. I'm still tracking down the Wizard.", DarkGrey)
	PlayerMessage(Player, "2. Where was it I was to take the jacket to again?", DarkGrey)
	PlayerMessage(Player, "3. I've...lost your pelt... my bad.", DarkGrey)
	Exit Sub
End If
If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 242) = 5 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "Trapper Joe says, ''How goes the errand Friend?''", Yellow)
	PlayerMessage(Player, "1. The Wizard has enchanted your jacket.", DarkGrey)
	PlayerMessage(Player, "2. Where was it I was to take the jacket to again?", DarkGrey)
	PlayerMessage(Player, "3. I've...lost your pelt... my bad.", DarkGrey)
	Exit Sub
End If

If ObjNum = 0 Then	'No Current Task
	If GetPlayerLevel(Player) < 40 Then Level = 4
	If GetPlayerLevel(Player) > 39 & GetPlayerLevel(Player) < 60 Then Level = 6
	If GetPlayerLevel(Player) > 59 Then Level = 8
		Select Case Random(Level)
			Case 0
				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 46, 76)
				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 47, Random(21) + 10)
			Case 1
				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 46, 127)
				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 47, Random(21) + 10)
			Case 2
				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 46, 78)
				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 47, Random(21) + 10)
			Case 3
				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 46, 307)
				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 47, Random(11) + 10)
			Case 4
				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 46, 151)
				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 47, Random(21) + 10)
			Case 5
				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 46, 354)
				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 47, 1)
			Case 6
				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 46, 167)
				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 47, Random(5) + 1)
			Case 7
				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 46, 355)
				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 47, 1)
		End Select
	PlayerMessage(Player, strcat("Trapper Joe says, ''Could I bother you for a favour friend? Would you find me ", strcat(str(GetPlayerFlag(Player, 47)), strcat(" ", strcat(GetObjectName(GetPlayerFlag(Player, 46)), "s?''")))), White)
Else
	If HasObj(Player, ObjNum) >= ObjVal Then	'Task Complete
		TakeObj(Player, ObjNum, ObjVal)
		SetPlayerFlag(Player, 46, 0)
		SetPlayerFlag(Player, 47, 0)
		SetPlayerFlag(Player, 244, GetPlayerFlag(Player, 244) + 1)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You successfully complete the task!", BrightGreen)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "Trapper Joe says, ''Thank you so much friend.''", White)
		If GetPlayerLevel(Player) < 80 Then
			Select Case ObjNum
				Case 76
					GivePlayerExp(Player, 10000)
					PlayerMessage(Player, "You receive 10k Experience!", Green)
				Case 127
					GivePlayerExp(Player, 15000)
					PlayerMessage(Player, "You receive 15k Experience!", Green)
				Case 78
					GivePlayerExp(Player, 20000)
					PlayerMessage(Player, "You receive 20k Experience!", Green)
				Case 307
					GivePlayerExp(Player, 25000)
					PlayerMessage(Player, "You receive 25k Experience!", Green)
				Case 151
					GivePlayerExp(Player, 35000)
					PlayerMessage(Player, "You receive 35k Experience!", Green)
				Case 354
					GivePlayerExp(Player, 50000)
					PlayerMessage(Player, "You receive 50k Experience!", Green)
				Case 167
					GivePlayerExp(Player, 70000)
					PlayerMessage(Player, "You receive 70k Experience!", Green)
				Case 355
					GivePlayerExp(Player, 100000)
					PlayerMessage(Player, "You receive 100k Experience!", Green)
			End Select
		Else
			Select Case ObjNum
				Case 354
					GiveObj(Player, 6, 50000)
					PlayerMessage(Player, "You receive 50k Gold!", Green)
				Case 167
					GiveObj(Player, 6, 50000)
					PlayerMessage(Player, "You receive 50k Gold!", Green)
				Case 355
					GiveObj(Player, 6, 60000)
					PlayerMessage(Player, "You receive 60k Gold!", Green)
			End Select
		End If
	Else 'Task Incomplete
		SetPlayerFlag(Player, 47, ObjVal - HasObj(Player, ObjNum))
		TakeObj(Player, ObjNum, HasObj(Player, ObjNum))
		PlayerMessage(Player, strcat("Trapper Joe says, ''Thank you friend, but I still require ", strcat(str(GetPlayerFlag(Player, 47)), strcat(" ", strcat(GetObjectName(ObjNum), "s.''")))), White)
	End If
End If

End Sub

		CreateMapFloatText(587, GetMonsterX(587, 0), GetMonsterY(587, 0), "Your home is where you lay your head", White)
		SetPlayerFlag(Player, 109, 1)
		Timer(Player, 6, "PushTimer")

	PlayerWarp(Player, 587, 6, 7)

End If

Select Case GetGuildHall(GetPlayerGuild(Player))
	Case 0
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You must own a Guild Hall to use this warp.", White)
		If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 109) = 0 Then

Name=map595_7_5

Script Source=
Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim ObjNum as Long, Level as Long
ObjNum = GetPlayerFlag(Player, 48)

If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 240) = 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "Manny Farmer says, ''Hey Kid, look lively. I need a new bucket for milking my cows. Head up to the Crafter in Northcoast and get me a new one would ye?''", Yellow)
	PlayerMessage(Player, "1. Ehh, ok...sir!", DarkGrey)
	PlayerMessage(Player, "2. Manners don't cost a thing.", DarkGrey)
	Exit Sub
End If
If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 240) > 0 & GetPlayerFlag(Player, 240) < 5 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "Manny Farmer says, ''Have you got that bucket for us yet Kid?''", Yellow)
	PlayerMessage(Player, "1. I'm on it.", DarkGrey)
	PlayerMessage(Player, "2. Where was I meant to get the bucket from again?", DarkGrey)
	Exit Sub
End If
If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 240) = 5 Then
	If HasObj(Player, 466) Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "Manny Farmer says, ''You got my bucket! Good lad! Would you mind milking my cows though? They're in desperate need of it.''", Yellow)
		Exit Sub
	Else
		PlayerMessage(Player, "Manny Farmer says, ''Hey Kid, look lively. I need a new bucket for milking my cows. Head up to the Crafter in Northcoast and get me a new one would ye?''", Yellow)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "1. Ehh, ok...sir!", DarkGrey)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "2. Manners don't cost a thing.", DarkGrey)
		Exit Sub
	End If
End If
If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 240) = 6 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "Manny Farmer says, ''Thank you my lad. If ever you're in need of a good meal you just see the wife alright?", Yellow)
	TakeObj(Player, 464, 1)
	SetPlayerFlag(Player, 240, 7)
	'COMPLETED ERRAND OMG
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You have completed Manny Farmer's Errand!", BrightGreen)
	If GetPlayerLevel(Player) < 80 Then
		GivePlayerExp(Player, 20000)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You have gained 20k experience!", Green)
	Else
		GiveObj(Player, 6, 100000)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You have received 100k Gold Coins!", Green)
	End If
	Exit Sub
End If

If ObjNum = 0 Then	'No Current Task
	If GetPlayerLevel(Player) < 40 Then Level = 3
	If GetPlayerLevel(Player) > 39 & GetPlayerLevel(Player) < 60 Then Level = 5
	If GetPlayerLevel(Player) > 59 Then Level = 6
		Select Case Random(Level)
			Case 0
				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 48, 48)	'Sushi
			Case 1
				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 48, 113)	'Fruit
			Case 2
				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 48, 69)	'Marshroom
			Case 3
				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 48, 103)	'Carrot
			Case 4
				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 48, 198)	'Cookie
			Case 5
				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 48, 41)	'Candy Apple
		End Select
	PlayerMessage(Player, strcat("Manny Farmer says, ''Looking to make yourself useful kid? Go bring me a ", strcat(GetObjectName(GetPlayerFlag(Player, 48)), ".''")), White)
Else
	If HasObj(Player, ObjNum) Then	'Task Complete
		TakeObj(Player, ObjNum, 1)
		SetPlayerFlag(Player, 48, 0)
		SetPlayerFlag(Player, 244, GetPlayerFlag(Player, 244) + 1)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You successfully complete the errand!", BrightGreen)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "Manny Farmer says, ''Cheers for that kid.''", White)
		If GetPlayerLevel(Player) < 80 Then
			Select Case ObjNum
				Case 48
					GivePlayerExp(Player, 10000)
					PlayerMessage(Player, "You received 10k Experience!", Green)
				Case 113
					GivePlayerExp(Player, 20000)
					PlayerMessage(Player, "You received 20k Experience!", Green)
				Case 69
					GivePlayerExp(Player, 30000)
					PlayerMessage(Player, "You received 30k Experience!", Green)
				Case 103
					GivePlayerExp(Player, 40000)
					PlayerMessage(Player, "You received 40k Experience!", Green)
				Case 198
					GivePlayerExp(Player, 50000)
					PlayerMessage(Player, "You received 50k Experience!", Green)
				Case 41
					GivePlayerExp(Player, 50000)
					GivePlayerExp(Player, 10000)
					PlayerMessage(Player, "You received 60k Experience!", Green)
			End Select
		Else
			Select Case ObjNum
				Case 198
					GiveObj(Player, 6, 50000)
					PlayerMessage(Player, "You received 50k Gold!", Green)
				Case 41
					GiveObj(Player, 6, 60000)
					PlayerMessage(Player, "You received 60k Gold!", Green)
			End Select
		End If
	Else 'Task Incomplete
		PlayerMessage(Player, strcat("Manny Farmer says, ''You found that ", strcat(GetObjectName(GetPlayerFlag(Player, 48)), " yet kid?''")), White)
	End If
End If

End Sub

Name=map603_5_9

Script Source=
Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim Loop as Long

CreateTileEffect(603, 0, 2, 11, 40, 8, 0, 0)
CreateTileEffect(603, 2, 2, 11, 40, 8, 0, 0)
CreateTileEffect(603, 2, 4, 11, 40, 8, 0, 0)
CreateTileEffect(603, 3, 7, 11, 40, 8, 0, 0)
CreateTileEffect(603, 5, 2, 11, 40, 8, 0, 0)
CreateTileEffect(603, 5, 7, 11, 40, 8, 0, 0)
CreateTileEffect(603, 7, 4, 11, 40, 8, 0, 0)
CreateTileEffect(603, 7, 9, 11, 40, 8, 0, 0)
CreateTileEffect(603, 9, 4, 11, 40, 8, 0, 0)
CreateTileEffect(603, 9, 8, 11, 40, 8, 0, 0)
CreateTileEffect(603, 9, 11, 11, 40, 8, 0, 0)
CreateTileEffect(603, 11, 9, 11, 40, 8, 0, 0)

For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
	If GetPlayerMap(Loop) = 603 Then
		If GetTileAtt(603, GetPlayerX(Loop), GetPlayerY(Loop)) = 5 Then
			MagicAttackPlayer(Player, Loop, 10)
		End If
	End If
Next Loop

End Sub

Name=map635_5_0

Script Source=
Function main(player as long) as long
Dim a as long
a = random(4)
setflag(102, 1)
if hasobj(player,426) then
takeobj(player, 426, 1)
runscript0("spawnnymph1")
end if
select case a
case 0
playerwarp(player, 1560, 5, 9)
case 1
playerwarp(player, 1560, 2, 5)
case 2
playerwarp(player, 1560, 6, 2)
case 3
playerwarp(player, 1560, 9, 6)
case else
end select
main = continue
End Function

Name=map70_1_6

Script Source=
Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim Loop as Long

PlayerWarp(Player, 70, 2, 6)

If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 11) = 1 Then	'Red Team
	For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
		If IsPlaying(Loop) Then
			If HasObj(Loop, 508) Then
				PlayerMessage(Player, "The Red Flag has been taken! You must return it!", White)
				Exit Sub
			End If
		End If
	Next Loop
	If HasObj(Player, 509) Then	'Has Blue Flag
		RunScript1("CTFRedScore", Player)
	Else
		PlayerMessage(Player, "This is your Flag.", White)
	End If
End If
If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 11) = 2 Then	'Blue Team
	For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
		If IsPlaying(Loop) Then
			If HasObj(Loop, 508) Then
				PlayerMessage(Player, "The Red Flag has been taken!", White)
				Exit Sub
			End If
		End If
	Next Loop
	If RunScript1("Invent", Player) = 1 Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "Your inventory is full.", Grey)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	GlobalMessage(strcat(GetPlayerName(Player), " has picked up the Red Flag!"), BrightBlue)
	GiveObj(Player, 508, 1)
	SetFlag(181, 0)
	Timer(Player, 2, "FlagTimer")
	For Loop = 0 To 80
		If GetObjNum(70, Loop) = 508 Then DestroyObject(70, Loop)
	Next Loop
End If

End Sub

Name=map78_10_6

Script Source=
Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim Loop as Long

PlayerWarp(Player, 78, 9, 6)

If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 11) = 2 Then	'Blue Team
	For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
		If IsPlaying(Loop) Then
			If HasObj(Loop, 509) Then
				PlayerMessage(Player, "The Blue Flag has been taken! You must return it!", White)
				Exit Sub
			End If
		End If
	Next Loop
	If HasObj(Player, 508) Then	'Has Red Flag
		RunScript1("CTFBlueScore", Player)
	Else
		PlayerMessage(Player, "This is your Flag.", White)
	End If
End If
If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 11) = 1 Then	'Red Team
	For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
		If IsPlaying(Loop) Then
			If HasObj(Loop, 509) Then
				PlayerMessage(Player, "The Blue Flag has been taken!", White)
				Exit Sub
			End If
		End If
	Next Loop
	If RunScript1("Invent", Player) = 1 Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "Your inventory is full.", Grey)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	GlobalMessage(strcat(GetPlayerName(Player), " has picked up the Blue Flag!"), BrightRed)
	GiveObj(Player, 509, 1)
	Timer(Player, 2, "FlagTimer")
	SetFlag(182, 0)
	For Loop = 0 To 80
		If GetObjNum(78, Loop) = 509 Then DestroyObject(78, Loop)
	Next Loop
End If

End Sub

Name=map813_6_11

Script Source=
SUB Main(Player AS LONG)
	Dim A As Long, B As Long
	B = 0
	For A = 1 to GetMaxUsers
		If GetPlayerMap(A) = 814 Then
			B = A
		End If
	Next A

	If B > 0 Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, StrCat(GetPlayerName(B), " is already in the treasure room!"), BRIGHTRED)
		PlayerWarp(Player, 813, 6, 10)
	Else
		ResetMap(814)
		PlayerWarp(Player, 814, 6, 0)
	End If
	
End Sub

Function Main(Player as Long) AS LONG

If GetPlayerEquipped(Player, 1) = 463 Then	''Staff
	If HasObj(Player, 78) >= 30 Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You drop the Scorpian Stings into the water and dip the staff. Suddenly there is a great flash as your staff is imbued with ancient power!", White)
		TakeObj(Player, 78, 30)
		SetEquippedItemPrefix(Player, 1, 44)
		SetEquippedItemSuffix(Player, 1, 249)
		CreateCharacterEffect(GetPlayerMap(Player), Player, 40, 40, 8, 0, 0)
		PlayerWarp(Player, 850, 3, 8)
	Else
		PlayerMessage(Player, "To imbue this staff it is required that the water be amalgamated with the Stings of Scorpians.", White)
	End If
Else
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You require a staff to imbue.", Grey)
End If

PlayerWarp(Player, 850, 3, 8)

End Function

Name=map898_1_4

Script Source=
SUB Main(Player AS LONG)
	Dim A As Long, B As Long
	B = 0
	For A = 1 to GetMaxUsers
		If GetPlayerMap(A) = 748 Then
			B = A
		End If
	Next A
	
	If B > 0 Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, StrCat(GetPlayerName(B), " is already in the treasure room!"), BRIGHTRED)
		PlayerWarp(Player, 898, 2, 4)
	Else
		ResetMap(748)
		PlayerWarp(Player, 748, 6, 6)
	End If
END SUB

FUNCTION Main(player AS LONG) AS LONG
 Dim Intelligence AS LONG,Strength AS LONG,Agility AS LONG,Endurance AS LONG
 Dim Guild AS LONG,Name AS STRING,Level AS LONG
 Dim Map AS LONG,X AS LONG,Y AS LONG
 Dim Class AS LONG,Status AS LONG
 Dim HP AS LONG,Energy AS LONG,Mana AS LONG
 Dim BA AS LONG,BB AS LONG,BC AS LONG
 Dim VALUA AS LONG, VALUB AS LONG, VALUC AS LONG

   Intelligence = Getplayerintelligence(player)
   Strength = GetplayerStrength(player)
   Agility = Getplayeragility(player)
   Endurance = Getplayerendurance(player)

   Guild = Getplayerguild(player)
   Name = Getplayername(player)
   Level = Getplayerlevel(player)
 
   Map = Getplayermap(player)
   X = GetplayerX(player)
   Y = GetplayerY(player)

   Class = Getplayerclass(player)
   Status = Getplayerstatus(player)
 
   HP = GetplayerHP(player)
   Energy = Getplayerenergy(player)
   Mana = Getplayermana(player)


 If HasObj(player, 249) >= 1 Then

  Takeobj(player, 249, 1)

    BA = Random(5)

      If BA = 0 Then
       playermessage(player, "Slot Machine: JOKER", yellow)
       VALUA = 0
      End If
      If BA = 1 Then
       playermessage(player, "Slot Machine: ORANGE", yellow)
       VALUA = 1
      End If
      If BA = 2 Then
       playermessage(player, "Slot Machine: APPLE", yellow)
       VALUA = 2
      End If
      If BA = 3 Then
       playermessage(player, "Slot Machine: BAR", yellow)
       VALUA = 3
      End If
      If BA = 4 Then
       playermessage(player, "Slot Machine: MEDUSA", yellow)
       VALUA = 4
      End If
      If BA = 5 Then
       playermessage(player, "Slot Machine: COIN", yellow)
       VALUA = 5
      End If

    BB = Random(5)

      If BB = 0 Then
       playermessage(player, "Slot Machine: JOKER", yellow)
       VALUB = 0
      End If
      If BB = 1 Then
       playermessage(player, "Slot Machine: ORANGE", yellow)
       VALUB = 1
      End If
      If BB = 2 Then
       playermessage(player, "Slot Machine: APPLE", yellow)
       VALUB = 2
      End If
      If BB = 3 Then
       playermessage(player, "Slot Machine: BAR", yellow)
       VALUB = 3
      End If
      If BB = 4 Then
       playermessage(player, "Slot Machine: MEDUSA", yellow)
       VALUB = 4
      End If
      If BB = 5 Then
       playermessage(player, "Slot Machine: COIN", yellow)
       VALUB = 5
      End If

    BC = Random(5)

      If BC = 0 Then
       playermessage(player, "Slot Machine: JOKER", yellow)
       VALUC = 0
      End If
      If BC = 1 Then
       playermessage(player, "Slot Machine: ORANGE", yellow)
       VALUC = 1
      End If
      If BC = 2 Then
       playermessage(player, "Slot Machine: APPLE", yellow)
       VALUC = 2
      End If
      If BC = 3 Then
       playermessage(player, "Slot Machine: BAR", yellow)
       VALUC = 3
      End If
      If BC = 4 Then
       playermessage(player, "Slot Machine: MEDUSA", yellow)
       VALUC = 4
      End If
      If BC = 5 Then
       playermessage(player, "Slot Machine: COIN", yellow)
       VALUC = 5
      End If

   If VALUA <> VALUB | VALUB <> VALUC | VALUC <> VALUA | VALUA <> VALUC | VALUC <> VALUB | VALUB <> VALUA Then
    playermessage(player, "You lose!", brown)
   End If

   If VALUA = 0 & VALUB = 0 & VALUC = 0 Then
    playermessage(player, "You Win! -<JOKER>- 5 Elitist Coins aquired!", brightred)
    Giveobj(player, 249, 5)
   End If

   If VALUA = 1 & VALUB = 1 & VALUC = 1 Then
    playermessage(player, "You Win! -<ORANGE>- 10 Elitist Coins aquired!", brightred)
    Giveobj(player, 249, 10)
   End If

   If VALUA = 2 & VALUB = 2 & VALUC = 2 Then
    playermessage(player, "You Win! -<APPLE>- 20 Elitist Coins aquired!", brightred)
    Giveobj(player, 249, 20)
   End If

   If VALUA = 3 & VALUB = 3 & VALUC = 3 Then
    playermessage(player, "You Win! -<BAR>- 30 Elitist Coins aquired!", brightred)
    Giveobj(player, 249, 30)
   End If

   If VALUA = 4 & VALUB = 4 & VALUC = 4 Then
    playermessage(player, "You Win! -<MEDUSA>- 40 Elitist Coins aquired!", brightred)
    Giveobj(player, 249, 40)
   End If

   If VALUA = 5 & VALUB = 5 & VALUC = 5 Then
    playermessage(player, "You Win! -<COIN>- 50 Elitist Coins aquired!", brightred)
    Giveobj(player, 249, 50)
   End If

 End If

	Dim B As Long

		If GetPlayerMap(A) = 983 Then
			B = A
		End If
	Next A

	Else

	End If
END SUB

Script Source=
FUNCTION Main(Player AS LONG, Message AS String) AS LONG
	If StrCmp(Message, "info") Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "The Frost Wizard tells you, ''I can enchant your items for 30,000 gold coins.  There is no telling what the enchantment will do, and it costs 5,000 gold to remove it.  I can enchant all sorts of things!  To enchant an item, simply say 'enchant' followed by 'weapon', 'helm', 'armor' or 'shield'. The item must be equipped.  If you want to remove an enchantment, say purge followed by weapon, armor, shield, or helm.''", Grey)
	End If
	
	Dim EnchantCost As Long
	EnchantCost = 30000
	if strcmp(message,"enchant weapon") then
	   If HasObj(Player, 6) >= EnchantCost Then
		  If GetEquippedItemPrefix(Player, 1) = 0 Then
			 TakeObj(Player, 6, EnchantCost)
			 Dim Prefix As Long
			 Prefix = Random(8) + 1

			 Dim PrefixID As Long
			 Select Case Prefix
				Case 1
				   PrefixID = 1
				Case 2
				   PrefixID = 11
				Case 3
				   PrefixID = 21
				Case 4
				   PrefixID = 31
				Case 5
				   PrefixID = 41
				Case 6
				   PrefixID = 51
				Case 7
				   PrefixID = 61
				Case 8
				   PrefixID = 71
				Case Else
				   GlobalMessage("Enchanting error!", BRIGHTRED)
			 End Select
			 SetEquippedItemPrefix(Player, 1, PrefixID)
			 PlayerMessage(player, StrCat(StrCat("The Frost Wizard says, ''I have given your item the enchantment ", GetPrefixName(PrefixID)), ".''"),grey)
		  Else
			 PlayerMessage(player, "The Frost Wizard says, ''That item has already been enchanted!''",grey)
		  End If
	   Else
		  PlayerMessage(player, "The Frost Wizard says, ''You don't have enough money!  You need 2,000 gold to enchant.''",grey)
	   End If
	end if

	   End If

			 PlayerMessage(player, StrCat(StrCat("The Frost Wizard says, ''I have given your item the enchantment ", GetPrefixName(PrefixID)), ".''"),grey)
		  Else
			 PlayerMessage(player, "The Frost Wizard says, ''That item has already been enchanted!''",grey)
		  End If
	   Else
		  PlayerMessage(player, "The Frost Wizard says, ''You don't have enough money!  You need 2,000 gold to enchant.''",grey)
	   End If
	end if
	
	Dim PurgeCost as Long
	PurgeCost = 5000
	if strcmp(message,"purge shield") then
	   If HasObj(Player, 6) >= PurgeCost Then
		  If GetEquippedItemPrefix(Player, 2) > 0 Then
			 TakeObj(Player, 6, PurgeCost)
			 SetEquippedItemPrefix(Player, 2, 0)
			 PlayerMessage(player, "The Frost Wizard says, ''I have purged your item of it's magic.''",grey)
		  Else
			 PlayerMessage(player, "The Frost Wizard says, ''I cannot purge that item, because it has no magic power.''",grey)
		  End If
	   Else
		  PlayerMessage(player, "The Frost Wizard says, ''You don't have enough money!  You need 5,000 gold to purge.''",grey)
	   End If
	end if

	if strcmp(message,"purge weapon") then
	   If HasObj(Player, 6) >= PurgeCost Then
		  If GetEquippedItemPrefix(Player, 1) > 0 Then
				If GetPlayerequipped(player,1) < 180 | GetPlayerequipped(player,1) > 192 then
					TakeObj(Player, 6, PurgeCost)
					SetEquippedItemPrefix(Player, 1, 0)
					PlayerMessage(player, "The Frost Wizard says, ''I have purged your item of it's magic.''",grey)
				Else
				 PlayerMessage(player, "The Frost Wizard says, ''I cannot purge Arcticite weapons, fool.''", grey)
			  End If
			Else
			 PlayerMessage(player, "The Frost Wizard says, ''I cannot purge that item, because it has no magic power.''",grey)
		  End If
	   Else
		  PlayerMessage(player, "The Frost Wizard says, ''You don't have enough money!  You need 5,000 gold to purge.''",grey)
	   End If
	end if

	if strcmp(message,"purge armor") then
	   If HasObj(Player, 6) >= PurgeCost Then
		  If GetEquippedItemPrefix(Player, 3) > 0 Then
			 TakeObj(Player, 6, PurgeCost)
			 SetEquippedItemPrefix(Player, 3, 0)
			 PlayerMessage(player, "The Frost Wizard says, ''I have purged your item of it's magic.''",grey)
		  Else
			 PlayerMessage(player, "The Frost Wizard says, ''I cannot purge that item, because it has no magic power.''",grey)
		  End If
	   Else
		  PlayerMessage(player, "The Frost Wizard says, ''You don't have enough money!  You need 5,000 gold to purge.''",grey)
	   End If
	end if

	if strcmp(message,"purge helm") then
	   If HasObj(Player, 6) >= PurgeCost Then
		  If GetEquippedItemPrefix(Player, 4) > 0 Then
			 TakeObj(Player, 6, PurgeCost)
			 SetEquippedItemPrefix(Player, 4, 0)
			 PlayerMessage(player, "The Frost Wizard says, ''I have purged your item of it's magic.''",grey)
		  Else
			 PlayerMessage(player, "The Frost Wizard says, ''I cannot purge that item, because it has no magic power.''",grey)
		  End If
	   Else
