FUNCTION Main(Player AS LONG, Message AS String) AS LONG
	Dim ChangeCost AS LONG
	Dim A AS LONG
	ChangeCost = 1000
	If StrCmp(Message, "knight") Then
		For A = 1 to 5
			If GetPlayerEquipped(Player, A) > 0 Then
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You must unequip all your items first!", WHITE)
				Main = Stop
				Exit Function
			End If
		Next A
		If HasObj(Player, 6) >= ChangeCost Then
			TakeObj(Player, 6, ChangeCost)
			SetPlayerClass(Player, 1)
			SetPlayerFlag(Player, 250, 1)
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You are now a venerate Knight!", WHITE)
		Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You do not have enough ancient relics!", WHITE)
		End If
		Main = Stop
		Exit Function
	End If
	
	If StrCmp(Message, "cleric") Then
		For A = 1 to 5
			If GetPlayerEquipped(Player, A) > 0 Then
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You must unequip all your items first!", WHITE)
				Main = Stop
				Exit Function
			End If
		Next A
		If HasObj(Player, 6) >= ChangeCost Then
			TakeObj(Player, 6, ChangeCost)
			SetPlayerClass(Player, 4)
			SetPlayerFlag(Player, 250, 4)
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You are now a venerate Cleric!", WHITE)
		Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You do not have enough ancient relics!", WHITE)
		End If
		Main = Stop
		Exit Function
	End If
	
	If StrCmp(Message, "mage") Then
		For A = 1 to 5
			If GetPlayerEquipped(Player, A) > 0 Then
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You must unequip all your items first!", WHITE)
				Main = Stop
				Exit Function
			End If
		Next A
		If HasObj(Player, 6) >= ChangeCost Then

		Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You do not have enough ancient relics!", WHITE)
		End If
		Main = Stop
		Exit Function
	End If
	
	If StrCmp(Message, "rogue") Then

	EnchantCost = 80000

	   If HasObj(Player, 6) >= EnchantCost Then
		  If GetEquippedItemPrefix(Player, 5) = 0 Then

			 Dim Prefix as Long
			 Dim PrefixID as Long
			 Prefix = Random(8) + 1

			 Select Case Prefix
				Case 1
				   PrefixID = 1
				Case 2
				   PrefixID = 11
				Case 3
				   PrefixID = 21
				Case 4
				   PrefixID = 31
				Case 5
				   PrefixID = 41
				Case 6
				   PrefixID = 51
				Case 7
				   PrefixID = 61
				Case 8
				   PrefixID = 71
				Case Else
				   GlobalMessage("Enchanting error!", BRIGHTRED)
			 End Select
			 SetEquippedItemPrefix(Player, 5, PrefixID)
			 PlayerMessage(player, StrCat(StrCat("Taylor Tailor says, ''I have given your item the enchantment ", GetPrefixName(PrefixID)), ".''"),grey)
		  Else
			 PlayerMessage(player, "Taylor Tailor says, ''That item has already been enchanted!''",grey)
		  End If
	   Else
		  PlayerMessage(player, "Taylor Tailor says, ''You don't have enough money!  You need 2,000 gold to enchant.''",grey)
	   End If
	end if
	
	Dim PurgeCost as Long

Sub Main(Player as Long)

dim Cost5 as Long, Cost6 as Long, Cost7 as Long

Cost1 = 150 - Divide(GetFlag(130), 400) 'Lumber
Cost2 = 150 - Divide(GetFlag(131), 400) 'Coarse Ore
Cost3 = 300 - Divide(GetFlag(132), 160) 'Flawed Ore
Cost4 = 1000 - Divide(GetFlag(133), 20) 'Pure Ore
Cost5 = 150 - Divide(GetFlag(134), 400) 'Small Fish
Cost6 = 300 - Divide(GetFlag(135), 160) 'Medium Fish
Cost7 = 1000 - Divide(GetFlag(136), 20) 'Big Fish
If Cost1 < 75 Then Cost1 = 75
If Cost2 < 75 Then Cost2 = 75
If Cost3 < 150 Then Cost3 = 150
If Cost4 < 500 Then Cost4 = 500
If Cost5 < 75 Then Cost5 = 75
If Cost6 < 150 Then Cost6 = 150
If Cost7 < 500 Then Cost7 = 500

PlayerMessage(Player, "==Skills Market==", Yellow)

PlayerMessage(Player, "Item - Ammount - Buy/Sell Price per item", White)

Name=marketbuy

Script Source=
Sub Main(Player as Long, Item as Long, Ammount as Long)
dim Cost as Long, Flag as Long

Select Case Item
	Case 1 'Lumber
		Item = 215
		Flag = 130
			Cost = 150 - Divide(GetFlag(Flag), 400)
			If Cost < 75 Then Cost = 75
			Cost = Cost * Ammount
	Case 2 'Coarse Ore
		Item = 216
		Flag = 131
			Cost = 150 - Divide(GetFlag(Flag), 400)
			If Cost < 75 Then Cost = 75
			Cost = Cost * Ammount
	Case 3 'Flawed Ore
		Item = 217
		Flag = 132
			Cost = 300 - Divide(GetFlag(Flag), 160)
			If Cost < 150 Then Cost = 150
			Cost = Cost * Ammount
	Case 4 'Pure Ore
		Item = 218
		Flag = 133
			Cost = 1500 - Divide(GetFlag(Flag), 20)
			If Cost < 750 Then Cost = 750
			Cost = Cost * Ammount
	Case 5 'Small Fish
		Item = 153
		Flag = 134
			Cost = 150 - Divide(GetFlag(Flag), 400)
			If Cost < 75 Then Cost = 75
			Cost = Cost * Ammount
	Case 6 'Medium Fish
		Item = 152
		Flag = 135
			Cost = 300 - Divide(GetFlag(Flag), 160)
			If Cost < 150 Then Cost = 150
			Cost = Cost * Ammount
	Case 7 'Big Fish
		Item = 148
		Flag = 136
			Cost = 1500 - Divide(GetFlag(Flag), 20)
			If Cost < 750 Then Cost = 750
			Cost = Cost * Ammount
	Case Else
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You must select which resource you would like to buy.", Grey)
		Exit Sub
End Select

If Ammount = 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, strcat("You must select how much ", strcat(GetObjectName(Item), " you wish to buy.")), Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
If Ammount > GetFlag(Flag) + 1 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, strcat("There is not that much ", strcat(GetObjectName(Item), " for sale.")), Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
If Ammount > 100 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You may only buy in lots upto 100 items.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If

If Cost > HasObj(Player, 6) + 1 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, strcat("You cannot afford that much ", GetObjectName(Item)), Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If

TakeObj(Player, 6, Cost)
GiveObj(Player, Item, Ammount)
SetFlag(Flag, GetFlag(Flag) - Ammount)
PlayerMessage(Player, strcat("You have bought ", strcat(str(Ammount), strcat(" ", GetObjectName(Item)))), White)
RunScript0("refreshmarket")

End Sub

*******************************************************

*******************************************************
Name=marketsell

Script Source=
Sub Main(Player as Long, Item as Long, Ammount as Long)
dim Cost as Long, Flag as Long

Select Case Item
	Case 1 'Lumber
		Item = 215
		Flag = 130
			Cost = 150 - Divide(GetFlag(Flag), 400)
			If Cost < 75 Then Cost = 75
			Cost = Cost - 10
			Cost = Cost * Ammount
	Case 2 'Coarse Ore
		Item = 216
		Flag = 131
			Cost = 150 - Divide(GetFlag(Flag), 400)
			If Cost < 75 Then Cost = 75
			Cost = Cost - 10
			Cost = Cost * Ammount
	Case 3 'Flawed Ore
		Item = 217
		Flag = 132
			Cost = 300 - Divide(GetFlag(Flag), 160)
			If Cost < 150 Then Cost = 150
			Cost = Cost - 50
			Cost = Cost * Ammount
	Case 4 'Pure Ore
		Item = 218
		Flag = 133
			Cost = 1500 - Divide(GetFlag(Flag), 20)
			If Cost < 500 Then Cost = 500
			Cost = Cost - 100
			Cost = Cost * Ammount
	Case 5 'Small Fish
		Item = 153
		Flag = 134
			Cost = 150 - Divide(GetFlag(Flag), 400)
			If Cost < 75 Then Cost = 75
			Cost = Cost - 10
			Cost = Cost * Ammount
	Case 6 'Medium Fish
		Item = 152
		Flag = 135
			Cost = 300 - Divide(GetFlag(Flag), 160)
			If Cost < 150 Then Cost = 150
			Cost = Cost - 50
			Cost = Cost * Ammount
	Case 7 'Big Fish
		Item = 148
		Flag = 136
			Cost = 1500 - Divide(GetFlag(Flag), 40)
			If Cost < 500 Then Cost = 500
			Cost = Cost - 100
			Cost = Cost * Ammount
	Case Else
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You must select which resource you wish to sell.", Grey)
		Exit Sub
End Select

If Ammount = 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, strcat("You must select how much ", strcat(GetObjectName(Item), " you wish to sell.")), Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
If Ammount > HasObj(Player, Item) + 1 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, strcat("You dont have that much ", GetObjectName(Item)), Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If

	PlayerMessage(Player, "You may only sell in lots upto 100 items.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If

GiveObj(Player, 6, Cost)
SetFlag(Flag, GetFlag(Flag) + Ammount)

RunScript0("refreshmarket")

End Sub

Script Source=
SUB Main(Player as LONG,Parm1 as LONG)
'\marketcancel -slotnumber-
'Script by MarsPhoenix with much help by Fankadore
Dim a as LONG,openinvslot as LONG,objectnum as LONG,specialvalue as LONG,prefixnum as LONG,suffixnum as LONG,originalamount as LONG

If strcmp(ReadIniStr("Market",GetPlayerUser(Player),str(Parm1),""), "") Then
   PlayerMessage(Player,"There's nothing in that slot!",BrightRed)
Else
   For openinvslot = 1 to 20
      objectnum = val(ReadIniStr("Market",GetPlayerUser(Player),str(Parm1),"")) - 100000000
      For a = 1 to 10
         If objectnum >= 10000000 Then
            objectnum = objectnum - 10000000
         End If
      Next a
      For a = 1 to 10
         If objectnum >= 1000000 Then
            objectnum = objectnum - 1000000
         End If
      Next a
      For a = 1 to 10
         If objectnum >= 100000 Then
            objectnum = objectnum - 100000
         End If
      Next a
      For a = 1 to 10
         If objectnum >= 10000 Then
            objectnum = objectnum - 10000
         End If
      Next a
      For a = 1 to 10
         If objectnum >= 1000 Then
            objectnum = objectnum - 1000
         End If
      Next a
         If GetObjectType(objectnum) = 0 | GetObjectType(objectnum) = 5 | GetObjectType(objectnum) = 7 | GetObjectType(objectnum) = 9 | GetObjectType(objectnum) = 10 Then
            If RunScript0(strcat("GetObj",str(objectnum))) = 1 Then
               PlayerMessage(Player,"You can't carry anymore of this object!",BrightRed)
               Exit SUB
            End If
            If GetPlayerInvObject(Player,openinvslot) = 0 Then
               GiveObj(Player,objectnum,1)
               PlayerMessage(Player,"Item retrieved!",BrightGreen)
               WriteIniStr("Market",GetPlayerUser(Player),str(Parm1),"")
               WriteIniStr("Market",GetPlayerUser(Player),str(Parm1 + 100),"")
               openinvslot = 21
            Else
               If openinvslot = 20 Then
                  PlayerMessage(Player,"Clear out your inventory! You don't have room.",BrightRed)
               End If
            End If
         Else
            specialvalue = val(ReadIniStr("Market",GetPlayerUser(Player),str(Parm1),"")) - 100000000
            specialvalue = specialvalue - objectnum
            specialvalue = Divide(specialvalue,1000)
            If GetObjectType(objectnum) = 6 | GetObjectType(objectnum) = 11 Then
               If RunScript0(strcat("GetObj",str(objectnum))) = 1 Then
                  PlayerMessage(Player,"You can't carry anymore! of this object!",BrightRed)
                  Exit SUB
               End If
               If GetPlayerInvObject(Player,openinvslot) = 0 | GetPlayerInvObject(Player,openinvslot) = objectnum Then
                  GiveObj(Player,objectnum,specialvalue)
                  If specialvalue = 1 Then
                     PlayerMessage(Player,"Item retrieved!",BrightGreen)
                  Else
                     PlayerMessage(Player,"Items retrieved!",BrightGreen)
                  End If
                  WriteIniStr("Market",GetPlayerUser(Player),str(Parm1),"")
                  WriteIniStr("Market",GetPlayerUser(Player),str(Parm1 + 100),"")
                  openinvslot = 21
               Else
                  If openinvslot = 20 Then
                     PlayerMessage(Player,"Clear out your inventory! You don't have room.",BrightRed)
                  End If
               End If
            Else
PlayerMessage(Player,"How did you get an Equipment item into storage?",BrightRed)
'               If GetPlayerInvObject(Player,openinvslot) = 0 Then
'                  GiveObj(Player,objectnum,1)
'                  SetObjDurability(Player,openinvslot,specialvalue)
'                  suffixnum = val(ReadIniStr("Market",GetPlayerUser(Player),str(Parm1 + 200),"") - 1000000
'                  For a = 1 to 10
'                     If suffixnum >= 100000 Then
'                        suffixnum = suffixnum - 100000
'                     End If
'                  Next a
'                  For a = 1 to 10
'                     If suffixnum >= 10000 Then
'                        suffixnum = suffixnum - 10000
'                     End If
'                  Next a
'                  For a = 1 to 10
'                     If suffixnum >= 1000 Then
'                        suffixnum = suffixnum - 1000
'                     End If
'                  Next a
'                  prefixnum = val(ReadIniStr("Market",GetPlayerUser(Player),str(Parm1 + 200),"") - 1000000
'                  prefixnum = prefixnum - suffixnum
'                  prefixnum = Divide(prefixnum,1000)

         End If
   Next openinvslot
End If
End SUB

Name=marscash

Script Source=
SUB Main(Player as LONG)
'\marketcash
'Script by MarsPhoenix with much help by Fankadore

Dim openinvslot as LONG

If strcmp(ReadIniStr("Market",GetPlayerUser(Player),"Profit",""),"") Then
   PlayerMessage(Player,"You have no gold in the marketplace.",Yellow)
Else
   For openinvslot = 1 to 20
      If GetPlayerInvObject(Player,openinvslot) = 0 | GetPlayerInvObject(Player,openinvslot) = 6 Then
         GiveObj(Player,6,Val(ReadIniStr("Market",GetPlayerUser(Player),"Profit","")))
         PlayerMessage(Player,StrCat("Retrieved ",StrCat(ReadIniStr("Market",GetPlayerUser(Player),"Profit","")," Gold!")),Yellow)
         WriteIniStr("Market",GetPlayerUser(Player),"Profit","")
         openinvslot = 21
      Else
         If openinvslot = 20 Then
            PlayerMessage(Player,"Clear out your inventory! You don't have room.",BrightRed)
         End If
      End If
   Next openinvslot
End If
End SUB

Script Source=
SUB Main(Player as LONG)
'\marketcheck
'Script by MarsPhoenix with much help by Fankadore
Dim slot as LONG,objectnum as LONG,specialvalue as LONG,a as LONG,price as LONG
PlayerMessage(Player,ReadIniStr("PlayerNameLookup","PNL","Prophet of Fire",""),Yellow)

For slot = 1 to 15
   If strcmp(ReadIniStr("Market",GetPlayerUser(Player),str(slot),""), "") Then
	'Empty Slot
   Else
      objectnum = val(ReadIniStr("Market",GetPlayerUser(Player),str(slot),"")) - 100000000
      For a = 1 to 10
         If objectnum >= 10000000 Then
            objectnum = objectnum - 10000000
         End If
      Next a
      For a = 1 to 10
         If objectnum >= 1000000 Then
            objectnum = objectnum - 1000000
         End If
      Next a
      For a = 1 to 10
         If objectnum >= 100000 Then
            objectnum = objectnum - 100000
         End If
      Next a
      For a = 1 to 10
         If objectnum >= 10000 Then
            objectnum = objectnum - 10000
         End If
      Next a
      For a = 1 to 10
         If objectnum >= 1000 Then
            objectnum = objectnum - 1000
         End If
      Next a
      price = val(ReadIniStr("Market",GetPlayerUser(Player),str(slot + 100),""))
      If GetObjectType(objectnum) = 0 | GetObjectType(objectnum) = 5 | GetObjectType(objectnum) = 7 | GetObjectType(objectnum) = 9 | GetObjectType(objectnum) = 10 Then
         PlayerMessage(Player,StrCat("Slot ",StrCat(str(slot),StrCat(": ",StrCat(GetObjectName(objectnum),StrCat("   Price: ",str(price)))))),Yellow)
      Else
         specialvalue = val(ReadIniStr("Market",GetPlayerUser(Player),str(slot),"")) - 100000000
         specialvalue = specialvalue - objectnum
         specialvalue = Divide(specialvalue,1000)
         If GetObjectType(objectnum) = 6 | GetObjectType(objectnum) = 11 Then
            PlayerMessage(Player,StrCat("Slot ",StrCat(str(slot),StrCat(": ",StrCat(str(specialvalue),StrCat(" ",StrCat(GetObjectName(objectnum),StrCat("s ",StrCat("   Price: ",str(price))))))))),Yellow)
         Else
            PlayerMessage(Player,StrCat("Slot ",StrCat(str(slot),StrCat(": ",StrCat(GetObjectName(objectnum),StrCat("   Durability: ",StrCat(str(specialvalue),StrCat("   Price: ",str(price)))))))),Yellow)
         End If
      End If
   End If
Next slot
PlayerMessage(Player,StrCat("Money in Market: ",ReadIniStr("Market",GetPlayerUser(Player),"Profit","")),Yellow)
End SUB

SUB Main(Player as LONG,Parm1 as LONG,Parm2 as LONG,Parm3 as LONG)
'\marketsell -inventory slot- -amount- -price-
'Script by MarsPhoenix with much help by Fankadore
Dim slot as LONG,objectnum as LONG,objectcode as LONG,prefixsuffixcode as LONG

objectnum = GetPlayerInvObject(Player,Parm1)

If Parm1 = 0 | Parm1 > 21 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player,"Your inventory slots are 1-20. Try and pick one that actually exists.",BrightRed)
	Exit Sub
End If
If objectnum = 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player,"There's nothing in that inventory slot, skippy.",BrightRed)
	Exit Sub
End If

If GetObjectType(objectnum) = 0 | GetObjectType(objectnum) = 5 | GetObjectType(objectnum) = 6 | GetObjectType(objectnum) = 7 | GetObjectType(objectnum) = 9 | GetObjectType(objectnum) = 10 | GetObjectType(objectnum) = 11 Then
	If GetObjectType(objectnum) = 6 | GetObjectType(objectnum) = 11 Then
		If Parm2 = 0 Then
			PlayerMessage(Player,"Yeah, no one is going to buy 0 of something. Put in a value.",BrightRed)
			Exit Sub
		End If
		If Parm2 >= 100000 Then
			PlayerMessage(Player,"You can stack up to 99,999 at a time. That's more than enough. Who has 100,000 of anything besides Gold?",BrightRed)
			Exit Sub
		End If
		If GetPlayerInvValue(Player,Parm1) < Parm2 Then
			PlayerMessage(Player,"I'm sure you wish you had that many to sell, but you don't.",BrightRed)
			Exit Sub
		End If
		If Parm3 = 0 Then
			PlayerMessage(Player,"You don't REALLY wanna give that out for free, do you? At least put 1.",BrightRed)
			Exit Sub
		End If
		If Parm3 > 10000000 Then
			PlayerMessage(Player,"10,000,000 is already a ripoff maximum value, why don't you just use that?",BrightRed)
			Exit Sub
		End If
		For slot = 1 to 15
			If strcmp(ReadIniStr("Market",GetPlayerUser(Player),str(slot),""), "") Then
				objectcode = 100000000 + (Parm2 * 1000) + objectnum
				WriteIniStr("Market",GetPlayerUser(Player),str(slot),str(objectcode))
				WriteIniStr("Market",GetPlayerUser(Player),str(slot + 100),str(Parm3))
				TakeObj(Player,objectnum,Parm2)
				If Parm2 = 1 Then
					PlayerMessage(Player,StrCat("1 ",StrCat(GetObjectName(objectnum),StrCat(" put up for the price of ",StrCat(Str(Parm3)," Gold.")))),Yellow)
				Else
					PlayerMessage(Player,StrCat(Str(Parm2),StrCat(" ",StrCat(GetObjectName(objectnum),StrCat("s put up for the price of ",StrCat(Str(Parm3)," Gold each."))))),Yellow)
				End If
				slot = 16
			End If
			If slot = 15 Then PlayerMessage(Player,"You don't even have room for this! Sell or take out your items.",BrightRed)
		Next slot
	Else
		If Parm3 = 0 Then
			PlayerMessage(Player,"You don't REALLY wanna give that out for free, do you? At least put 1.",BrightRed)
			Exit Sub
		End If
		If Parm3 > 10000000 Then
			PlayerMessage(Player,"10,000,000 is already a ripoff maximum value already, why don't you just use that?",BrightRed)
			Exit Sub
		End If
		For slot = 1 to 15
			If strcmp(ReadIniStr("Market",GetPlayerUser(Player),str(slot),""), "") Then
				objectcode = 100001000 + objectnum
				WriteIniStr("Market",GetPlayerUser(Player),str(slot),str(objectcode))
				WriteIniStr("Market",GetPlayerUser(Player),str(slot + 100),str(Parm3))
				TakeObj(Player,objectnum,1)
				PlayerMessage(Player,StrCat("1 ",StrCat(GetObjectName(objectnum),StrCat(" put up for the price of ",StrCat(Str(Parm3)," Gold.")))),Yellow)
				slot = 16
			End If
			If slot = 15 Then PlayerMessage(Player,"You don't even have room for this! Sell or take out your items.",BrightRed)
		Next slot
	End If
Else
	PlayerMessage(Player,"Equipment is currently not functional with the market. ReMoTe has yet to add a way to check and store object durability.",BrightRed)
'         If Parm3 > 0 Then
'            If Parm3 < 10000000 Then
'               For slot = 1 to 15
'                  If ReadIniStr("Market",GetPlayerUser(Player),str(slot),"") = "" Then
'                     objectcode = 100000000 + (1000 * GetObjDurability(Player,Parm1) + objectnum

Name=marstest

Script Source=
SUB Main(Player as LONG, Parm1 as LONG) 
Dim sevendigit as LONG, a as LONG, roundcheck as LONG

sevendigit = Parm1 
 
'Finds the middle 3 numbers of a seven-digit number (xxOOOxx) 
For a = 1 to 10 
   If sevendigit >= 1000000 Then 
      sevendigit = sevendigit - 1000000 
   End If 
Next a 
For a = 1 to 10 
   If sevendigit >= 100000 Then 
      sevendigit = sevendigit - 100000 
   End If 
Next a 

roundcheck = sevendigit 
For a = 1 to 10 
   If roundcheck >= 10000 Then 
      roundcheck = roundcheck - 10000 
   End If 
Next a 
For a = 1 to 10 
   If roundcheck >= 1000 Then 
      roundcheck = roundcheck - 1000 
   End If 
Next a 
For a = 1 to 10 
   If roundcheck >= 100 Then 
      roundcheck = roundcheck - 100 
   End If 
Next a 
sevendigit = sevendigit - roundcheck 
sevendigit = Divide(sevendigit,100) 
PlayerMessage(Player,str(sevendigit),BrightGreen) 
End SUB

Script Source=
SUB Main(Player as LONG, Command as String, Parm1 as STRING)
'\marketview -player name-
'Script by MarsPhoenix with much help by Fankadore
Dim slot as LONG,objectnum as LONG,specialvalue as LONG,a as LONG,price as LONG,discoveredname as STRING

If strcmp(ReadIniStr("PlayerNameLookup","PNL",Parm1,""), "") Then
   PlayerMessage(Player,strcat("No player by the name ",strcat(Parm1," was found! Make sure the spelling is right.")),BrightRed)
   Exit SUB
Else
   discoveredname = ReadIniStr("PlayerNameLookup","PNL",Parm1,"")
End If


For slot = 1 to 15
   If strcmp(ReadIniStr("Market",discoveredname,str(slot),""), "") Then
	'Empty Slot
   Else
      objectnum = val(ReadIniStr("Market",discoveredname,str(slot),"")) - 100000000
      For a = 1 to 10
         If objectnum >= 10000000 Then
            objectnum = objectnum - 10000000
         End If
      Next a
      For a = 1 to 10
         If objectnum >= 1000000 Then
            objectnum = objectnum - 1000000
         End If
      Next a
      For a = 1 to 10
         If objectnum >= 100000 Then
            objectnum = objectnum - 100000
         End If
      Next a
      For a = 1 to 10
         If objectnum >= 10000 Then
            objectnum = objectnum - 10000
         End If
      Next a
      For a = 1 to 10
         If objectnum >= 1000 Then
            objectnum = objectnum - 1000
         End If
      Next a
      price = val(ReadIniStr("Market",discoveredname,str(slot + 100),""))
      If GetObjectType(objectnum) = 0 | GetObjectType(objectnum) = 5 | GetObjectType(objectnum) = 7 | GetObjectType(objectnum) = 9 | GetObjectType(objectnum) = 10 Then
         PlayerMessage(Player,StrCat("Slot ",StrCat(str(slot),StrCat(": ",StrCat(GetObjectName(objectnum),StrCat("   Price: ",str(price)))))),Yellow)
      Else
         specialvalue = val(ReadIniStr("Market",discoveredname,str(slot),"")) - 100000000
         specialvalue = specialvalue - objectnum
         specialvalue = Divide(specialvalue,1000)
         If GetObjectType(objectnum) = 6 | GetObjectType(objectnum) = 11 Then
            PlayerMessage(Player,StrCat("Slot ",StrCat(str(slot),StrCat(": ",StrCat(str(specialvalue),StrCat(" ",StrCat(GetObjectName(objectnum),StrCat("s ",StrCat("   Price: ",str(price))))))))),Yellow)
         Else
            PlayerMessage(Player,StrCat("Slot ",StrCat(str(slot),StrCat(": ",StrCat(GetObjectName(objectnum),StrCat("   Durability: ",StrCat(str(specialvalue),StrCat("   Price: ",str(price)))))))),Yellow)
         End If
      End If
   End If
Next slot
End SUB

Name=meteor

Script Source=
Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim Map as Long, X as Long, Y as Long, RangeX as Long, RangeY as Long

Map = GetPlayerMap(Player)
X = GetPlayerX(Player) - 1
Y = GetPlayerY(Player) - 1


For RangeX = 1 To 3
For RangeY = 1 To 3
	If X = GetPlayerX(Player) & Y = GetPlayerY(Player) Then
	'Doesnt hit self
	Else
		If Random(2) = 1 Then
			CreateTileEffect(Map, X, Y, 63, 100, 3, 2, 0)
			CreateTileEffect(Map, X, Y, 23, 40, 2, 6, 0)
		End If
	End If
	Y = Y + 1
Next RangeY
	X = X + 1
	Y = GetPlayerY(Player) - 1
Next RangeX

End Sub

Name=mineore

Script Source=
Function Main(Player as Long) AS LONG
dim Chance as Long, LowChance as Long

Chance = Random(100) + 1
LowChance = Random(500) + 1
If Random(100) = 1 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "A Stone Golem grabs you and pulls you into the wall!", White)
'	SpawnMonster(1437, 194, 8, 6, 0)
	SetPlayerFlag(Player, 210, GetPlayerMap(Player))
	SetPlayerFlag(Player, 211, GetPlayerX(Player))
	SetPlayerFlag(Player, 212, GetPlayerY(Player))
	PlayerWarp(Player, 1437, 5, 6)
End If
Select Case Chance
	Case 1
		'Amethyst
		GiveObj(Player, 82, 1)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You mine an Amethyst!", Green)
	Case 2
		'Sapphire
		GiveObj(Player, 86, 1)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You mine a Sapphire!", Green)
	Case 3
		'Emerald
		GiveObj(Player, 84, 1)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You mine an Emerald!", Green)
	Case 4
		'Ruby
		GiveObj(Player, 85, 1)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You mine a Ruby!", Green)
	Case 5
		'Diamond
		GiveObj(Player, 83, 1)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You mine a Diamond!", Green)
	Case 6
		'Gold Nugget
		GiveObj(Player, 186, 1)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You mine a Gold Nugget!", Green)
	Case Else
		Select Case LowChance
			Case 1
				'Perfect Diamond
				GiveObj(Player, 434, 1)
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You mine a Perfect Diamond!!", BrightGreen)
			Case 2
				'Shining Ruby
				GiveObj(Player, 435, 1)
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You mine a Shining Ruby!!", BrightGreen)
			Case 3
				'Clear Emerald
				GiveObj(Player, 441, 1)
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You mine a Clear Emerald!!", BrightGreen)
			Case 4
				'Bright Sapphire
				GiveObj(Player, 438, 1)
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You mine a Bright Sapphire!!", BrightGreen)
			Case 5
				'Shined Amethyst
				GiveObj(Player, 458, 1)
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You mine a Cut Amethyst!!", BrightGreen)
			Case 6
				'10 Gold Nuggets
				GiveObj(Player, 186, 10)
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You mine 10 Gold Nuggets!!", BrightGreen)
		End Select
End Select

End Function

Name=MINUTETIMER

Script Source=
Sub Main()
	Dim Hour as Long, Minute as Long, Loop as Long 

	SetFlag(94, GetFlag(94) + 1)								'Minute Timer
	If GetFlag(94) % 60 = 0 Then SetFlag(98, GetFlag(98) + 1)	'Hour Timer

	'1 Minute
	RunScript0("LightTimer")
	RunScript0("JailTimer")
	RunScript0("Artifacts")
	'Lavos
	RunScript0("LavosTimer")
	'Fort
	Runscript0("FortTimer")
	'AB Boss
	Runscript0("ABtimer")


	'Fort 1a (test)
	'dim d as long
	'for d = 1 to getmaxusers()
	'if getplayerflag(d,184) > 10 then
	'setplayerflag(d,184,0)

	'else
	'if getplayerflag(d,184) > 0 then
	'setplayerflag(d, 184, getplayerflag(d,184)+1)
	'end if
	'end if

	'next d

	'Fort 1b
	if getflag(185) > 180 then
		setflag(185,0)
		setflag(186,0)
	else
		if getflag(185) > 0 then
			setflag(185, getflag(185)+1)
		end if
	end if


	'fortvault
	If getflag(187) > 0 Then
		Setflag(187, getflag(187) - 1)
	end if

	'vault
	If GetFlag(188) > 0 Then 'Fort Reward Timer
		If GetMapPlayerCount(2119) = 0 then
			setflag(188, 0)
			setflag(187, 100)
		End if
	end if

	If GetFlag(85) > 0 Then RunScript0("TofTimer")
	If GetFlag(89) > 0 Then RunScript0("ChampTimer")
	If GetFlag(99) > 0 Then RunScript0("FootballTimer")
	If GetFlag(82) = 1 Then GlobalMessage("Carnage will begin shortly, type /carn for a instant warp to the waiting room!  You do not lose items or experience in a carnage battle.", BrightBlue)
	If GetFlag(145) > 0 Then
		If GetFlag(146) = 0 Then
			RunScript0("SancGame2End")
		Else
			SetFlag(146, GetFlag(146) - 1)
			If GetFlag(146) = 0 Then MapMessage(620, "One Minute Left!", Yellow)
		End If
	End If

	'5 Minutes
	If GetFlag(94) % 5 = 0 Then
		If GetFlag(80) > 0 Then GlobalMessage("Tournament Arena is currently open. Type /tourny to join.", Yellow)
		If GetFlag(85) > 0 Then GlobalMessage("ToF is currently open. Type /tof to join.", Yellow)
		If GetFlag(89) > 10 Then GlobalMessage("Solo the Champ is currently open. Type /champ to join.", Yellow)
		If GetFlag(122) > 0 Then GlobalMessage(strcat("The Odyssey Lottery is now open! Type /lottery with ", strcat(str(GetFlag(124)), " Gold to play!")), BrightGreen)
	End If

	'60 Minutes

	End If
	
	RunScript0("BlockerCheck")
	'RunScript1("DuckAttack", 79)

Function Main(Player as Long) AS LONG
dim Mon1 as Long, Mon2 as Long, Mon3 as Long, Mon4 as Long, Mon5 as Long, Mon6 as Long, Monster as Long

If GetMonsterTarget(GetPlayerMap(Player), 0) = Player Then Mon1 = 1
If GetMonsterTarget(GetPlayerMap(Player), 1) = Player Then Mon2 = 1
If GetMonsterTarget(GetPlayerMap(Player), 2) = Player Then Mon3 = 1
If GetMonsterTarget(GetPlayerMap(Player), 3) = Player Then Mon4 = 1
If GetMonsterTarget(GetPlayerMap(Player), 4) = Player Then Mon5 = 1
If GetMonsterTarget(GetPlayerMap(Player), 5) = Player Then Mon6 = 1

If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 23) = 0 Then
	SetPlayerFlag(Player, 23, 1)
	RunScript1("cooldown", Player)
		For Monster = 0 To 5
			AttackMonster(Player, Monster, 0)
		Next Monster

	If Mon1 = 1 Then SetMonsterTarget(GetPlayerMap(Player), 0, Player)
	If Mon2 = 1 Then SetMonsterTarget(GetPlayerMap(Player), 1, Player)
	If Mon3 = 1 Then SetMonsterTarget(GetPlayerMap(Player), 2, Player)
	If Mon4 = 1 Then SetMonsterTarget(GetPlayerMap(Player), 3, Player)
	If Mon5 = 1 Then SetMonsterTarget(GetPlayerMap(Player), 4, Player)
	If Mon6 = 1 Then SetMonsterTarget(GetPlayerMap(Player), 5, Player)
Else
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must regenerate to cast again.", Grey)
End If

End Function

Name=mulecheck

Script Source=
Sub Main(Player AS LONG)
	Dim A AS LONG, B As LONG
	Dim DupeCount AS LONG
	
	For A = 1 to 80
		SetPlayerFlag(A, 256, 0)
	Next A
	
	For A = 1 to 80
		If IsPlaying(A) Then
			For B = 1 to 80
				If IsPlaying(B) Then
					If A = B Then
					
					Else
						If StrCmp(GetPlayerIP(A), GetPlayerIP(B)) Then
							If GetPlayerFlag(B, 256) = 0 Then
								SetPlayerFlag(A, 256, 1)
								SetPlayerFlag(B, 256, 1)
								DupeCount = DupeCount + 1
								PlayerMessage(Player, StrCat(StrCat(GetPlayerName(A), " - "), GetPlayerName(B)), WHITE)
							End If
						End If
					End If
				End If
			Next B
		End If
	Next A
	
	PlayerMessage(Player, StrCat("Total dupes: ", Str(DupeCount)), WHITE)
	
	For A = 1 to 80
		SetPlayerFlag(A, 256, 0)
	Next A
End Sub

CreateTileEffect(717,x,y+2, 23,20, 8, 0,0)
CreateTileEffect(717,x,y+3, 23,20, 8, 0,0)
for a = 0 to getmaxusers
if getplayermap(a) = 717 & getplayerx(a) = x & getplayery(a) > y & getplayery(a)  <= y+3 then 
CreatePlayerFloatText(a, "10", brightred)
if getplayerhp(player) > 10 then 
setplayerhp(player,getplayerhp(player)-10)
else
setplayerhp(player,1)
end if
end if
next a

case 2'left
CreateTileEffect(717,x-1,y, 23,20, 8, 0,0)
CreateTileEffect(717,x-2,y, 23,20, 8, 0,0)
CreateTileEffect(717,x-3,y, 23,20, 8, 0,0)
for a = 0 to getmaxusers
if getplayermap(a) = 717 & getplayerx(a) < x & getplayerx(a) >= x-3 & getplayery(a) = y then
CreatePlayerFloatText(a, "10", brightred)
if getplayerhp(player) > 10 then 
setplayerhp(player,getplayerhp(player)-10)
else
setplayerhp(player,1)
end if
end if
next a
case 3'right

CreateTileEffect(717,x+1,y, 23,20, 8, 0,0)
CreateTileEffect(717,x+2,y, 23,20, 8, 0,0)
CreateTileEffect(717,x+3,y, 23,20, 8, 0,0)
for a = 0 to getmaxusers
if getplayermap(a) = 717 & getplayerx(a) > x & getplayerx(a) <= x+ 3 & getplayery(a) = y then 
CreatePlayerFloatText(a, "10", brightred)
if getplayerhp(player) > 10 then
setplayerhp(player,getplayerhp(player)-10)
else
setplayerhp(player,1)
end if
end if
next a
End select

case 3
for a = 0 to getmaxusers()
if getplayermap(a) = 717 & random(2) = 0 then
setmonstertarget(717,0,a)
target = a
goto attack
end if
next a
goto next1
attack:
mapmessage(717,strcat(strcat("Nis yells, ''Time to die, ",getplayername(target)),"!''"),grey)
x = getmonsterx(717,0)
y = getmonstery(717,0)
CreateTileEffect(717,getplayerx(target),getplayery(target), 3,20, 8, 0,0)
select case getmonsterdirection(717,0)
case 0
playerwarp(target,717,x,y-1)
case 1
playerwarp(target,717,x,y+1)
case 2
playerwarp(target,717,x-1,y)
case 3
playerwarp(target,717,x+1,y)
end select
playermessage(target,"You are pulled to Nis!",brightred)
CreateTileEffect(717,getplayerx(target),getplayery(target), 3,20, 8, 0,0)
setmonstertarget(717,0,target)
next1:
case 4
mapmessage(717,"Nis yells, ''You cannot kill a god!",grey)
x = getmonsterx(717,0)
y = getmonstery(717,0)
CreateMapFloatText(717, x, y, "Incendia Ex!", brightred)


CreateTileEffect(717,x,y-1, 23,20, 8, 0,0)
CreateTileEffect(717,x,y-2, 23,20, 8, 0,0)
CreateTileEffect(717,x,y-3, 23,20, 8, 0,0)
for a = 0 to getmaxusers
if getplayermap(a) = 717 & getplayerx(a) = x & getplayery(a) < y & getplayery(a) >= y-3 then
CreatePlayerFloatText(a, "14", brightred)
if getplayerhp(player) > 14 then 
setplayerhp(player,getplayerhp(player)-14)
else
setplayerhp(player,1)
end if
end if
next a


CreateTileEffect(717,x,y+1, 23,20, 8, 0,0)
CreateTileEffect(717,x,y+2, 23,20, 8, 0,0)
CreateTileEffect(717,x,y+3, 23,20, 8, 0,0)
for a = 0 to getmaxusers
if getplayermap(a) = 717 & getplayerx(a) = x & getplayery(a) > y & getplayery(a)  <= y + 3 then 
CreatePlayerFloatText(a, "14", brightred)
if getplayerhp(player) > 14 then
setplayerhp(player,getplayerhp(player)-14)
else
setplayerhp(player,1)
end if
end if
next a


CreateTileEffect(717,x-1,y, 23,20, 8, 0,0)
CreateTileEffect(717,x-2,y, 23,20, 8, 0,0)
CreateTileEffect(717,x-3,y, 23,20, 8, 0,0)
for a = 0 to getmaxusers
if getplayermap(a) = 717 & getplayerx(a) < x & getplayerx(a) >= x-3 & getplayery(a) = y then
CreatePlayerFloatText(a, "14", brightred)
if getplayerhp(player) > 14 then 
setplayerhp(player,getplayerhp(player)-14)
else
setplayerhp(player,1)
end if
end if
next a

CreateTileEffect(717,x+1,y, 23,20, 8, 0,0)
CreateTileEffect(717,x+2,y, 23,20, 8, 0,0)
CreateTileEffect(717,x+3,y, 23,20, 8, 0,0)
for a = 0 to getmaxusers
if getplayermap(a) = 717 & getplayerx(a) > x & getplayerx(a) <= x+ 3 & getplayery(a) = y then 
CreatePlayerFloatText(a, "14", brightred)
if getplayerhp(player) > 14 then
setplayerhp(player,getplayerhp(player)-14)
else
setplayerhp(player,1)
end if
end if
next a

end select
end if

end sub

Name=PARTGAME

Script Source=
Function Main(Player as Long) as Long
dim Loop as Long, Count as Long, A as Long

'Artifacts
	If HasObj(Player, 393) Then RunScript1("ArtifactSpawn", Player)
	If HasObj(Player, 389) Then RunScript1("ArtifactSpawn", Player)

'Lottery
	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 220) > 0 Then
		SetFlag(120, GetFlag(120) - 1)
		SetFlag(121, GetFlag(121) - 3000)
		For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
			If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 220) > GetPlayerFlag(Player, 220) Then
				SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 220, GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 220) - 1)
			End If
		Next Loop
		SetPlayerFlag(Player, 220, 0)
	End If
	
'Party
If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 201) > 0 Then
	For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
		If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 201) = GetPlayerFlag(Player, 201) Then
			PlayerMessage(Loop, strcat(GetPlayerName(Player), " has left your party."), White)
		End If
	Next Loop
	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 202) = 1 Then
		SetPlayerFlag(Player, 202, 0)
			For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
				If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 201) = GetPlayerFlag(Player, 201) Then
					SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 202, 1)
					Goto Finish
				End If
			Next Loop
	End If
End If
Finish:

'Solo the Champ
If GetFlag(90) = Player Then SetFlag(90, 0)
If GetFlag(95) = Player Then SetFlag(95, 0)
'Jims game
If GetFlag(96) = Player Then SetFlag(96, 0)
If GetFlag(97) = Player Then SetFlag(97, 0)

'Titan Takedown
If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 10) = 4 Then
	SetPlayerFlag(Player, 10, 0)
	SetPlayerFlag(Player, 11, 0)
	SetPlayerFlag(Player, 12, 0)
End If
   
'Carn
	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 10) = 1 Then
		SetPlayerFlag(Player, 10, 0)
			For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
				If IsPlaying(Loop) Then
					If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10) = 1 Then
						Count = Count + 1
						A = Loop
					End If
				End If
			Next Loop
		If Count = 1 Then
			GlobalMessage(strcat(GetPlayerName(A), " has won Carnage!"), BrightGreen)
			PlayerWarp(A, 8, 9, 7)
			SetPlayerFlag(A, 10, 0)
		End If
	End If

'CTF
	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 10) = 6 Then
		SetPlayerFlag(Player, 10, 0)
		If HasObj(Player, 508) Then
			GlobalMessage("The Red Flag has been returned!", BrightRed)
			TakeObj(Player, 508, HasObj(Player, 508))
			SpawnObject(70, 508, 1, 1, 6)
			SetFlag(181, 0)
		End If
		If HasObj(Player, 509) Then
			GlobalMessage("The Blue Flag has been returned!", BrightBlue)
			TakeObj(Player, 509, HasObj(Player, 509))
			SpawnObject(78, 509, 1, 10, 6)
			SetFlag(182, 0)
		End If
	End If

'Stake Arena
	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 13) > 0 Then
		SetPlayerFlag(Player, 13, 0)
		For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
			If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 13) > 0 Then
				Count = Count + 1
				A = Loop
			End If
		Next Loop
		If Count = 0 Then
			SetFlag(150, 0)
			MapMessage(1949, "A new duel can now begin.", Yellow)
		Else
			SetPlayerFlag(A, 13, 4)
			PlayerWarp(A, 1949, 4, 2)
			MapMessage(1949, strcat(GetPlayerName(A), "wins by default!"), Yellow)
		End If
	End If

'Duel Arena
	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 14) > 0 Then
		SetPlayerFlag(Player, 14, 0)
		For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
			If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 14) > 0 Then Count = Count + 1
		Next Loop
		If Count = 0 Then
			SetFlag(151, 0)
			MapMessage(1414, "A new duel can now begin.", Yellow)
		End If
	End If

'Trade Room
	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 17) > 0 Then
		SetPlayerFlag(Player, 17, 0)
		For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
			If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 17) > 0 Then Count = Count + 1
		Next Loop
		If Count = 0 Then
			SetFlag(152, 0)
			MapMessage(554, "A new trade can now begin.", Yellow)
		End If
	End If

'Team Arena
	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 10) = 13 Then
		If GetFlag(153) = 1 Then
			MapMessage(1443, strcat(GetPlayerName(Player), " forfeits by logging."), Yellow)
			SetPlayerGuild(Player, GetPlayerFlag(Player, 5))
			RunScript0("TeamArenaWin")
		End If
	End If

'Tournament Arena
	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 10) = 14 Then
		For Loop = 171 To 178
			If GetFlag(Loop) = Player Then SetFlag(Loop, 0)
		Next Loop
		If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 11) = 1 Then RunScript1("TournamentForfeit", Player)
	End If

RunScript1("ResetFlags", Player)

Main = Continue
End Function

Name=partyall

Script Source=
Function Main(Player as Long) AS LONG
dim Loop as Long, Party as Long, Message as String, Count as Long, Count2 as Long

GlobalMessage("==Party List==", Yellow)
Count2 = 1
For Party = 1 To 30
	Message = strcat(str(Count2), ". ")
	Count = 0
	For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
		If IsPlaying(Loop) Then
			If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 201) = Party Then
				Count = Count + 1
				If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 202) = 1 Then
					Message = strcat(Message, strcat(GetPlayerName(Loop), " (Leader), "))
				Else
					Message = strcat(Message, strcat(GetPlayerName(Loop), ", "))
				End If				
			End If
		End If
	Next Loop
	If Count > 0 Then
		GlobalMessage(Message, Party)
		Count2 = Count2 + 1
	End If
Next Party

End Function

Name=partyboot

Script Source=
Function Main(Player as Long, Target as Long) AS LONG

If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 201) > 0 Then
	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 202) = 1 Then
		If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 201) = GetPlayerFlag(Target, 201) Then
			SetPlayerFlag(Target, 201, 0)
			PlayerMessage(Player, strcat("You have booted ", strcat(GetPlayerName(Target), " from the Party.")), White)
			PlayerMessage(Target, "You have been booted from the Party.", White)
			Exit Function
		Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, "That player is not in your Party.", Grey)
		End If
	Else
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You are not Leader of the Party.", Grey)
	End If
Else
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You are not in a Party.", Grey)
End If

End Function

Name=partyinvite

Script Source=
Function Main(Player as Long, Target as Long) AS LONG
dim Loop as Long, Count as Long

If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 201) > 0 Then
	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 202) = 1 Then
		For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
			If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 201) = GetPlayerFlag(Player, 201) Then Count = Count + 1
			If Count >= 10 Then 
				PlayerMessage(Player, "Your Party is full.", Grey)
				Exit Function
			End If
		Next Loop
		If GetPlayerFlag(Target, 203) = GetPlayerFlag(Player, 201) Then
			PlayerMessage(Player, strcat("You have already invited ", strcat(GetPlayerName(Target), " to your party.")), Grey)
		Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, strcat("You have invited ", strcat(GetPlayerName(Target), " to your Party.")), White)
			PlayerMessage(Target, strcat(GetPlayerName(Player), " has invited you to their Party. Type /party join."), White)
			SetPlayerFlag(Target, 203, GetPlayerFlag(Player, 201))
		End If
	Else
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You are not Leader of the Party.", Grey)
	End If
Else
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You are not in a Party.", Grey)
End If

End Function

Function Main(Player as Long) AS LONG
dim Loop as Long, Count as Long

If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 201) = 0 Then
	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 203) > 0 Then
		For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
			If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 201) = GetPlayerFlag(Player, 203) Then Count = Count + 1
			If Count >= 10 Then 
				PlayerMessage(Player, "That Party is full.", Grey)
				Exit Function
			End If
		Next Loop
		SetPlayerFlag(Player, 201, GetPlayerFlag(Player, 203))
		SetPlayerFlag(Player, 203, 0)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You have joined a Party!", Yellow)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "To leave the party type /party leave.", White)
		RunScript1("partylist", Player)
		For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
			If Player <> Loop Then
				If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 201) = GetPlayerFlag(Player, 201) Then
					PlayerMessage(Loop, strcat(GetPlayerName(Player), " has joined your Party."), White)
				End If
			End If
		Next Loop
	Else
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You have not been invited to a Party.", Grey)
	End If
Else
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You are already in a Party.", Grey)
End If

End Function

Name=partyleave

Script Source=
Function Main(Player as Long) AS LONG
dim Loop as Long, Leader as Long

If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 201) > 0 Then
	For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
		If Player <> Loop Then
			If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 201) = GetPlayerFlag(Player, 201) Then
				PlayerMessage(Loop, strcat(GetPlayerName(Player), " has left your Party."), White)
			End If
		End If
	Next Loop
	For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
		If Player <> Loop Then
			If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 201) = GetPlayerFlag(Player, 201) Then
				Leader = Loop
				Goto Finish
			End If
		End If
	Next Loop
End If

Finish:
RunScript2("partyleader", Player, Leader)
SetPlayerFlag(Player, 201, 0)
SetPlayerFlag(Player, 202, 0)
PlayerMessage(Player, "You are no longer part of any Party.", Grey)

End Function

Name=partylist

Script Source=
Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim Loop as Long, Party as Long, Message as String
dim Count as Long, Count2 as Long, Colour as Long

PlayerMessage(Player, "==Party List==", White)
Count2 = 1
For Party = 1 To 30
	Message = strcat(str(Count2), ". ")
	Count = 0
	For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
		If IsPlaying(Loop) Then
			If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 201) = Party Then
				Count = Count + 1
				If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 202) = 1 Then
					Message = strcat(Message, strcat(GetPlayerName(Loop), " (Leader), "))
				Else
					Message = strcat(Message, strcat(GetPlayerName(Loop), ", "))
				End If				
			End If
		End If
	Next Loop
	If Count > 0 Then
		If Colour = 4 Then Colour = 6 Else Colour = 4
		PlayerMessage(Player, Message, Party)
		Count2 = Count2 + 1
	End If
Next Party

End Sub

	   X = X + 1
	   For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
		  If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 201) = X Then
			 GoTo Start
		  End If
	   Next Loop
	   TakeObj(Player, 6, Cost)
	   SetFlag(113, GetFlag(113) + Cost) 'Gold Collected
	   SetPlayerFlag(Player, 201, X)
	   SetPlayerFlag(Player, 202, 1)
	   PlayerMessage(Player, "You have created a Party!", Yellow)
	   PlayerMessage(Player, "Type /party invite <player> to invite others to join.", Grey)
	Else
		PlayerMessage(Player, strcat("It costs ", strcat(str(Cost), " Gold to start a Party.")), Grey)
	End If
Else
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You are already in a Party.", Grey)
End If

End Function

Script Source=
Function Main(Player AS LONG) AS LONG

'God Death
If GetPlayerAccess(Player) > 0 Then
	Main = Stop
'	Exit Function
End If

If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 120) > 0 Then
	RunScript1("debuff", Player)
End If

'Artifacts
	If HasObj(Player, 393) Then RunScript1("ArtifactSpawn", Player)
	If HasObj(Player, 389) Then RunScript1("ArtifactSpawn", Player)

'Battle Royal
If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 97) > 1 Then
	Main = Stop
	If GetPlayerGuild(Player) = 30 Then PlayerWarp(Player, 1421, 0, 1)
	If GetPlayerGuild(Player) = 31 Then PlayerWarp(Player, 1422, 11, 1)
End If

'Protect players under level 20 from losing their items
If GetPlayerLevel(Player) <= 20 Then
	SetPlayerStatus(Player, 0)
	PlayerMessage(Player, "The angel of mercy has protected you from losing your items and experience.", WHITE)
	PlayerMessage(Player, "To avoid death, stay along the roads and avoid attacking strong monsters or players until you become stronger!  For help on what quests to do, visit OdysseyClassic.com and view the quest guides!", WHITE)
	Main = Stop
	Exit Function
End If

'Sprite Reset on Death
If GetPlayerGuild(Player) = 0 Then
   SetPlayerSprite(Player, 0)
Else
   SetPlayerSprite(Player, GetGuildSprite(GetPlayerGuild(Player)))
End If

Main = Continue

End Function

Name=poison

Script Source=
Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim Mana as Long, Loop as Long, Damage as Long, Cast as Long
dim Map as Long, X as Long, Y as Long, CalcX as Long, CalcY as Long

Map = GetPlayerMap(Player)
X = GetPlayerX(Player)
Y = GetPlayerY(Player)
Mana = 1
Damage = Divide(GetPlayerDamage(Player), 10)

If GetPlayerMana(Player) < Mana Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must regenerate to cast.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 23) > 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must wait to cast.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If

SetPlayerMana(Player, GetPlayerMana(Player) - Mana)
SetPlayerFlag(Player, 23, 1)
RunScript1("SpellCooldown", Player)
CreatePlayerFloatText(Player, "KIXFACE!", BrightGreen)


For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
	If Player <> Loop Then
		If GetPlayerMap(Loop) = Map Then
			CalcX = Abs(GetPlayerX(Loop) - X)
			CalcY = Abs(GetPlayerY(Loop) - Y)
			If CalcX < 3 & CalcY < 3 Then
				Cast = 1
				SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 31, Damage)
				SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 33, Player)
				CreateCharacterEffect(GetPlayerMap(Loop), Loop, 18, 40, 2, 2, 0)
				PlayerMessage(Loop, strcat(GetPlayerName(Player), " has poisoned you!"), White)
				Timer(Loop, 2, "Poison1")
				Timer(Loop, 20, "PoisonCooldown")
			End If
		End If
	End If
Next Loop

If Cast = 1 Then SetPlayerFlag(Player, 32, 1)

End Sub

Name=PUSH

Script Source=
Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim X as Long, Y as Long, Z as Long
dim Loop as Long, Map as Long

If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 76) = 0 Then Exit Sub
If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 109) > 0 Then Exit Sub
If GetPlayerHP(Player) <> GetPlayerMaxHP(Player) Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must have full Health to use Push.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If

Map = GetPlayerMap(Player)
X = GetPlayerX(Player)
Y = GetPlayerY(Player)

SetPlayerFlag(Player, 109, 1)
Timer(Player, 6, "PushTimer")
MapMessage(GetPlayerMap(Player), StrCat(GetPlayerName(Player), " has used Push!"), BRIGHTRED)

Select Case GetPlayerDirection(Player)
	Case Up
		Y = Y - 1
		Z = Y - 1
		If Y < 1 Then Exit Sub
		For Loop = 1 to GetMaxUsers()
			If GetPlayerMap(Loop) = Map & GetPlayerX(Loop) = X & GetPlayerY(Loop) = Y Then
				If GetTileAtt(Map, X, Z) = 0 Then PlayerWarp(Loop, Map, X, Z)
			End If
		Next Loop
	Case Down
		Y = Y + 1
		Z = Y + 1
		If Y > 10 Then Exit Sub
		For Loop = 1 to GetMaxUsers()
			If GetPlayerMap(Loop) = Map & GetPlayerX(Loop) = X & GetPlayerY(Loop) = Y Then
				If GetTileAtt(Map, X, Z) = 0 Then PlayerWarp(Loop, Map, X, Z)
			End If
		Next Loop
	Case Left
		X = X - 1
		Z = X - 1
		If X < 1 Then Exit Sub
		For Loop = 1 to GetMaxUsers()
			If GetPlayerMap(Loop) = Map & GetPlayerX(Loop) = X & GetPlayerY(Loop) = Y Then
				If GetTileAtt(Map, Z, Y) = 0 Then PlayerWarp(Loop, Map, Z, Y)
			End If
		Next Loop
	Case Right
		X = X + 1
		Z = X + 1
		If X > 10 Then Exit Sub
		For Loop = 1 to GetMaxUsers()
			If GetPlayerMap(Loop) = Map & GetPlayerX(Loop) = X & GetPlayerY(Loop) = Y Then
				If GetTileAtt(Map, Z, Y) = 0 Then PlayerWarp(Loop, Map, Z, Y)
			End If
		Next Loop
End Select

End Sub

	Y = GetPlayerY(Player)

Name=ration

Script Source=
Function Main(Player as Long) AS LONG
dim Ration as Long

'HP Potion
'Ancient Tome
'Sushi
'Fish Cakes
'Fish Stew
'Candy Apple
'Kank's Cake
'Cookie
'Witch's Brew

Ration = HasObj(Player, 39) + HasObj(Player, 99) + HasObj(Player, 48) + HasObj(Player, 329) + HasObj(Player, 330) + HasObj(Player, 41) + HasObj(Player, 138) + HasObj(Player, 198) + HasObj(Player, 149)
If Ration >= 5 Then
	Main = Stop
Else
	Main = Continue
End If

End Function

Name=redemption

Script Source=
Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim Map as Long, X as Long, Y as Long
dim CalcX as Long, CalcY as Long
dim Mana as Long, Loop as Long
'Cleric Redemption

Map = GetPlayerMap(Player)
X = GetPlayerX(Player)
Y = GetPlayerY(Player)
Mana = 1

If HasObj(Player, 411) = 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You require a Living Essence to cast this spell.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
If GetPlayerHP(Player) > Divide(GetPlayerMaxHP(Player), 5) Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must be below 20% health to cast this spell.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
If GetPlayerMana(Player) < Mana Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must regenerate before casting.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If

TakeObj(Player, 411, 1)
SetPlayerFlag(Player, 207, 1)
PlayerMessage(Player, "You draw from the power of the essence.", White)

End Sub

*******************************************************
*******************************************************
Name=redemption2

Script Source=
Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim Map as Long, X as Long, Y as Long
dim CalcX as Long, CalcY as Long
dim Loop as Long, Damage as Long
Damage = GetPlayerDamage(Player) + Divide(GetPlayerDamage(Player), 3)
Map = GetPlayerMap(Player)
X = GetPlayerX(Player)
Y = GetPlayerY(Player)

SetPlayerFlag(Player, 207, 0)
If HasObj(Player, 411) = 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You require a Living Essence to cast this spell.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If

TakeObj(Player, 411, 1)
SetPlayerFlag(Player, 15, 2)
CreatePlayerFloatText(Player, "Decerto!", BrightRed)
SetPlayerIsDead(Player, 0)
For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
	If GetPlayerMap(Loop) = Map Then
		If Loop <> Player Then
			CalcX = Abs(GetPlayerX(Loop) - X)
			CalcY = Abs(GetPlayerY(Loop) - Y)
			If CalcX < 4 & CalcY < 4 Then
				MagicAttackPlayer(Player, Loop, Damage)
				CreateCharacterEffect(GetPlayerMap(Loop), Loop, 20, 40, 8, 0, 0)
			End If
		End If
	End If
Next Loop
SetPlayerIsDead(Player, 1)

End Sub

Name=refreshmarket

Script Source=
Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim Map as Long, Item as Long

Map = 534

For Item = 0 To 49
	If GetTileAtt(Map, GetObjX(Map, Item), GetObjY(Map, Item)) = 5 Then
		DestroyObject(Map, Item)
	End If
Next Item

If GetFlag(130) > 0 Then SpawnObject(Map, 215, GetFlag(130), 6, 4)	'Lumber
If GetFlag(131) > 0 Then SpawnObject(Map, 216, GetFlag(131), 3, 3)	'C Ore
If GetFlag(132) > 0 Then SpawnObject(Map, 217, GetFlag(132), 5, 3)	'F Ore
If GetFlag(133) > 0 Then SpawnObject(Map, 218, GetFlag(133), 4, 4)	'P Ore
If GetFlag(134) > 0 Then SpawnObject(Map, 153, GetFlag(134), 7, 3)	'S Fish
If GetFlag(135) > 0 Then SpawnObject(Map, 152, GetFlag(135), 9, 3)	'M Fish
If GetFlag(136) > 0 Then SpawnObject(Map, 148, GetFlag(136), 8, 4)	'B Fish

End Sub

Name=repairheros

Script Source=
Function Main(Player as Long) AS LONG
dim Slot as Long

For Slot = 1 To 20
	If GetPlayerInvObject(Player, Slot) = 248 Then
		TakeObj(Player, 248, 1)
		GiveObj(Player, 248, 1)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You have repaired your Hero's Guard!", Grey)
		Exit Function
	End If
Next Slot

End Function

Name=RES

Script Source=
Sub Main(Player as Long, Target as Long)
dim Map as Long
Map = GetPlayerMap(Player)
	If Map = 66 | Map = 67 | Map = 85 | Map = 87 | Map = 88 | Map = 91 | Map = 93 | Map = 98 | Map = 148 | Map = 167 | Map = 231 | Map = 232 Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You may not resurrect here.", Grey)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	
	If GetPlayerGuild(Player) = GetPlayerGuild(Target) & GetPlayerGuild(Player) > 0 Then
		'Players can resurrect their own guild
	Else
		If GetPlayerFlag(Target, 15) = 1 Then
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You may not resurrect those killed by man.", White)
			Exit Sub
		End If
		If GetPlayerFlag(Target, 15) = 2 Then
			PlayerMessage(Player, "This soul has exploded.", White)
			Exit Sub
		End If
	End If

If GetPlayerIsDead(Target) = True Then
	If HasObj(Player, 411) Then
		SetPlayerFlag(Player, 90, 0)
		TakeObj(Player, 411, 1)
		SetPlayerIsDead(Target, False)
		If GetPlayerMap(Target) = 1962 Then
			GlobalMessage(StrCat(StrCat(StrCat(GetPlayerName(Target), " has been resurrected by "), GetPlayerName(Player)), " in the arena, what a newb."), BrightGreen)
		Else
			GlobalMessage(StrCat(StrCat(GetPlayerName(Target), " has been resurrected by "), GetPlayerName(Player)), BrightGreen)
		End If
		CreatePlayerEffect(GetPlayerMap(Player), Player, Target, 31, 40, 8, 0)
	Else
		SetPlayerFlag(Player, 90, 0)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You require a Living Essence to cast this.", Grey)
	End If
End If

End Sub

Name=resetpots

Script Source=
Function Main(Player as Long) AS LONG

'Apples
While HasObj(Player, 41) > 3
	TakeObj(Player, 41, 1)
Wend

'Anceint Tomes
While HasObj(Player, 41) + HasObj(Player, 99) > 3
	TakeObj(Player, 99, 1)
Wend

'HP Pots
While HasObj(Player, 39) > 5
	TakeObj(Player, 39, 1)
Wend

'Energy Pots
While HasObj(Player, 40) > 5
	TakeObj(Player, 40, 1)
Wend

'Blinding Powder
While HasObj(Player, 407) > 5
	TakeObj(Player, 407, 1)
Wend

'Nightfall Dust
While HasObj(Player, 408) > 3
	TakeObj(Player, 408, 1)
Wend

'Holy Water
While HasObj(Player, 413) > 5
	TakeObj(Player, 413, 1)
Wend

'Living Essence
While HasObj(Player, 411) > 2
	TakeObj(Player, 411, 1)
Wend

End Function

Function main(player as long) as long
'Dim a as long

Timer(Player, 45, "roundsix")

'case 0

'case 1
SpawnMonster(1567, 247, 8, 3,0)
'case 2
SpawnMonster(1567, 247, 8, 6,0)
'case 3
SpawnMonster(1567, 247, 5, 6,0)


SpawnMonster(1567, 232, 8, 8,0)
SpawnMonster(1567, 225, 4, 4,0)
'case else
'end select
main = continue
End Function

Name=ruins

Script Source=
Function Main(player as long) as long
dim a as long

	GlobalMessage("A Free For All Carnage has started!", 9)
	GlobalMessage("Map: Ruins of Crendale",white)
	  
SetFlag(82, 0)
For A = 1 to GetMaxUsers()
	If IsPlaying(A) Then
		If GetPlayerMap(A) = 68 Then
			If GetPlayerAccess(A) = 0 Then
				SetPlayerFlag(A, 5, GetPlayerGuild(A))
				SetPlayerFlag(A, 10, 1)
				SetPlayerStatus(A, 9)
				SetPlayerGuild(A, 0)
				SetPlayerSprite(A, 11)
				PlayerWarp(A, 1011, 3 + random(7), 3 + random(7))
			Else
				PlayerWarp(A, 1011, 0, 1)
			End If
		End If
	End If
Next A

End Function

Name=rules

Script Source=
Function Main(Player as Long) AS LONG

PlayerMessage(Player, "The Rules of Odyssey", Yellow)
PlayerMessage(Player, "1. You must not block players so they cannot move freely.", White)
PlayerMessage(Player, "2. An unguilded may not interfere in a guild fight on a white map.", White)
PlayerMessage(Player, "3. You may not use any sort of program to help you in the game.", White)
PlayerMessage(Player, "4. You may not spam in an obstructive way.", White)

Name=sacrifice

Script Source=
Sub Main(Player as Long, Target as Long)
dim Mana as Long

Mana = Divide(GetPlayerMana(Player), 3)

If GetTileAtt(GetPlayerMap(Player), GetPlayerX(Player), GetPlayerY(Player)) = 6 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You cannot cast here.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 23) > 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must wait to cast again.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
	SetPlayerFlag(Player, 23, 1)
	RunScript1("SpellCooldown", Player)
	SetPlayerMana(Player, GetPlayerMana(Player) - Mana)
	SetPlayerMana(Target, GetPlayerMana(Target) + Mana)
	If GetPlayerMana(Target) > GetPlayerMaxMana(Target) Then SetPlayerMana(Target, GetPlayerMaxMana(Target))
	CreatePlayerFloatText(Player, "Victima!", BrightGreen)
	CreatePlayerFloatText(Target, str(Mana), BrightBlue)
	CreateCharacterEffect(GetPlayerMap(Target), Target, 2, 40, 8, 0, 0)
	SetPlayerFlag(Player, 96, 0)

End Sub

				SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 225, GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 225) + 1)
			End If
			SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10, 0)
			SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 12, 0)
		End If
	Next Loop
End If

End Sub

Sub Main(Player as Long)

'Coarse Ore => 
	If HasObj(Player, 216) >= 10 Then
			TakeObj(Player, 216, 10)
			GiveObj(Player, 221, 1)
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You've smelted 10 Coarse Ore into some Smelted Metal!", Yellow)
			Exit Sub
	Else
'Flawed Ore => 
		If HasObj(Player, 217) >= 5 Then
				TakeObj(Player, 217, 5)
				GiveObj(Player, 221, 1)
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You've smelted 5 Flawed Ore into some Smelted Metal!", Yellow)
				Exit Sub
		Else
'Pure Ore => 
			If HasObj(Player, 218) Then
				TakeObj(Player, 218, 1)
				GiveObj(Player, 221, 1)
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You've smelted a Pure Ore into some Smelted Metal!", Yellow)
				Exit Sub
			Else
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You require 1 Pure Ore, 5 Flawed Ores or 10 Coarse Ore to smelt into Metal.", White)
			End If
		End If
	End If
	
End Sub

			Else
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You dont have enough Smelted Metal to smith that.", Grey)
			End If
		Case 2
			If HasObj(Player, Metal) >= 25 Then
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You smithed a Protection Ring!", Yellow)
				TakeObj(Player, Metal, 25)
				GiveObj(Player, 214, 1)
			Else
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You dont have enough Smelted Metal to smith that.", Grey)
			End If
		Case 3
			If HasObj(Player, Metal) >= 50 Then
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You smithed a Dragon Tooth!", Yellow)
				TakeObj(Player, Metal, 50)
				GiveObj(Player, 121, 1)
			Else
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You dont have enough Smelted Metal to smith that.", Grey)

			End If
		Case 4
			If HasObj(Player, Metal) >= 70 Then
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You smithed a Sun Blade!", Yellow)
				TakeObj(Player, Metal, 70)
				GiveObj(Player, 159, 1)

			End If
		Case 5

				TakeObj(Player, Metal, 100)
				GiveObj(Player, 135, 1)

Script Source=
Sub Main(Player as Long, Parm1 as Long)
dim Metal as Long, Slot as Long, A as Long

A = 0
For Slot = 1 To 20
	If GetPlayerInvObject(Player, Slot) = 0 Then
		A = A + 1
	End If
Next Slot
If A = 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You have no room in your inventory to smith.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
Metal = 221

Select Case Parm1
	Case 0
		PlayerMessage(Player, "=Smithing Menu=", Yellow)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "1. Claymore - 35 Metals", Grey)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "2. Battle Axe - 28 Metals", Grey)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "3. Morning Star - 24 Metals", Grey)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "4. Rapier - 17 Metals", Grey)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "5. War Mace - 14 Metals", Grey)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "6. Scimitar - 8 Metals", Grey)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "Type /smith # to smith an item.", White)
	Case 1
		If HasObj(Player, Metal) >= 35 Then
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You smithed a Claymore!", Yellow)
			TakeObj(Player, Metal, 35)
			GiveObj(Player, 28, 1)
		Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You dont have enough Smelted Metal to smith that.", Grey)
		End If
	Case 2
		If HasObj(Player, Metal) >= 28 Then
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You smithed a Battle Axe!", Yellow)
			TakeObj(Player, Metal, 28)
			GiveObj(Player, 2, 1)
		Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You dont have enough Smelted Metal to smith that.", Grey)
		End If
	Case 3
		If HasObj(Player, Metal) >= 24 Then
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You smithed a Morning Star!", Yellow)
			TakeObj(Player, Metal, 24)
			GiveObj(Player, 8, 1)
		Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You dont have enough Smelted Metal to smith that.", Grey)
		End If
	Case 4
		If HasObj(Player, Metal) >= 17 Then
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You smithed a Rapier!", Yellow)
			TakeObj(Player, Metal, 17)
			GiveObj(Player, 22, 1)
		Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You dont have enough Smelted Metal to smith that.", Grey)
		End If
	Case 5
		If HasObj(Player, Metal) >= 14 Then
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You smithed a War Mace!", Yellow)
			TakeObj(Player, Metal, 14)
			GiveObj(Player, 3, 1)
		Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You dont have enough Smelted Metal to smith that.", Grey)
		End If
	Case 6
		If HasObj(Player, Metal) >= 8 Then
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You smithed a Scimitar!", Yellow)
			TakeObj(Player, Metal, 8)
			GiveObj(Player, 17, 1)
		Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You dont have enough Smelted Metal to smith that.", Grey)
		End If
	Case Else
		PlayerMessage(Player, "That is not a valid option.", Grey)
End Select

End Sub

Name=smithhigh

Script Source=
Function Main(Player as Long, Parm1 as Long) AS LONG
dim Metal as Long, Slot as Long, A as Long

A = 0
For Slot = 1 To 20
	If GetPlayerInvObject(Player, Slot) = 0 Then
		A = A + 1
	End If
Next Slot
If A = 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You have no room in your inventory to smith.", Grey)
	Exit Function
End If

Metal = 448

If GetPlayerMap(Player) = 174 Then
	Select Case Parm1
		Case 0
			PlayerMessage(Player, "=Smithing Menu=", Yellow)
			PlayerMessage(Player, "1. Soulbinders - 10 Metals", Grey)
			PlayerMessage(Player, "2. Crown of Zeugg - 15 Metals", Grey)
			PlayerMessage(Player, "3. Ztiwhborflail - 25 Metals", Grey)
			PlayerMessage(Player, "4. Hero's Guard - 30 Metals", Grey)
			PlayerMessage(Player, "5. Repair Hero's Guard - 3 Metals", Grey)
			PlayerMessage(Player, " - This will repair the first Hero's Guard to appear in your inventory, and will not repair any if equipped.", Grey)
'			PlayerMessage(Player, "smith # to smith an item", Grey)
		Case 1
			If HasObj(Player, Metal) >= 10 Then
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You smithed some Soulbinders!", Yellow)
				TakeObj(Player, Metal, 10)
				GiveObj(Player, 117, 1)
			Else
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You dont have enough Devilkin Metal to smith that.", Grey)
			End If
		Case 2
			If HasObj(Player, Metal) >= 15 Then
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You smithed a Crown of Zeugg!", Yellow)
				TakeObj(Player, Metal, 15)
				GiveObj(Player, 197, 1)
			Else
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You dont have enough Devilkin Metal to smith that.", Grey)
			End If
		Case 3
			If HasObj(Player, Metal) >= 25 Then
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You smithed a Ztiwhborflail!", Yellow)
				TakeObj(Player, Metal, 25)
				GiveObj(Player, 250, 1)
			Else
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You dont have enough Devilkin Metal to smith that.", Grey)

			End If
		Case 4
			If HasObj(Player, Metal) >= 30 Then
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You smithed a Hero's Guard!", Yellow)
				TakeObj(Player, Metal, 30)
				GiveObj(Player, 248, 1)
			Else
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You dont have enough Devilkin Metal to smith that.", Grey)
			End If
		Case 5
			If HasObj(Player, 248) Then
				If HasObj(Player, Metal) >= 3 Then
					PlayerMessage(Player, "You have repaired a Hero's Guard!", Yellow)
					TakeObj(Player, Metal, 3)
					RunScript1("repairheros", Player)
				Else
					PlayerMessage(Player, "You dont have enough Devilkin Metal to repair that.", Grey)
				End If
			Else
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You dont have a Hero's Guard to repair.", Grey)
			End If
	End Select
Else
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must be in a blacksmiths to smith.", Grey)
End If

End Function

Script Source=
Sub Main(Player as Long, Parm1 as Long)
dim Metal as Long

Metal = 221

Select Case Parm1
	Case 0
		PlayerMessage(Player, "=Repair Menu=", Yellow)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "1. Hero's Guard - 30 Metals", Grey)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "2. Soulbinders - 10 Metals", Grey)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "Type /smith # to repair an item.", White)
	Case 1
		If HasObj(Player, Metal) >= 30 Then
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You repair a Hero's Guard!", Yellow)
			TakeObj(Player, Metal, 30)
			TakeObj(Player, 248, 1)
			GiveObj(Player, 248, 1)
		Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You dont have enough Smelted Metal to repair that.", Grey)
		End If
	Case 2
		If HasObj(Player, Metal) >= 10 Then
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You repair some Soulbinders!", Yellow)
			TakeObj(Player, Metal, 10)
			TakeObj(Player, 117, 1)
			GiveObj(Player, 117, 1)
		Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You dont have enough Smelted Metal to repair that.", Grey)
		End If
	Case Else
		PlayerMessage(Player, "That is not a valid option.", Grey)
End Select

End Sub

Name=snowballkill

Script Source=
Sub Main(Killer as Long, Killed as Long)

If GetPlayerFlag(Killer, 11) = 1 Then
	SetPlayerFlag(Killer, 11, 0)
	SetPlayerSprite(Killer, 34)
	RunScript1("Restore", Killer)
	SetPlayerFlag(Killer, 12, GetPlayerFlag(Killer, 12) + 1)

	SetPlayerFlag(Killed, 11, 1)
	SetPlayerSprite(Killed, 113)
	RunScript1("Restore", Killed)
	MapMessage(620, strcat(GetPlayerName(Killer), strcat(" tags ", strcat(GetPlayerName(Killed), "!"))), Yellow)
Else
	SetPlayerFlag(Killer, 12, GetPlayerFlag(Killer, 12) + 1)
End If

End Sub

Name=SOC

Script Source=
Function Main(player as long) as long
dim a as long

	GlobalMessage("A Free For All Carnage has started!", 9)
	GlobalMessage("Map: Killing Zone",white)

SetFlag(82, 0)
For A = 1 to GetMaxUsers()
	If IsPlaying(A) Then
		If GetPlayerMap(A) = 68 Then
			If GetPlayerAccess(A) = 0 Then
				SetPlayerFlag(A, 5, GetPlayerGuild(A))
				SetPlayerFlag(A, 10, 1)
				SetPlayerStatus(A, 9)
				SetPlayerGuild(A, 0)
				SetPlayerSprite(A, 196)
				PlayerWarp(A, 1954, Random(4) + 5, Random(5) + 3)
			Else
				PlayerWarp(A, 1954, 0, 0)
			End If
		End If
	End If
Next A

End Function

Name=space

Script Source=
function main(player as long) as long
dim a as long, b as long, c as long, d as long

globalmessage("A Random Team Carnage has started!",brightblue)
globalmessage("Map: Team Space Carnage",white)

b = 0
c = 0
d = 0
setflag(60,0)
setflag(61,0)

'========Teams=======

for a = 1 to getmaxusers

If getplayermap(a)= 68 then
if getplayeraccess(a) = 0 then
b = random(1)

if b = 0 then

if c >= d then
SetPlayerFlag(A, 5, GetPlayerGuild(A))
SetPlayerGuild(A, 30)
SetPlayerSprite(A, 114)
d = d + 1
setflag(61,getflag(61) + 1)
else
SetPlayerFlag(A, 5, GetPlayerGuild(A))
SetPlayerGuild(A, 31)
SetPlayerSprite(A, 113)
c = c + 1
setflag(60,getflag(60) + 1)
end if

else

if c < d then
SetPlayerFlag(A, 5, GetPlayerGuild(A))
SetPlayerGuild(A, 31)
SetPlayerSprite(A, 113)
c = c + 1
setflag(60,getflag(60) + 1)
else
SetPlayerFlag(A, 5, GetPlayerGuild(A))
SetPlayerGuild(A, 30)
SetPlayerSprite(A, 114)
d = d + 1
setflag(61,getflag(61) + 1)
end if

end if
else
end if
else
end if

next a

'========Warp=======

for a = 1 to getmaxusers
if getplayermap(A) = 68 then
 If GetPlayerGuild(A) = 30 Then PlayerWarp(A, 610, 2, 6)
 If GetPlayerGuild(A) = 31 Then PlayerWarp(A, 613, 9, 5)
 If GetPlayerAccess(A) > 0 Then PlayerWarp(A, 610, 1, 1)
end if
next a

end function

Name=spacecarn

Script Source=
Function Main(Player as Long) AS LONG
dim Loop as Long, Team as Long

globalmessage("A Team Carnage has started!",brightblue)
globalmessage("Map: Team Space Carnage",white)
SetFlag(82, 0)

For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
	If IsPlaying(Loop) Then
		If GetPlayerMap(Loop) = 68 Then
			If GetPlayerAccess(Loop) > 0 Then
				PlayerWarp(Loop, 610, 1, 1)
			Else
				SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10, 2)
				SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 5, GetPlayerGuild(Loop))
				SetPlayerStatus(Loop, 9)
				If Team = 0 Then
					SetPlayerGuild(Loop, 100)
					SetPlayerSprite(Loop, 114)
					SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11, 1)
					PlayerWarp(Loop, 610, 2, 6)
					Team = 1
				Else
					SetPlayerGuild(Loop, 101)
					SetPlayerSprite(Loop, 113)
					SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11, 2)
					PlayerWarp(Loop, 613, 9, 5)
					Team = 0
				End If
			End If
		End If
	End If
Next Loop

End Function

Name=spell123

Script Source=
Function Main(Player as Long) AS LONG
Dim Map as Long, X as Long, Y as Long
Dim CalcX as Long, CalcY as Long
Dim Mana as Long, Loop as Long

Mana = 35
Map = GetPlayerMap(Player)
X = GetPlayerX(Player)
Y = GetPlayerY(Player)

If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 28) > 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must wait to cast again.", Grey)
	Exit Function
End If
If GetPlayerMana(Player) < Mana Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must regenerate before casting.", Grey)
	Exit Function
End If
	SetPlayerFlag(Player, 28, 1)
	RunScript1("BuffCooldown", Player)
	SetPlayerMana(Player, GetPlayerMana(Player) - Mana)
	CreatePlayerFloatText(Player, "Con Fun Dere!", BrightGreen)
For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
	If IsPlaying(Loop) Then
		If Map = GetPlayerMap(Loop) Then
			If Loop <> Player Then
				CalcX = Abs(GetPlayerX(Loop) - X)
				CalcY = Abs(GetPlayerY(Loop) - Y)
				If CalcX < 4 & CalcY < 4 Then
					If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 23) = 0 Then
						SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 23, 1)
						SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 27, 1)
						SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 28, 1)
						RunScript1("SpellCooldown", Loop)
						RunScript1("InvisCooldown", Loop)
						RunScript1("BuffCooldown", Loop)
						PlayerMessage(Loop, "You have been silenced!", Grey)
						CreateCharacterEffect(Map, Loop, 21, 40, 8, 0, 0)
					End If
				End If
			End If
		End If
	End If
Next Loop

End Function

Script Source=
Sub Main(Player as Long)
Dim A as Long, CalcX as Long, CalcY as Long, Mana as Long
Dim CurrentMap as Long, CurrentX as Long, CurrentY as Long
'Mage Spell - Drain

CurrentMap = GetPlayerMap(Player)
CurrentX = GetPlayerX(Player)
CurrentY = GetPlayerY(Player)

If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 23) > 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must wait to cast again.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If

SetPlayerFlag(Player, 23, 1)
RunScript1("SpellCooldown", Player)
CreatePlayerFloatText(Player, "By Zag Ma!", BrightGreen)

For A = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
	If IsPlaying(A) Then
		If A <> Player Then
			If GetPlayerMap(A) = GetPlayerMap(Player) Then
				If GetPlayerIsDead(A) = 1 Then
					CalcX = Abs(GetPlayerX(A) - CurrentX)
					CalcY = Abs(GetPlayerY(A) - CurrentY)
					If CalcX < 3 & CalcY < 3 Then
						Mana = GetPlayerMana(A)
						SetPlayerMana(Player, GetPlayerMana(Player) + Mana)
						If GetPlayerMana(Player) > GetPlayerMaxMana(Player) Then SetPlayerMana(Player, GetPlayerMaxMana(Player))
						CreateCharacterEffect(GetPlayerMap(A), A, 51, 40, 8, 0, 0)
					End If
				End If
			End If
		End If
	End If
Next A
	
End Sub

Name=spell130

Script Source=
Function Main(Player as Long) AS LONG
dim Map as Long, X as Long, Y as Long, CalcX as Long, CalcY as Long
dim Mana as Long, Loop as Long, Att as Long, Att2 as Long
'Mage Guild Warp

Mana = 45
Map = GetPlayerMap(Player)
X = GetPlayerX(Player)
Y = GetPlayerY(Player)
Att = GetTileAtt(Map, X, Y)
Att2 = GetTileAtt2(Map, X, Y)

If Map = 1423 | Map = 1424 | Map = 1425 | Map = 1826 | Map = 1949 | Map = 1828 | Map = 1829 | Map = 982 | Att = 5 | Att = 6 | Att = 8 | Att = 11 | Att = 13 | Att2 = 5 | Att2 = 6 | Att2 = 11 | Att2 = 13 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You cannot cast that here.", Grey)
	Exit Function
End If

If GetPlayerGuild(Player) > 0 Then
	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 23) = 0 Then
		If GetPlayerMana(Player) >= Mana Then
			SetPlayerMana(Player, GetPlayerMana(Player) - Mana)
			SetPlayerFlag(Player, 23, 1)
			RunScript1("SpellCooldown", Player)
			CreatePlayerFloatText(Player, "Gek Ommen!", BrightGreen)
			CreateCharacterEffect(Map, Player, 12, 40, 8, 0, 0)
			For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
				If Loop <> Player Then
					If GetPlayerGuild(Loop) = GetPlayerGuild(Player) Then
						If GetPlayerMap(Loop) = Map Then
							CalcX = Abs(X - GetPlayerX(Loop))
							CalcY = Abs(Y - GetPlayerY(Loop))
							
							If CalcX < 3 & CalcY < 3 Then
								CreateTileEffect(GetPlayerMap(Loop), GetPlayerX(Loop), GetPlayerY(Loop), 12, 40, 8, 0, 0)
								PlayerWarp(Loop, Map, X, Y)
								PlayerMessage(Loop, strcat("You have been warped to ", GetPlayerName(Player)), White)
							End If
						End If
					End If
				End If
			Next Loop
		Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You must regenerate before casting.", Grey)
		End If
	Else
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You must wait to cast again.", Grey)
	End If
Else
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must be in a guild to cast this spell.", Grey)
End If

End Function

				CalcY = Abs(GetPlayerY(Loop) - Y)
				If CalcX < 4 & CalcY < 4 Then
					Health = Divide(GetPlayerHP(Loop), 10)
					SetPlayerHP(Loop, GetPlayerHP(Loop) - Health)
					SetPlayerHP(Player, GetPlayerHP(Player) + Health)
					If GetPlayerHP(Player) > GetPlayerMaxHP(Player) Then SetPlayerHP(Player, GetPlayerMaxHP(Player))
					CreateCharacterEffect(GetPlayerMap(Loop), Loop, 51, 40, 8, 0, 0)
				End If
			End If
		End If
	End If
Next Loop

End Sub

if getplayerdirection(player)=3 then x = x + 1

next B

if getplayery(players)=y then
if player <> players then

AttackPlayer(Player,players,dmg)

end if
end if
end if
next players
outss:
next i

x = getplayerx(player)
y = getplayery(player)
for i = 0 to 5

goto outs

if y=-1 then

Name=spell179

Script Source=
Sub Main(Player AS LONG)
'Thief - Quick Strike
	Dim Dir AS LONG, DestDir AS LONG
	Dim Map AS LONG, StartX AS LONG, StartY AS LONG
	Dim CheckX AS LONG, CheckY AS LONG
	Dim DestX AS LONG, DestY AS LONG
	Dim Damage AS LONG, Mana AS LONG
	
	Map = GetPlayerMap(Player)
	StartX = GetPlayerX(Player)
	StartY = GetPlayerY(Player)
	Dir = GetPlayerDirection(Player)
'	If HasObj(Player, 298) = 0 Then Mana = 50 Else Mana = 1
	Mana = GetPlayerMaxMana(Player)
	Select Case Dir
		Case 0 'Up
			CheckX = StartX
			CheckY = StartY - 1
			DestX = CheckX
			DestY = CheckY - 1
			DestDir = 1
		Case 1 'Down
			CheckX = StartX
			CheckY = StartY + 1
			DestX = CheckX
			DestY = CheckY + 1
			DestDir = 0
		Case 2 'Left
			CheckX = StartX - 1
			CheckY = StartY
			DestX = CheckX - 1
			DestY = CheckY
			DestDir = 3
		Case 3 'Right
			CheckX = StartX + 1
			CheckY = StartY
			DestX = CheckX + 1
			DestY = CheckY
			DestDir = 2
	End Select
	
	'Check bounds, if an invalid place to check then exit the script
	If CheckX < 0 | CheckY < 0 | CheckX > 11 | CheckY > 11 Then Exit Sub
	If DestX < 0 | DestY < 0 | DestX > 11 | DestY > 11 Then Exit Sub
	If GetPlayerMana(Player) < Mana Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You must regenerate before casting again.", Grey)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	If GetTileAtt(GetPlayerMap(Player), DestX, DestY) = 5 | GetTileAtt(GetPlayerMap(Player), DestX, DestY) = 11 | GetTileAtt(GetPlayerMap(Player), DestX, DestY) = 17 Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You cannot cast that here.", Grey)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	Dim A AS LONG
	For A = 1 to GetMaxUsers
		If IsPlaying(A) & GetPlayerAccess(A) = 0 Then
			If GetPlayerMap(A) = Map & GetPlayerX(A) = CheckX & GetPlayerY(A) = CheckY Then
				If GetTileIsVacant(Map, DestX, DestY) = True Then
					If GetTileNoDirectionalWalls(Map, StartX, StartY, Dir) = True & GetTileNoDirectionalWalls(Map, CheckX, CheckY, Dir) = True & GetTileNoDirectionalWalls(Map, DestX, DestY, DestDir) = True Then
						If Dir = GetPlayerDirection(A) Then
							Damage = GetPlayerDamage(Player) + Divide(GetPlayerDamage(Player), 3)
							CreateCharacterEffect(GetPlayerMap(A), A, 38, 60, 8, 0, 0)
						Else
							If (Dir = 0 & GetPlayerDirection(A) = 1) | (Dir = 1 & GetPlayerDirection(A) = 0) | (Dir = 2 & GetPlayerDirection(A) = 3) | (Dir = 3 & GetPlayerDirection(A) = 2) Then
								PlayerMessage(Player, "Your opponent is aware of your intent.", Grey)
								Exit Sub
							Else
								Damage = GetPlayerDamage(Player) + Divide(GetPlayerDamage(Player), 5)
								CreateCharacterEffect(GetPlayerMap(A), A, 66, 60, 8, 0, 0)
							End If
						End If
						AttackPlayer(Player, A, Damage)
						PlayerWarp(Player, Map, DestX, DestY)
						SetPlayerDirection(Player, DestDir)
						SetPlayerMana(Player, GetPlayerMana(Player) - Mana)
						Exit Sub
					End If
				End If
			End If
		End If
	Next A
	
	For A = 0 to 5
		If GetMonsterType(Map, A) > 0 & GetMonsterX(Map, A) = CheckX & GetMonsterY(Map, A) = CheckY Then
			If GetTileIsVacant(Map, DestX, DestY) = True Then
				If GetTileNoDirectionalWalls(Map, StartX, StartY, Dir) = True & GetTileNoDirectionalWalls(Map, CheckX, CheckY, Dir) = True & GetTileNoDirectionalWalls(Map, DestX, DestY, DestDir) = True Then
					If (Dir = 0 & GetMonsterDirection(Map, A) = 1) | (Dir = 1 & GetMonsterDirection(Map, A) = 0) | (Dir = 2 & GetMonsterDirection(Map, A) = 3) | (Dir = 3 & GetMonsterDirection(Map, A) = 2) Then
						PlayerMessage(Player, "Your opponent is aware of your intent.", Grey)
						Exit Sub
					Else
						PlayerWarp(Player, Map, DestX, DestY)
						SetPlayerDirection(Player, DestDir)
						Damage = GetPlayerDamage(Player) + Divide(GetPlayerDamage(Player), 4)
	'					AttackMonster(Player, A, Damage)
						SetPlayerMana(Player, GetPlayerMana(Player) - Mana)
						Exit Sub
					End If
				End If
			End If
		End If
	Next A
End Sub

								SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 25, 1)
								SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 19, GetPlayerSprite(Loop))
								SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 20, GetPlayerStatus(Loop))
								SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 21, GetPlayerX(Loop))
								SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 22, GetPlayerY(Loop))
								SetPlayerStatus(Loop, 9)
								SetPlayerSprite(Loop, 255)
								Timer(Loop, 20, "TurnVisible")
								Timer(Loop, 1, "Invis1")
								Gate = 1
							End If
						else
							PlayerMessage(Player, "You must be in the same guild as your target.", Grey)
						end if
					else
						PlayerMessage(Player, "You must be in the same guild as your target.", Grey)
					end if
				Else
					PlayerMessage(Player, "Target cannot hide yet.", Grey)
				End If
			End If
		End If
	End If
Next Loop
If Gate = 1 Then 'Worked
	CreateCharacterEffect(GetPlayerMap(Player), Player, 61, 40, 8, 0, 0)
	CreateTileEffect(GetPlayerMap(Player), X, Y, 57, 40, 8, 0, 0)
Else
	CreateTileEffect(GetPlayerMap(Player), X, Y, 52, 40, 8, 0, 0)
End If

End Sub
