Script Source=
Sub Main(Player as Long)
	Dim Count as Long, Energy as Long, XCoord as Long, YCoord as Long, Loop as Long
	'Area of Effect - Sacrafice Energy
	If GetPlayerMap(Player) = 1427 | GetPlayerMap(Player) = 1828 | GetPlayerMap(Player) = 1829 Then Exit Sub

	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 213) = 1 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "Cooling down.", Grey)
	exit sub
	end if

	For Loop = 1 to GetMaxUsers()
		If IsPlaying(Loop) Then
			If GetPlayerMap(Loop) = GetPlayerMap(Player) Then
				XCoord = Abs(GetPlayerX(Loop) - GetPlayerX(Player))
				YCoord = Abs(GetPlayerY(Loop) - GetPlayerY(Player))
				If XCoord < 2 & YCoord < 2 Then
					If GetPlayerGuild(Player) > 0 Then
						If GetPlayerGuild(Player) = GetPlayerGuild(Loop) Then
							If Player <> Loop Then
								If GetPlayerAccess(Loop) = 0 Then
								Count = Count + 1
								End If
							End If
						End If
					End If
				End If
			End If
		End If
	Next Loop

	If Count > 0 Then
		Energy = Divide(GetPlayerEnergy(Player), Count)
		SetPlayerEnergy(Player, 0)
		CreatePlayerFloatText(Player, "Nike Tima!", BrightGreen)
			
		SetPlayerFlag(Player, 213, 1)
		Timer(Player, 60, "SACTIMER")

		For Loop = 1 to GetMaxUsers()
			If IsPlaying(Loop) Then
				If GetPlayerMap(Loop) = GetPlayerMap(Player) Then
					XCoord = Abs(GetPlayerX(Loop) - GetPlayerX(Player))
					YCoord = Abs(GetPlayerY(Loop) - GetPlayerY(Player))
					If XCoord < 2 & YCoord < 2 Then
						If Player <> Loop Then
							If GetPlayerAccess(Loop) = 0 Then
								If GetPlayerGuild(Player) > 0 Then
									If GetPlayerGuild(Player) = GetPlayerGuild(Loop) Then
										'SetPlayerEnergy(Loop, GetPlayerEnergy(Loop) + Energy)
										'If GetPlayerEnergy(Loop) > GetPlayerMaxEnergy(Loop) Then SetPlayerEnergy(Loop, GetPlayerMaxEnergy(Loop))
										'CreatePlayerFloatText(Loop, str(Energy), Yellow)
										CreateCharacterEffect(GetPlayerMap(Loop), Loop, 46, 50, 20, 1, 0)
										RunScript2("energy1", Loop, Energy)
										End If
									End If
								End If
							End If
						End If
					End If
				End If

		Next Loop
	End If

End Sub

	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must wait to cast again.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If

	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must regenerate before casting.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If

	If GetPlayerMap(Loop) = Map Then
		If GetPlayerGuild(Loop) = GetPlayerGuild(Player) Then
			CalcX = Abs(GetPlayerX(Loop) - X)
			CalcY = Abs(GetPlayerY(Loop) - Y)
			If CalcX < 4 & CalcY < 4 Then
				SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 19, GetPlayerSprite(Loop))
				SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 20, GetPlayerStatus(Loop))
				SetPlayerSprite(Loop, GetGuildSprite(GetPlayerGuild(Loop)))
				SetPlayerStatus(Loop, 9)
				SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 25, 1)
				Timer(Loop, 10, "TurnVisible3")
			End If
		End If
	End If
Next Loop

End Sub

For Loop = 1 to GetMaxUsers()
	If IsPlaying(Loop) Then
		If Map = GetPlayerMap(Loop) Then
			If GetPlayerClass(Loop) = 4 Then
				CalcX = Abs(GetPlayerX(Loop) - X)
				CalcY = Abs(GetPlayerY(Loop) - Y)
				If CalcX < 4 & CalcY < 4 Then
					If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 16) = 0 Then
						RunScript2("Buff3", Loop, Buff)
					Else
						If GetPlayerGuild(Player) > 0 Then
							If GetPlayerGuild(Player) = GetPlayerGuild(Loop) Then
								RunScript2("Buff3", Loop, Buff)
							End If
						Else
							SetPlayerFlag(Player, 16, 0)
							PlayerMessage(Player, "Your spells have been set to affect everyone.", White)
							RunScript2("Buff3", Loop, Buff)
						End If
					End If
				End If
			End If
		End If
	End If
Next Loop

End Sub

Script Source=

Sub Main(Player as Long)
Dim Effect as Long, Damage as Long, HP as Long
Dim XCoord as Long, YCoord as Long, Loop as Long, MonsterLoop as Long

'Area of Effect - Mage Spell - Arcane Rain
'effect = 59
Effect = 3
Damage = GetPlayerDamage(Player) + 5

SetPlayerFlag(Player, 23, 0)

For Loop = 1 to GetMaxUsers()
	If IsPlaying(Loop) Then
		If GetPlayerMap(Loop) = GetPlayerFlag(Player, 24) Then
			XCoord = Abs(GetPlayerX(Loop) - GetPlayerFlag(Player, 21))
			YCoord = Abs(GetPlayerY(Loop) - GetPlayerFlag(Player, 22))
			If XCoord < 2 & YCoord < 2 Then
				If Player <> Loop Then
					If GetPlayerAccess(Loop) = 0 Then
						
	'					HP = GetPlayerHP(Loop)
	'					If Abs(GetPlayerArmor(Loop, Damage)) >= HP Then Damage = HP - GetPlayerArmor(Loop, 1)
						MagicAttackPlayer(Player, Loop, Damage)
					End If
				End If
			End If
		End If
	End If
Next Loop

For XCoord = 1 to 3
	For YCoord = 1 to 3
		For MonsterLoop = 0 to 9
			If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 21) - 2 + XCoord = GetMonsterX(GetPlayerMap(Player), MonsterLoop) & GetPlayerFlag(Player, 22) - 2 + YCoord = GetMonsterY(GetPlayerMap(Player), MonsterLoop) Then
				MagicAttackMonster(Player, MonsterLoop, Damage)
			End If
		Next MonsterLoop
		CreateTileEffect(GetPlayerFlag(Player, 24), GetPlayerFlag(Player, 21) - 2 + Xcoord, GetPlayerFlag(Player, 22) - 2 + Ycoord, Effect, 33, 10, 0, 0)
	Next YCoord
Next XCoord

End Sub

				End If
			End If
		Next Mon
	Case 2
		For Mon = 0 To 5
			If GetMonsterX(Map, Mon) <= GetPlayerX(Player) Then
				If Abs(GetPlayerY(Player) - GetMonsterY(Map, Mon)) < 4 Then

						SetMonsterTarget(Map, Mon, Player)
					End If
				End If
			End If
		Next Mon
	Case 3
		For Mon = 0 To 5
			If GetMonsterX(Map, Mon) >= GetPlayerX(Player) Then
				If Abs(GetPlayerY(Player) - GetMonsterY(Map, Mon)) < 4 Then
					If GetMonsterType(Map, Mon) <> 104 Then

					End If
				End If
			End If
		Next Mon

Name=spell36

Script Source=

Function Main(Player as Long) AS LONG
'Store Command - Push
Dim Map as Long, StartX as Long, StartY as Long
Dim CheckX as Long, CheckY as Long, DestX as Long, DestY as Long
Dim Loop as Long

Map = GetPlayerMap(Player)
StartX = GetPlayerX(Player)
StartY = GetPlayerY(Player)

'if getplayerhp(player) <> getplayermaxhp(player) then
	'playermessage(player, "Push requires full hp to use.",white)
	'exit function
'end if

'Push timer - currently disabled
If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 109) > 0 Then Exit Function

If GetPlayerHP(Player) > Divide(GetPlayerMaxHP(Player), 2) Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must be below 50% health to cast this spell.", White)
	Exit Function
End If

If GetPlayerGuild(Player) = 0 Then
	playermessage(player, "You need to be in a guild.", grey)
	Exit function
end if

If GetPlayerEquipped(Player, 2) = 0 Then
	playermessage(player, "You cannot use this ability without a shield!", grey)
	Exit function
end if

'If HasObj(Player, 280) >= 1 Then
'	TakeObj(Player, 280, 4) 
'Else
'	PlayerMessage(Player, "You need Ancient Relics to cast this spell!", Grey)
	'Exit function
'End If


SetPlayerFlag(Player, 109, 1)
Timer(Player, 1, "PushTimer")
Select Case GetPlayerDirection(Player)
	Case Up
		CheckX = StartX
		CheckY = StartY - 1
		DestX = CheckX
		DestY = CheckY - 1
	Case Down
		CheckX = StartX
		CheckY = StartY + 1
		DestX = CheckX
		DestY = CheckY + 1
	Case Left
		CheckX = StartX - 1
		CheckY = StartY
		DestX = CheckX - 1
		DestY = CheckY
	Case Right
		CheckX = StartX + 1
		CheckY = StartY
		DestX = CheckX + 1
		DestY = CheckY
End Select

'Check bounds, if an invalid place to check then exit the script
If CheckX < 0 | CheckY < 0 | CheckX > 11 | CheckY > 11 Then Exit Function
If DestX < 0 | DestY < 0 | DestX > 11 | DestY > 11 Then Exit Function

If RunScript3("CheckAtt", Player, CheckX, CheckY) = Stop Then Exit Function
If RunScript3("CheckAtt2", Player, CheckX, CheckY) = Stop Then Exit Function
If RunScript3("CheckAtt", Player, DestX, DestY) = Stop Then Exit Function
If RunScript3("CheckAtt2", Player, DestX, DestY) = Stop Then Exit Function
'If GetTileAtt(Map, CheckX, CheckY) > 0 Then Exit function
'If GetTileAtt(Map, DestX, DestY) > 0 Then Exit function
'If GetTileAtt2(Map, CheckX, CheckY) > 0 Then Exit function
'If GetTileAtt2(Map, DestX, DestY) > 0 Then Exit function

For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
	If IsPlaying(Loop) Then
		If GetPlayerAccess(Loop) = 0 Then
			If GetPlayerMap(Loop) = Map Then
				If GetPlayerX(Loop) = CheckX Then
					If GetPlayerY(Loop) = CheckY Then 

'Target in position
						If GetPlayerHP(Loop) = GetPlayerMaxHP(Loop) Then 'Full HP
							PlayerWarp(Loop, Map, DestX, DestY)
						End If
					End If
				End If
			End If
		End If
	End If
Next Loop



End Function

		CreateTileEffect(Map, X, Y, 40, 30 + Random(20), 8, 0, 0)

				MagicAttackPlayer(Player, Player, 42)

	Next RangeY
	X = X + 1
	Y = GetMonsterY(1489, 0) - 1
Next RangeX

end if

Name=teamarena

Script Source=
Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim Loop as Long, X as Long, Y as Long
dim RedCount as Long, BlueCount as Long, RedGate as Long, BlueGate as Long

If GetPlayerMap(Player) = 1443 Then
	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 10) <> 13 Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You cannot start a Team Battle.", Grey)
		Exit Sub
	End If
Else
	PlayerMessage(Player, "This is not the Team Arena.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If

For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
	If GetPlayerMap(Loop) = 1443 Then
		If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10) = 13 Then
				If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11) = 1 Then RedCount = RedCount + 1
				If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11) = 2 Then BlueCount = BlueCount + 1
			X = GetPlayerX(Loop)
			Y = GetPlayerY(Loop)
			If Y = 1 Then
				If X = 0 | X = 1 Then RedGate = RedGate + 1
				If X = 10 | X = 11 Then BlueGate = BlueGate + 1
			End If
		End If
	End If
Next Loop

If RedGate < 2 | BlueGate < 2 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "There are not enough players on the start tiles.", White)
	Exit Sub
End If

MapMessage(1443, strcat("A Team Battle has started - ", strcat(str(RedCount), strcat("v", str(BlueCount)))), Yellow)
SetFlag(153, 1)
For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
	If GetPlayerMap(Loop) = 1443 Then
		If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10) = 13 Then
			If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11) = 1 Then PlayerWarp(Loop, 1443, 3 + Random(3), 1 + Random(3))
			If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11) = 2 Then PlayerWarp(Loop, 1443, 8 - Random(3), 6 - Random(3))
		End If
	End If
Next Loop

End Sub

		Exit Sub
	Case 1
		CarnScript = "FortressCarn"

	Case 3
		CarnScript = "SwampCarn"
	Case 4
		CarnScript = "SpaceCarn"
	Case 5
		CarnScript = "CavernCarn"
	Case 6
		CarnScript = "CityCarn"

	RunScript1(CarnScript, Player)
Else
	Timer(1, Time, CarnScript)
	PlayerMessage(Player, strcat(CarnScript, strcat(" runs in ", strcat(str(Time), " seconds."))), White)
End If

Function Main(Killer as Long, Killed as Long) AS LONG
dim Loop as Long, Count1 as Long, Count2 as Long

RunScript1("GameWarp", Killed)
RunScript1("Restore", Killed)
SetPlayerFlag(Killed, 10, 0)
SetPlayerFlag(Killed, 11, 0)
SetPlayerGuild(Killed, GetPlayerFlag(Killed, 5))
RunScript1("Sprite", Killed)

For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
	If IsPlaying(Loop) Then
		If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10) = 2 Then
			If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11) = 1 Then Count1 = Count1 + 1
			If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11) = 2 Then Count2 = Count2 + 1
		End If
	End If
Next Loop

If Count1 = 0 Then
	GlobalMessage(strcat(strcat(GetPlayerName(Killer), " has slain "), strcat(GetPlayerName(Killed), " and won Team Carnage!")), BrightGreen)
	For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
		If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10) = 2 Then
			If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11) = 2 Then
				RunScript1("GameWarp", Loop)
				RunScript1("Restore", Loop)
				GiveObj(Loop, 484, 1)
				SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10, 0)
				SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11, 0)
				SetPlayerGuild(Loop, GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 5))
				RunScript1("Sprite", Loop)
			End If
		End If
	Next Loop
Else
	If Count2 = 0 Then
		GlobalMessage(strcat(strcat(GetPlayerName(Killer), " has slain "), strcat(GetPlayerName(Killed), " and won Team Carnage!")), BrightGreen)
		For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
			If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10) = 2 Then
				If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11) = 1 Then
					RunScript1("GameWarp", Loop)
					RunScript1("Restore", Loop)
					GiveObj(Loop, 483, 1)
					SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10, 0)
					SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11, 0)
					SetPlayerGuild(Loop, GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 5))
					RunScript1("Sprite", Loop)
				End If
			End If
		Next Loop
	Else
		If GetPlayerFlag(Killer, 11) = 1 Then
			GlobalMessage(strcat(strcat(GetPlayerName(Killer), " has slain "), strcat(GetPlayerName(Killed), " in Team Carnage!")), BrightRed)
		Else
			GlobalMessage(strcat(strcat(GetPlayerName(Killer), " has slain "), strcat(GetPlayerName(Killed), " in Team Carnage!")), BrightBlue)
		End If
	End If
End If

End Function

		If GetPlayerMap(Loop) = Map Then
			If GetPlayerX(Loop) = X & GetPlayerY(Loop) = Y Then
				If Player = Loop Then
					Energy = Divide(GetPlayerEnergy(Loop), 10)

				'Else
					'MagicAttackPlayer(Player, Loop, Damage - 10)
				End If
			End If
		End If
	End If
Next Loop

FUNCTION Main(Player AS LONG, found AS LONG, hit AS LONG) AS LONG
'Global Variables

Dim x AS LONG

'Player
Dim map AS LONG
Dim playerx AS LONG
Dim playery AS LONG

Playerx = GetPlayerX(Player)
Playery = GetPlayerY(Player)

'Other Player
Dim map1 AS LONG
DIm Playerx1 AS LONG
Dim Playery1 AS LONG
map1 = GetPLayerMap(found)
Playerx1 = GetPlayerX(found)
Playery1 = GetPlayerY(found)


If map = map1 Then
 'effect
 For a = -1 to 1
  CreateTileEffect(Map, PlayerX1 + a, PlayerY1, 8, 100, 5, 0, 0)
  CreateTileEffect(Map, PlayerX1, PlayerY1 + a, 8, 100, 5, 0, 0)
 Next a

 'damage

  For a = 0 to GetMaxUsers
   If Abs(PlayerX1 - GetPlayerX(a)) <= 1 & Abs(PlayerY1 - GetPlayerY(a)) <= 1 & GetPlayerMap(Player) = GetPlayerMap(a) Then AttackPlayer(PLayer, a, hit)
  Next a

End IF

Function main(player as long) as long
Dim a as long, b as long, c as long, d as long
b = getmaxusers()
d = getmapplayercount(1563)
c = random(d)


Dim SkipCounter as Long
SkipCounter = 0
For A = 1 to GetMaxUsers()
   If GetPlayerMap(A) = 1563 Then
      If SkipCounter >= C Then
         SetMonsterTarget(1563, 1, A)
         mapmessage(1563, StrCat("The Touch of Death has been commanded to attack ", GetPlayerName(A)), white)
         Timer(A, 15, "todattack")
         Exit Function
      End If
      SkipCounter = SkipCounter + 1
   End If
Next A

'If the script got here, we didn't find a target
ResetMap(1563)

main = continue
End Function

				PlayerWarp(Loop, 1883, 2, 6)
				Timer(Loop, 2, "TournamentRound2")
				Exit Sub
			End If
		End If
	Next Loop
End If

If GetFlag(172) = 0 Then
	For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
		If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10) = 14 Then
			If GetFlag(171) = Loop Then
				MapMessage(1883, strcat(GetPlayerName(Loop), " wins by default!"), Yellow)
				PlayerWarp(Loop, 1883, 2, 6)
				Timer(Loop, 2, "TournamentRound2")
				Exit Sub
			End If
		End If
	Next Loop
End If

For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
	If GetPlayerMap(Loop) = 1883 Then
		If GetFlag(171) = Loop Then
			SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 5, GetPlayerGuild(Loop))
			SetPlayerGuild(Loop, 0)
			SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11, 1)
			PlayerWarp(Loop, 1883, 2, 1)
			First = Loop
		End If
		If GetFlag(172) = Loop Then
			SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 5, GetPlayerGuild(Loop))
			SetPlayerGuild(Loop, 0)
			SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11, 1)
			PlayerWarp(Loop, 1883, 9, 4)
			Second = Loop
		End If
	End If
Next Loop

Name=tournamentstart

Script Source=
Sub Main()
dim Loop as Long, Flag as Long
dim Count as Long

Count = 0
If GetFlag(171) = 0 Then
	For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
		If GetPlayerMap(Loop) = 1883 Then
			For Flag = 171 To 178
				If GetFlag(Flag) = Loop Then Count = Count + 1
			Next Flag
			If Count = 0 Then
				PlayerWarp(Loop, 1883, 2, 6)
				SetFlag(171, Loop)
				GoTo EndLoop1
			End If
		End If
	Next Loop
	If GetFlag(171) = 0 Then
		If GetFlag(172) > 0 Then
			'Player 1 Forfeits
			'Player 2 Wins by Default
		Else
			'Tournament Reset, not enough players
		End If
	End If
End If
EndLoop1:

Count = 0
If GetFlag(172) = 0 Then
	For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
		If GetPlayerMap(Loop) = 1883 Then
			For Flag = 171 To 178
				If GetFlag(Flag) = Loop Then Count = Count + 1
			Next Flag
			If Count = 0 Then
				PlayerWarp(Loop, 1883, 2, 8)
				SetFlag(172, Loop)
				GoTo EndLoop2
			End If
		End If
	Next Loop
	If GetFlag(172) = 0 Then
		'Player 2 Forfeits
		'Player 1 Wins by Default
	End If
End If
EndLoop2:

For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
	If GetPlayerMap(Loop) = 1883 Then
		If GetFlag(171) = Loop Then PlayerWarp(Loop, 1883, 2, 1)
		If GetFlag(172) = Loop Then PlayerWarp(Loop, 1883, 9, 4)
	End If
Next Loop

End Sub

*******************************************************
Name=tournamentwarp

Script Source=
Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim Flag as Long, Count as Long, Cost as Long
Cost = GetFlag(180)

If GetFlag(170) > 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "A Tournament is already in progress.", Grey)
'	PlayerWarp(Player, 1883, GetPlayerX(Player), 11)
	RunScript1("GameWarp", Player)
	Exit Sub
End If

If GetFlag(80) = 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "The tournament arena is closed.", Grey)
	PlayerWarp(Player, 1883, GetPlayerX(Player), 11)
	Exit Sub
End If

If HasObj(Player, 6) < Cost Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, strcat("You require ", strcat(str(Cost), " Gold to enter this Tournament.")), Grey)
	PlayerWarp(Player, 1883, GetPlayerX(Player), 11)
	Exit Sub
End If

Count = 0
For Flag = 171 To 178
	If GetFlag(Flag) = 0 Then
		Select Case Flag
			Case 171
				PlayerWarp(Player, 1883, 2, 6)
			Case 172
				PlayerWarp(Player, 1883, 2, 8)
			Case 173
				PlayerWarp(Player, 1883, 4, 6)
			Case 174
				PlayerWarp(Player, 1883, 4, 8)
			Case 175
				PlayerWarp(Player, 1883, 6, 6)
			Case 176
				PlayerWarp(Player, 1883, 6, 8)
			Case 177
				PlayerWarp(Player, 1883, 8, 6)
			Case 178
				PlayerWarp(Player, 1883, 8, 8)
		End Select
		SetFlag(Flag, Player)
		SetPlayerFlag(Player, 10, 14)
		SetPlayerFlag(Player, 11, 0)
		TakeObj(Player, 6, Cost)
		SetFlag(179, GetFlag(179) + Cost)
		GoTo EndLoop
	End If
Next Flag
PlayerWarp(Player, 1883, GetPlayerX(Player), 11)

EndLoop:
For Flag = 171 To 178
	If GetFlag(Flag) > 0 Then Count = Count + 1
Next Flag

If Count = 8 Then
	MapMessage(1883, strcat("The Tournament Prize Pot is ", strcat(str(GetFlag(179)), " Gold!")), Yellow)
	RunScript0("TournamentRound1")
End If

End Sub

Sub Main(Player as Long, A as Long)
If GetFlag(40) = 0 Then
	If GetPlayerMap(Player) = 305 & GetPlayerX(Player) = 3 & GetPlayerY(Player) = 6 Then
		If GetPlayermap(A) = 305 & getplayerx(a) = 8 & getplayery(a) = 6 Then
			setflag(40, 1)
			'runscript1("begintrade", player)
			MapMessage(305,StrCat(StrCat(GetPlayerName(Player), " has gold: "), str(hasobj(Player,6))), BRIGHTGREEN)
			MapMessage(305,StrCat(StrCat(GetPlayerName(A), " has gold: "), str(hasobj(a,6))), BRIGHTGREEN)
			'timer(player, 60, "60seconds")
			'timer(player,90, "30seconds")
			timer(player,110, "10seconds")
			timer(player,120,"endtrade")
			playerwarp(player, 305, 1,3)
			playerwarp(a, 305, 10,3)
			playermessage(player, "PLEASE do not log off while trading!!", grey)
			mapmessage(305, "You have 2 minutes to complete the trade.", grey)
		Else
			playermessage(player, "Player must be in the correct place in the trading room!", grey)
		End If
	Else
		playermessage(player, "You must be in the correct place in the trading room!", grey)
	End If
End If

End Sub

Name=TRADESWITCH

Script Source=
Sub Main(Player as Long, A As Long)
	Dim B as Long, C as Long, D as Long, F as Long
	If GetPlayermap(Player) = 305 & getplayerx(Player) = 4 & getplayery(Player) = 1 Then
	If GetPlayermap(A) = 305 & getplayerx(a) = 7 & getplayery(a) = 1 Then
		Dim E As Long
		E = 0
		For B = 0 to 49
			C = GetObjX(305, B)
			D = GetObjY(305, B)
			F = GetObjNum(305, B)
			If F > 0 & C = 4 & D = 1 Then
				E = 1
			End If
			If F > 0 & C = 7 & D = 1 Then
				E = 1
			End If
		Next B
		
		If E = 1 Then
			MapMessage(305, "Do not drop items on the blue tiles.", WHITE)
		Else
			playerwarp(player, 305, 9,2)
			playerwarp(a, 305, 2,2)
		End If
	End If
	End If
End Sub

Sub Main(Player as Long, Target as Long)

If GetFlag(152) > 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "There is already a trade in progress.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If

If GetPlayerX(Player) = 3 & GetPlayerY(Player) = 7 Then
If GetPlayerX(Target) = 8 & GetPlayerY(Target) = 7 Then
	GoTo Warp
End If
End If

If GetPlayerX(Target) = 3 & GetPlayerY(Target) = 7 Then
	GoTo Warp
End If
End If

Exit Sub

PlayerWarp(Player, 554, 2, 3)
SetPlayerFlag(Player, 17, 1)
PlayerWarp(Target, 554, 9, 3)
SetPlayerFlag(Target, 17, 1)

SetFlag(152, 1)

End Sub

Name=ttd

Script Source=
Function Main(Player as Long) AS LONG
dim Loop as Long, Count as Long

Count = 0
SetFlag(82, 0)

For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
	If GetPlayerMap(Loop) = 68 Then
		If IsPlaying(Loop) Then
			If GetPlayerAccess(Loop) > 0 | GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 78) > 0 Then
				PlayerWarp(Loop, 1527, 4, 5)
			Else
			SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 5, GetPlayerGuild(Loop))
			SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10, 4)
				If Count < 3 Then
					PlayerWarp(Loop, 1525, 5, 5)
					SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11, 1)
					SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 12, 0)
					SetPlayerSprite(Loop, 19)
					SetPlayerGuild(Loop, 100)
					If GetPlayerLevel(Loop) >= 40 Then Count = Count + 1
				Else
					If GetPlayerLevel(Loop) >= 40 Then
						PlayerWarp(Loop, 1539, 5, 2)
						SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11, 2)
						SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 12, 1)
						SetPlayerSprite(Loop, 93)
						SetPlayerGuild(Loop, 101)
						CalculateStats(Loop)
						Count = 0
					Else
						PlayerWarp(Loop, 1525, 5, 5)
						SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11, 1)
						SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 12, 1)
						SetPlayerSprite(Loop, 19)
						SetPlayerGuild(Loop, 100)
					End If
				End If
			End If
		End If
	End If
Next Loop

End Function

Name=ttdkill

Script Source=
Function Main(Killer as Long, Killed as Long) AS LONG
dim Loop as Long, Count1 as Long, Count2 as Long

Select Case GetPlayerFlag(Killed, 11)
	Case 1
		If GetPlayerFlag(Killed, 12) > 0 Then
			PlayerWarp(Killed, 1525, 5, 5)
			SetPlayerSprite(Killed, 19)
			SetPlayerGuild(Killed, 100)
			SetPlayerHP(Killed, GetPlayerMaxHP(Killed))
			SetPlayerFlag(Killed, 12, GetPlayerFlag(Killed, 12) - 1)
		Else
			PlayerWarp(Killed, 8, 7, 9)
			RunScript1("GameWarp", Killed)
			GlobalMessage(strcat(GetPlayerName(Killed), " has been knocked out of Titan Takedown!"), Blue)
			SetPlayerFlag(Killed, 10, 0)
			SetPlayerFlag(Killed, 11, 0)
			SetPlayerGuild(Killed, GetPlayerFlag(Killed, 5))
			RunScript1("sprite", Killed)
		End If
	Case 2
		If GetPlayerFlag(Killed, 12) > 0 Then
			PlayerWarp(Killed, 1539, 5, 2)
			SetPlayerSprite(Killed, 93)
			SetPlayerGuild(Killed, 101)
			SetPlayerHP(Killed, GetPlayerMaxHP(Killed))
			SetPlayerFlag(Killed, 12, GetPlayerFlag(Killed, 12) - 1)
		Else
			PlayerWarp(Killed, 8, 7, 9)
			RunScript1("GameWarp", Killed)
			GlobalMessage(strcat(GetPlayerName(Killed), " has been knocked out of Titan Takedown!"), Red)
			SetPlayerFlag(Killed, 10, 0)
			SetPlayerFlag(Killed, 11, 0)
			SetPlayerGuild(Killed, GetPlayerFlag(Killed, 5))
			RunScript1("Sprite", Killed)
			CalculateStats(Killed)
		End If
End Select

Count1 = 0
Count2 = 0
For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
	If IsPlaying(Loop) Then
		If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10) = 4 Then
			If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11) = 1 Then Count1 = Count1 + 1
			If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11) = 2 Then Count2 = Count2 + 1
		End If
	End If
Next Loop
If Count1 = 0 Then
	GlobalMessage("The Titans have defended their ancient home!", BrightGreen)
	For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
		If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10) = 4 Then
			GiveObj(Loop, 484, 1)
			RunScript1("GameWarp", Loop)
			SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10, 0)
			SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11, 0)
			SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 12, 0)
			SetPlayerGuild(Loop, GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 5))
			RunScript1("Sprite", Loop)
			CalculateStats(Loop)
		End If
	Next Loop
End If
If Count2 = 0 Then
	GlobalMessage("The Invaders have defeated the Titans and conquered their fortress!", BrightGreen)
	For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
		If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10) = 4 Then
			GiveObj(Loop, 483, 1)
			RunScript1("GameWarp", Loop)
			SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10, 0)
			SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11, 0)
			SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 12, 0)
			SetPlayerGuild(Loop, GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 5))
			RunScript1("Sprite", Loop)
			CalculateStats(Loop)
		End If
	Next Loop
End If

End Function

Name=ttdteams

Script Source=
Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim Loop as Long, Message as String

GlobalMessage("==Titan Takedown Teams==", White)
Message = "Invaders - "
For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
	If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10) = 4 Then
		If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11) = 1 Then
			Message = strcat(Message, strcat(GetPlayerName(Loop), ", "))
		End If
	End If
Next Loop
GlobalMessage(Message, Red)
Message = "Titans - "
For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
	If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10) = 4 Then
		If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11) = 2 Then
			Message = strcat(Message, strcat(GetPlayerName(Loop), ", "))
		End If
	End If
Next Loop
GlobalMessage(Message, Yellow)
End Sub

Name=turnvisible

Script Source=
Sub Main(Player as Long)

If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 25) = 1 Then
	SetPlayerFlag(Player, 25, 0)
	SetPlayerFlag(Player, 27, 1)
	SetPlayerFlag(Player, 29, 0)
	RunScript1("InvisCooldown", Player)
	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 19) > 215 Then RunScript1("Sprite", Player) Else SetPlayerSprite(Player, GetPlayerFlag(Player, 19))
	If GetPlayerStatus(Player) = 1 Then Exit Sub
	SetPlayerStatus(Player, GetPlayerFlag(Player, 20))
	If GetPlayerStatus(Player) = 9 Then
		If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 10) = 0 Then
			SetPlayerStatus(Player, 0)
			SetPlayerFlag(Player, 20, 0)
		End If
	End If
End If

End Sub

Name=turnvisible2

Script Source=
Sub Main(Player as Long)

If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 25) = 1 Then
	SetPlayerStatus(Player, GetPlayerFlag(Player, 20))
	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 23) = 1 Then RunScript1("cooldown", Player)
	SetPlayerFlag(Player, 25, 0) 
	SetPlayerSprite(Player, 0)
	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 19) > 215 Then RunScript1("Sprite", Player) Else SetPlayerSprite(Player, GetPlayerFlag(Player, 19))
		If GetPlayerStatus(Player) = 1 Then Exit Sub
		SetPlayerStatus(Player, GetPlayerFlag(Player, 20))
		If GetPlayerStatus(Player) = 9 Then SetPlayerStatus(Player, 0)
End If

End Sub

Name=underworld

Script Source=
Function Main(player as long) as long
dim a as long

	GlobalMessage("A Free For All Carnage has started!", 9)
	GlobalMessage("Map: Underworld",white)
	  
SetFlag(82, 0)
For A = 1 to GetMaxUsers()
	If IsPlaying(A) Then
		If GetPlayerMap(A) = 68 Then
			If GetPlayerAccess(A) = 0 Then
				SetPlayerFlag(A, 5, GetPlayerGuild(A))
				SetPlayerFlag(A, 10, 1)
				SetPlayerStatus(A, 9)
				SetPlayerGuild(A, 0)
				SetPlayerSprite(A, 23)
				PlayerWarp(A, 1476, 3 + random(7), 3 + random(7))
			Else
				PlayerWarp(A, 1476, 2, 2)
			End If
		End If
	End If
Next A

End Function

Name=unfreeze

Script Source=
Function Main(Player as Long) AS LONG
dim Mon1 as Long, Mon2 as Long, Mon3 as Long, Mon4 as Long, Mon5 as Long, Mon6 as Long
SetPlayerFlag(Player, 4, 0)

If GetMonsterTarget(GetPlayerMap(Player), 0) = Player Then Mon1 = 1
If GetMonsterTarget(GetPlayerMap(Player), 1) = Player Then Mon2 = 1
If GetMonsterTarget(GetPlayerMap(Player), 2) = Player Then Mon3 = 1
If GetMonsterTarget(GetPlayerMap(Player), 3) = Player Then Mon4 = 1
If GetMonsterTarget(GetPlayerMap(Player), 4) = Player Then Mon5 = 1
If GetMonsterTarget(GetPlayerMap(Player), 5) = Player Then Mon6 = 1

If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 24) = GetPlayerMap(Player) & GetPlayerFlag(Player, 21) = GetPlayerX(Player) & GetPlayerFlag(Player, 22) = GetPlayerY(Player) Then
	PlayerWarp(Player, 2000, 5, 5)
	PlayerWarp(Player, GetPlayerFlag(Player, 24), GetPlayerFlag(Player, 21), GetPlayerFlag(Player, 22))
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You have been unfrozen.", Grey)
	If Mon1 = 1 Then SetMonsterTarget(GetPlayerMap(Player), 0, Player)
	If Mon2 = 1 Then SetMonsterTarget(GetPlayerMap(Player), 1, Player)
	If Mon3 = 1 Then SetMonsterTarget(GetPlayerMap(Player), 2, Player)
	If Mon4 = 1 Then SetMonsterTarget(GetPlayerMap(Player), 3, Player)
	If Mon5 = 1 Then SetMonsterTarget(GetPlayerMap(Player), 4, Player)
	If Mon6 = 1 Then SetMonsterTarget(GetPlayerMap(Player), 5, Player)
Else
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You aren't frozen, you dirty liar.", Grey)
End If

End Function

Name=USEOBJ196

Script Source=
FUNCTION Main(Player AS LONG) AS LONG
   Dim A as Long
   For A = 1 to 20
      If GetPlayerInvObject(Player,A) = 196 then
         If GetPlayerInvValue(Player,A) > 40 then
            PlayerMessage(Player,"Hey, that's a cheated weapon -- give me that!!",BrightRed)
            GlobalMessage(StrCat("A cheated staff has been removed from ", GetPlayerName(Player)), BrightRed)
            TakeObj(Player,196,1)
         End if
      End if
   Next A
   Main = Continue
END FUNCTION

Name=useobj255

Script Source=
Sub Main(Player as Long)

Select Case Random(5)
	Case 0
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You see a grand Tower to the South-East. It stands on a beach near a mountain range.", White)
	Case 1
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You see an ancient Pyramid to the West, through caves that run by water.", White)
	Case 2
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You see a decrepit Crypt to the North. It remains obscured from view beside a populus city.", White)
	Case 3
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You see a proud fortress to the West, standing amoung ruins.", White)
	Case 4
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You see a dark Abyss to the North-West, surrounded by salt water.", White)
End Select

End Sub

Name=useobj376

Script Source=
Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim Gate as Long
Gate = 0

If GetPlayerMap(Player) = 909 Then
	If GetPlayerX(Player) = 4 & GetPlayerY(Player) = 5 Then
		If GetPlayerDirection(Player) = Up Then
			Gate = 1
		End If
	End If
	If GetPlayerX(Player) = 5 & GetPlayerY(Player) = 4 Then
		If GetPlayerDirection(Player) = Left Then
			Gate = 1
		End If
	End If
End If

If Gate = 1 Then
	OpenDoor(909, 3, 4)
	OpenDoor(909, 4, 4)
	PlayerMessage(Player, "Sailor says, ''Lets go.''", Grey)
	TakeObj(Player, 376, 1)
Else
	PlayerMessage(Player, "One way ticket to Northcoast.", Grey)
End If

End Sub

Name=USEOBJ455

Script Source=
FUNCTION Main(Player AS LONG) AS LONG
   Dim MyMap as Long
   Dim MyX as Long
   Dim MyY as Long
   Dim UsedAdvocate as Long
   MyMap = GetPlayerMap(Player)
   MyX = GetPlayerX(Player)
   MyY = GetPlayerY(Player)

   Dim A as Long
   For A = 1 to GetMaxUsers()
      If GetPlayerMap(A) = MyMap Then
         Dim DistX as Long, DistY as Long
         DistX = Abs(MyX - GetPlayerX(A))
         DistY = Abs(MyY - GetPlayerY(A))

         If DistX <= 1 & DistY <= 1 Then
            If Player = A Then
               'Do Nothing
            Else
               UsedAdvocate = 1
               AttackPlayer(Player, A, 255)
               AttackPlayer(Player, A, 255)
               AttackPlayer(Player, A, 255)
               AttackPlayer(Player, A, 255)
               AttackPlayer(Player, A, 255)
               AttackPlayer(Player, A, 255)
               AttackPlayer(Player, A, 255)
               AttackPlayer(Player, A, 255)
               AttackPlayer(Player, A, 255)
               AttackPlayer(Player, A, 255)
               AttackPlayer(Player, A, 255)
               AttackPlayer(Player, A, 255)
               AttackPlayer(Player, A, 255)
               AttackPlayer(Player, A, 255)
               AttackPlayer(Player, A, 255)
            End If
         End If   
      End If
   Next A

   If UsedAdvocate = 1 Then 
      GlobalMessage(StrCat(GetPlayerName(Player), " has used a Death's Advocate!"), BRIGHTGREEN)
      TakeObj(Player, 455, 1)
   End If

   Main = Continue
END FUNCTION

Name=USEOBJ485

Script Source=
FUNCTION Main(Player AS LONG) AS LONG
	TakeObj(Player, 485, 1)
   Main = Stop
   
   Exit Function

   Dim A as Long, B as Long, C as Long, D as Long, E as Long
   Select Case GetPlayerDirection(Player)
      Case UP
         A = GetPlayerX(Player)
         B = GetPlayerY(Player) - 1
         D = GetPlayerMap(Player)
         E = B - 1
         If B < 0 Then Exit Function
         For C = 1 to GetMaxUsers()
            If GetPlayerMap(C) = D & GetPlayerX(C) = A & GetPlayerY(C) = B Then
               If GetTileAtt(D, A, E) = 0 Then PlayerWarp(C, D, A, E)
            End If
         Next A
      Case DOWN
         A = GetPlayerX(Player)
         B = GetPlayerY(Player) + 1
         D = GetPlayerMap(Player)
         E = B + 1
         If B > 10 Then Exit Function
         For C = 1 to GetMaxUsers()
            If GetPlayerMap(C) = D & GetPlayerX(C) = A & GetPlayerY(C) = B Then
               If GetTileAtt(D, A, E) = 0 Then PlayerWarp(C, D, A, E)
            End If
         Next A
      Case LEFT
         A = GetPlayerX(Player) - 1
         B = GetPlayerY(Player)
         D = GetPlayerMap(Player)
         E = A - 1
         If A < 0 Then Exit Function
         For C = 1 to GetMaxUsers()
            If GetPlayerMap(C) = D & GetPlayerX(C) = A & GetPlayerY(C) = B Then
               If GetTileAtt(D, E, B) = 0 Then PlayerWarp(C, D, E, B)
            End If
         Next A
      Case RIGHT
         A = GetPlayerX(Player) + 1
         B = GetPlayerY(Player)
         D = GetPlayerMap(Player)
         E = A + 1
         If A > 10 Then Exit Function
         For C = 1 to GetMaxUsers()
            If GetPlayerMap(C) = D & GetPlayerX(C) = A & GetPlayerY(C) = B Then
               If GetTileAtt(D, E, B) = 0 Then PlayerWarp(C, D, E, B)
            End If
         Next A
   End Select
END FUNCTION

Script Source=
Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim Map as Long, X as Long, Y as Long
dim Loop as Long, Mana as Long, Buff as Long
dim CalcX as Long, CalcY as Long
'Cleric Endurance Buff

Map = GetPlayerMap(Player)
X = GetPlayerX(Player)
Y = GetPlayerY(Player)
Mana = Divide(GetPlayerMaxMana(Player), 3) * 2
Buff = 7

If GetTileAtt(Map, X, Y) = 6 | GetTileAtt2(Map, X, Y) = 6 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You may not cast that here.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If



'If HasObj(Player, 413) Then
'	Buff = 14
'	TakeObj(Player, 413, 1)
'End If

CreatePlayerFloatText(Player, "Tu Tela!", BrightGreen)


RunScript1("BuffCooldown", Player)

For Loop = 1 to GetMaxUsers()
	If IsPlaying(Loop) Then
		If Map = GetPlayerMap(Loop) Then
			If GetPlayerClass(Loop) = 1 Then
				CalcX = Abs(GetPlayerX(Loop) - X)
				CalcY = Abs(GetPlayerY(Loop) - Y)
				If CalcX < 4 & CalcY < 4 Then
					If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 16) = 0 Then
						RunScript2("testbuff2", Loop, Buff)
					Else
						If GetPlayerGuild(Player) > 0 Then
							If GetPlayerGuild(Player) = GetPlayerGuild(Loop) Then
								RunScript2("testbuff2", Loop, Buff)
							End If
						Else
							SetPlayerFlag(Player, 16, 0)
							PlayerMessage(Player, "Your spells have been set to affect everyone.", White)
							RunScript2("testbuff2", Loop, Buff)
						End If
					End If
				End If
			End If
		End If
	End If
Next Loop

End Sub

Name=useobj619

Script Source=

Function Main(Player as Long) AS LONG
'Store Command - Push
Dim Map as Long, StartX as Long, StartY as Long
Dim CheckX as Long, CheckY as Long, DestX as Long, DestY as Long
Dim Loop as Long

Map = GetPlayerMap(Player)
StartX = GetPlayerX(Player)
StartY = GetPlayerY(Player)

'if getplayerhp(player) <> getplayermaxhp(player) then
	'playermessage(player, "Push requires full hp to use.",white)
	'exit function
'end if

'Push timer - currently disabled
If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 109) > 0 Then Exit Function

'If GetPlayerHP(Player) > Divide(GetPlayerMaxHP(Player), 2) Then
	'PlayerMessage(Player, "You must be below 50% health to cast this spell.", White)
	'Exit Function
'End If
	If GetTileAtt(GetPlayerMap(Player), DestX, DestY) = 5 | GetTileAtt(GetPlayerMap(Player), DestX, DestY) = 11 | GetTileAtt(GetPlayerMap(Player), DestX, DestY) = 17 Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You cannot cast that here.", Grey)
		Exit Sub
end If

If GetPlayerGuild(Player) = 0 Then
	playermessage(player, "You need to be in a guild.", grey)
	Exit function
end if

If GetPlayerEquipped(Player, 2) = 0 Then
	playermessage(player, "You cannot use this ability without a shield!", grey)
	Exit function
end if

'If HasObj(Player, 280) >= 1 Then
'	TakeObj(Player, 280, 4) 
'Else
'	PlayerMessage(Player, "You need Ancient Relics to cast this spell!", Grey)
	'Exit function
'End If


SetPlayerFlag(Player, 109, 1)
Timer(Player, 1, "PushTimer")
Select Case GetPlayerDirection(Player)
	Case Up
		CheckX = StartX
		CheckY = StartY - 1
		DestX = CheckX
		DestY = CheckY - 1
	Case Down
		CheckX = StartX
		CheckY = StartY + 1
		DestX = CheckX
		DestY = CheckY + 1
	Case Left
		CheckX = StartX - 1
		CheckY = StartY
		DestX = CheckX - 1
		DestY = CheckY
	Case Right
		CheckX = StartX + 1
		CheckY = StartY
		DestX = CheckX + 1
		DestY = CheckY
End Select

'Check bounds, if an invalid place to check then exit the script
If CheckX < 0 | CheckY < 0 | CheckX > 11 | CheckY > 11 Then Exit Function
If DestX < 0 | DestY < 0 | DestX > 11 | DestY > 11 Then Exit Function

'If RunScript3("CheckAtt", Player, CheckX, CheckY) = Stop Then Exit Function
'If RunScript3("CheckAtt2", Player, CheckX, CheckY) = Stop Then Exit Function
'If RunScript3("CheckAtt", Player, DestX, DestY) = Stop Then Exit Function
'If RunScript3("CheckAtt2", Player, DestX, DestY) = Stop Then Exit Function
If GetTileAtt(Map, CheckX, CheckY) > 0 Then Exit function
If GetTileAtt(Map, DestX, DestY) > 0 Then Exit function
If GetTileAtt2(Map, CheckX, CheckY) > 0 Then Exit function
If GetTileAtt2(Map, DestX, DestY) > 0 Then Exit function

For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
	If IsPlaying(Loop) Then
		If GetPlayerAccess(Loop) = 0 Then
			If GetPlayerMap(Loop) = Map Then
				If GetPlayerX(Loop) = CheckX Then
					If GetPlayerY(Loop) = CheckY Then 

'Target in position
						If GetPlayerHP(Loop) = GetPlayerMaxHP(Loop) Then 'Full HP
							PlayerWarp(Loop, Map, DestX, DestY)
						End If
					End If
				End If
			End If
		End If
	End If
Next Loop



End Function

Name=useobj620

Script Source=


Sub Main(Player as Long, Target as Long)
Dim Effect as Long, Damage as Long, Mana as Long, XCoord as Long, YCoord as Long, Loop as Long, MonsterLoop as Long, HP as Long



'Area of Effect - Mage Spell - Electric Pulse
If GetPlayerMap(Player) = 1427 | GetPlayerMap(Player) = 1828 | GetPlayerMap(Player) = 1829 Then Exit Sub

If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 23) > 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must wait to cast.", White)
	Exit Sub
End If

Mana = 35
If GetPlayerMana(Player) < Mana Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must regenerate before casting.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If

SetPlayerMana(Player, GetPlayerMana(Player) - Mana)
SetPlayerFlag(Player, 23, 1)
RunScript1("SpellCooldown", Player)

Effect = 5
Damage = GetPlayerDamage(Player) + 5


For Loop = 1 to GetMaxUsers()
	If IsPlaying(Loop) Then
		If GetPlayerMap(Loop) = GetPlayerMap(Player) Then
			XCoord = Abs(GetPlayerX(Loop) - GetPlayerX(Player))
			YCoord = Abs(GetPlayerY(Loop) - GetPlayerY(Player))
			If XCoord < 3 & YCoord < 3 Then
				If Player <> Loop Then
					If GetPlayerAccess(Loop) = 0 Then
	'					HP = GetPlayerHP(Loop)
	'					If Abs(GetPlayerArmor(Loop, Damage)) >= HP Then Damage = HP - GetPlayerArmor(Loop, 1)
						MagicAttackPlayer(Player, Loop, Damage)
					End If
				End If
			End If
		End If
	End If
Next Loop

For XCoord = 1 to 4
	For YCoord = 1 to 4
		For MonsterLoop = 0 to 9
			If GetPlayerX(Player) - 3 + XCoord = GetMonsterX(GetPlayerMap(Player), MonsterLoop) & GetPlayerY(Player) - 3 + YCoord = GetMonsterY(GetPlayerMap(Player), MonsterLoop) Then
				MagicAttackMonster(Player, MonsterLoop, Damage)
			End If
		Next MonsterLoop
		CreateCharacterEffect(GetPlayerMap(Target), Target, 37, 40, 8, 0, 0)
		'CreateCharacterEffect(GetPlayerMap(A), A, 9, 9, 9, 0, 0)
		'CreateTileEffect(GetPlayerMap(Player), GetPlayerX(Player) - 3 + XCoord, GetPlayerY(Player) - 3 + YCoord, Effect, 12, 0, 0, 0)
		'CreateTileEffect(GetPlayerMap(Player), GetPlayerX(Player) - 2 + XCoord, GetPlayerY(Player) - 2 + YCoord, Effect, 0, 10, 0, 0)
	Next YCoord
Next XCoord


End Sub

Name=volcano

Script Source=
Function Main(player as long) as long
dim a as long, Sprite as Long

If Random(2) = 0 Then Sprite = 39 Else Sprite = 176

	GlobalMessage("A Free For All Carnage has started!", 9)
	GlobalMessage("Map: Volcano",white)
	  
SetFlag(82, 0)
For A = 1 to GetMaxUsers()
	If IsPlaying(A) Then
		If GetPlayerMap(A) = 68 Then
			If GetPlayerAccess(A) = 0 Then
				SetPlayerFlag(A, 5, GetPlayerGuild(A))
				SetPlayerFlag(A, 10, 1)
				SetPlayerStatus(A, 9)
				SetPlayerGuild(A, 0)
				SetPlayerSprite(A, Sprite)
				PlayerWarp(A, 109, 3 + random(6), 3 + random(6))
			Else
				PlayerWarp(A, 109, 1, 1)
			End If
		End If
	End If
Next A

End Function

Function Main(Player as Long, Parm1 as Long) AS Long

Select Case Parm1	
	Case 1 'Cren
		PlayerWarp(Player, 2, 5, 5)
	Case 2 'Soc River
		PlayerWarp(Player, 107, 6, 2)
	Case 3 'Dragonia
		PlayerWarp(Player, 104, 7, 6)
	Case 4 'Babylon
		PlayerWarp(Player, 1206, 6, 8)
	Case 5 'Desert - Tombs
		PlayerWarp(Player, 139, 2, 9)
	Case 6 'Desert - Heros
		PlayerWarp(Player, 1585, 5, 7)
	Case 7 'CVR River
		PlayerWarp(Player, 16, 7, 3)
	Case 8 'Volcanic Island
		PlayerWarp(Player, 910, 5, 7)
	Case 9 'Shadecall Bog
		PlayerWarp(Player, 1314, 8, 6)
	Case 10 'Fishing Event
		PlayerWarp(Player, 1435, 11, 5)
	Case 11 'Mining Event
		PlayerWarp(Player, 1437, 11, 5)
	Case 12 'Lumber Event
		PlayerWarp(Player, 1438, 11, 5)
	Case 13 'The Sanctuary
		PlayerWarp(Player, 583, 5, 7)
	Case 14 'Champ 1
		PlayerWarp(Player, 1828, 0, 2)
	Case 15 'Champ 2
		PlayerWarp(Player, 1829, 0, 2)
	Case Else
		PlayerMessage(Player, "==Minor God Warp Points==", Yellow)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "1 - Crendale", White)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "2 - Soc River", White)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "3 - Dragonia", White)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "4 - Babylon", White)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "5 - Desert - Tombs", White)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "6 - Desert - Heros", White)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "7 - CVR River", White)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "8 - Volcanic Island", White)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "9 - Shadecall Bog", White)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "10 - Fishing Event", White)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "11 - Mining Event", White)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "12 - Lumber Event", White)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "13 - The Sanctuary", White)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "14 - Champ 1", White)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "15 - Champ 2", White)
End Select

End Function

Name=warpitems

Script Source=
Sub Main()

dim Map as Long, X as Long, Y as Long
dim Item as Long, Value as Long

Map = 1799

For Item = 0 To 50
	For X = 1 To 2
		For Y = 5 To 6
			If GetObjX(Map, Item) = X & GetObjY(Map, Item) = Y Then
				Value = GetObjVal(Map, Item)
				SpawnObject(Map, GetObjNum(Map, Item), Value, X+3, Y-5)
				DestroyObject(Map, Item)
				GoTo NextItem
			End If
		Next Y
	Next X
	For X = 9 To 10
		For Y = 5 To 6
			If GetObjX(Map, Item) = X & GetObjY(Map, Item) = Y Then
				Value = GetObjVal(Map, Item)
				SpawnObject(Map, GetObjNum(Map, Item), Value, X-3, Y-5)
				DestroyObject(Map, Item)
				GoTo NextItem
			End If
		Next Y
	Next X
NextItem:
Next Item

End Sub

Name=winter

Script Source=
function main(player as long) as long
dim a as long, b as long, c as long, d as long

globalmessage("A Random Team Carnage has started!",brightblue)
globalmessage("Map: Team Fortress Carnage",white)

b = 0
c = 0
d = 0
setflag(60,0)
setflag(61,0)


'//========Teams=======//

for a = 1 to getmaxusers

If getplayermap(a)= 68 then
if getplayeraccess(a) = 0 then
b = random(1)

if b = 0 then

if c >= d then
SetPlayerFlag(A, 5, GetPlayerGuild(A))
SetPlayerGuild(A, 30)
SetPlayerSprite(A, 71)
d = d + 1
setflag(61,getflag(61) + 1)
else
SetPlayerFlag(A, 5, GetPlayerGuild(A))
SetPlayerGuild(A, 31)
SetPlayerSprite(A, 119)
c = c + 1
setflag(60,getflag(60) + 1)
end if

else

if c < d then
SetPlayerFlag(A, 5, GetPlayerGuild(A))
SetPlayerGuild(A, 31)
SetPlayerSprite(A, 119)
c = c + 1
setflag(60,getflag(60) + 1)
else
SetPlayerFlag(A, 5, GetPlayerGuild(A))
SetPlayerGuild(A, 30)
SetPlayerSprite(A, 71)
d = d + 1
setflag(61,getflag(61) + 1)
end if

end if
else
end if
else
end if

next a

'//========Warp=======//

for a = 1 to getmaxusers
if getplayermap(A) = 68 then
 If GetPlayerGuild(A) = 30 Then PlayerWarp(A, 111, 0, 6)
 If GetPlayerGuild(A) = 31 Then PlayerWarp(A, 111, 11, 6)
 If GetPlayerAccess(A) > 5 Then PlayerWarp(A, 111, 1, 1)
end if
next a

end function

Name=wintercarn

Script Source=
Function Main(Player as Long) AS LONG
dim Loop as Long, Team as Long

globalmessage("A Team Carnage has started!",brightblue)
globalmessage("Map: Team Winter Carnage",white)
SetFlag(82, 0)

For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
	If IsPlaying(Loop) Then
		If GetPlayerMap(Loop) = 68 Then
			If GetPlayerAccess(Loop) > 0 Then
				PlayerWarp(Loop, 111, 1, 1)
			Else
				SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10, 2)
				SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 5, GetPlayerGuild(Loop))
				SetPlayerStatus(Loop, 9)
				If Team = 0 Then
					SetPlayerGuild(Loop, 100)
					SetPlayerSprite(Loop, 71)
					SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11, 1)
					PlayerWarp(Loop, 111, 0, 6)
					Team = 1
				Else
					SetPlayerGuild(Loop, 101)
					SetPlayerSprite(Loop, 119)
					SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11, 2)
					PlayerWarp(Loop, 111, 11, 6)
					Team = 0
				End If
			End If
		End If
	End If
Next Loop

End Function
